title: Etsy Store Sales Growth Manager & Store Operations Specialist – Professional Etsy who can manage store and deliver sales
description:
**Job Title: Etsy Store Sales Growth Manager & Store Operations Specialist – Premium Home Décor**



We are seeking an experienced **Etsy Store Sales Growth Manager & Store Operations Specialist** to lead the growth and day-to-day management of our Etsy shop specializing in **premium European-inspired home décor**. Our collection includes **tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, throws, and Afghan-style home textiles**, with a focus on craftsmanship, storytelling, and elevated presentation.



This role is ideal for a professional who understands how to grow an Etsy store strategically—not just maintain listings, but actively increase traffic, conversion, average order value, and repeat purchases while preserving a premium brand image.



### About the Brand



We are a premium home décor business offering beautifully designed textile and decorative products for customers who appreciate timeless, elegant interiors. Our products include:



* Tapestries and wall hangings

* Cushion covers and decorative pillow covers

* Table runners and table linens

* Afghan throws and woven home accessories

* Other premium home décor textiles and accessories



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our Etsy store and help turn it into a stronger, more consistent sales channel.



### Key Responsibilities



**Etsy Store Growth & Sales Generation**



* Develop and execute a clear strategy to grow Etsy store revenue, traffic, and conversion rates

* Optimize the Etsy storefront for sales performance, customer experience, and premium brand presentation

* Identify opportunities to improve click-through rate, conversion rate, average order value, and repeat customer purchases

* Build promotional strategies around seasonal demand, holidays, gifting, home décor trends, and product launches

* Recommend pricing, bundling, and merchandising strategies to improve profitability and sales 
ntum

* Monitor competitors, market trends, keyword opportunities, and product positioning within the premium home décor category



**Listing Optimization & Merchandising**



* Create, optimize, and manage product listings for Etsy SEO and customer conversion

* Write compelling, high-converting titles, descriptions, product highlights, and storytelling-driven copy aligned with a premium brand voice

* Improve product presentation through strong listing structure, keyword strategy, and merchandising logic

* Advise on listing images, mockups, lifestyle content, video, and other visual elements that can improve conversion

* Organize product collections, cross-sell opportunities, and shop sections to enhance browsing and basket size



**Store Management & Daily Operations**



* Manage the day-to-day performance and upkeep of the Etsy store

* Ensure listings are accurate, complete, and updated for inventory, pricing, attributes, shipping settings, and policies

* Monitor shop health, customer experience, reviews, response times, and order-related issues

* Coordinate with the business owner/team regarding new products, stock updates, promotions, and priorities

* Maintain consistency in product presentation, brand messaging, and customer communication



**Analytics, Reporting & Performance Improvement**



* Track Etsy store performance and provide regular reporting on key KPIs such as:



 * Revenue growth

 * Conversion rate

 * Etsy traffic and traffic sources

 * Click-through rate

 * Best-selling products and underperforming listings

 * Return on promotions and campaigns

 * Average order value

* Use data to identify what is working, what is underperforming, and where action is needed

* Make proactive recommendations to improve store performance month over month



### Ideal Candidate Profile



We are looking for someone who has a proven ability to **grow Etsy sales for product-based brands**, ideally within **home décor, textiles, interiors, gifts, lifestyle products, or premium handcrafted/elevated consumer goods**.



**Requirements**



* Proven experience managing and growing Etsy stores with measurable sales results

* Strong understanding of Etsy SEO, ranking factors, merchandising, and conversion optimization

* Experience writing compelling product listings and titles that balance keyword strategy with premium brand positioning

* Strong eye for product presentation, merchandising, and customer-facing storytelling

* Ability to analyze store performance and translate data into actionable growth strategies

* Experience with premium, design-led, lifestyle, or home décor brands is strongly preferred

* Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of store performance

* Excellent written English and communication skills



### What Success Looks Like in This Role



The right candidate will help us:



* Grow Etsy store revenue consistently

* Improve conversion rates across key product listings

* Strengthen the premium positioning of our shop

* Build a more polished, strategic, and high-performing Etsy presence

* Turn Etsy into a dependable and scalable sales channel for our home décor brand



### To Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about your Etsy experience

2. Examples of Etsy stores or brands you have managed

3. Specific results you achieved (sales growth, conversion improvements, SEO wins, etc.)

4. Your approach to growing a premium home décor Etsy store

5. Any relevant experience in home décor, textiles, woven products, interior styling, or premium/luxury consumer brands

title: Professional Amazon Seller Central Manager
description:
# Job Title: Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager- Minimum 7 years of experience required, and willing to work Eastern Standard Time; responsible, reliable, able to deliver results, and has worked exclusively on Amazon Seller Central. Only experienced candidates need apply. Experience should be specialized in Amazon services only.



**Company:** Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc.

**Industry:** Premium European Home Décor

**Location:** Remote

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Contract (depending on experience)



## About Us



Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc. is a premium home décor brand offering high-quality European-made products, including tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, throws, and other elegant textile furnishings. We are focused on building a strong, premium presence on Amazon through exceptional listings, account management, and operational excellence.



We are looking for an experienced **Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager** to take ownership of our Amazon catalog and day-to-day Seller Central operations. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to build, optimize, and manage high-converting Amazon listings while maintaining account health, operational efficiency, and premium brand presentation.



**Important:** This role does **not** include PPC/advertising management. We are specifically seeking a specialist in **Amazon listings and Seller Central management**.



## Role Overview



The Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing our Amazon product listings, maintaining catalog accuracy, improving conversion through better content execution, overseeing Seller Central operations, and ensuring that our Amazon storefront reflects the quality and premium positioning of our brand.



This person should be highly experienced with Amazon Seller Central, flat files, listing variations, catalog troubleshooting, content optimization, image coordination, inventory monitoring, and account performance management.



## Key Responsibilities



### Amazon Listing Management & Optimization



* Create, upload, optimize, and maintain Amazon product listings for premium home décor products.

* Write and refine SEO-friendly product titles, bullet points, product descriptions, backend search terms, and A+ content briefs to improve discoverability and conversion.

* Manage parent-child variations, listing merges/splits, browse node issues, suppressed listings, stranded inventory issues, and catalog inconsistencies.

* Ensure listings accurately reflect product specifications, materials, dimensions, country of origin, care instructions, and premium brand positioning.

* Continuously audit existing listings and identify opportunities to improve CTR, conversion rate, content quality, and overall customer experience.

* Coordinate with creative/design teams to improve listing images, infographics, comparison charts, lifestyle imagery, and premium content presentation.



### Seller Central Account Management



* Manage the day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central, excluding PPC.

* Monitor account health, voice of customer, listing quality dashboards, stranded inventory, suppressed listings, and performance notifications.

* Handle case log management and communicate with Amazon Seller Support to resolve listing, category, compliance, and catalog issues.

* Oversee catalog updates, SKU setup, variation corrections, pricing checks, and listing troubleshooting.

* Ensure product pages remain accurate, compliant, and optimized at all times.



### Inventory, Catalog & Operational Oversight



* Help manage product setup, SKU organization, and catalog structure for current and new launches.

* Monitor inventory levels and listing availability to help reduce stockouts and lost sales opportunities.

* Coordinate listing launches, updates, and seasonal content changes in an organized and timely manner.

* Maintain clean, structured Amazon catalog data and ensure consistency across listings.

* Assist in troubleshooting operational issues affecting listing visibility or sales performance.



### Performance & Growth Support



* Track listing-level performance metrics such as sessions, conversion rate, unit session percentage, sales trends, and Buy Box status.

* Identify underperforming listings and recommend actionable improvements in content, merchandising, images, or catalog structure.

* Work closely with ownership/management to support revenue growth through stronger listing quality, better catalog management, and improved customer-facing content.

* Provide regular reporting and recommendations on listing performance, catalog issues, account risks, and growth opportunities.



## Required Qualifications



* **Minimum 3–5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience** managing listings and account operations.

* Strong experience with **Amazon catalog management** and **listing optimization** in Seller Central.

* Proven experience creating and optimizing product listings that improve conversion and sales performance.

* Deep understanding of:



 * Amazon SEO and listing structure

 * Parent-child variations

 * Flat files and bulk uploads

 * Listing suppression issues

 * Inventory file templates

 * Seller Central troubleshooting

 * Account health and catalog compliance

* Experience managing Amazon listings for **premium consumer products**, ideally in home décor, furnishings, textiles, lifestyle, or similar categories.

* Strong written English and the ability to create polished, premium, customer-focused listing content.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying and solving issues.

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of Amazon account operations.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with **premium home décor, textiles, furnishings, or lifestyle brands**.

* Strong understanding of how listing images, A+ content, and brand storytelling affect conversion.

* Experience working with premium or European-made products and presenting craftsmanship, material quality, and design heritage effectively on Amazon.

* Familiarity with Amazon Brand Registry and premium content execution.

* Ability to work strategically while also managing the day-to-day operational details of Seller Central.



## What Success Looks Like in This Role



* Amazon listings are fully optimized, accurate, visually compelling, and aligned with our premium brand.

* Catalog issues, suppressed listings, and operational problems are resolved quickly and proactively.

* Listing quality and conversion performance improve over time.

* Seller Central is organized, actively managed, and closely monitored.

* Product launches and updates are executed accurately and efficiently.

* The Amazon storefront reflects a polished, premium European home décor brand experience.



## To Apply



Please send the following:



1. A short introduction outlining your Amazon Seller Central experience.

2. Examples of Amazon listings or brands you have managed.

3. A summary of your experience with listing optimization, catalog troubleshooting, and Seller Central account management.

4. Any experience working with premium home décor, textiles, furniture, or lifestyle brands.

5. Your availability and preferred compensation structure.



## Important Note



This role is **not for PPC or advertising management**. We are specifically seeking an Amazon professional who excels in **listing management, catalog optimization, and overall Seller Central account management**.

Job Type: Part-Time | 20 Hours per Week

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday to Friday | U.S. Eastern Time

Industry: B2B Sales, Government Contracting & Emergency Preparedness



About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and highly organized B2B Business Development & Government Bid Coordinator to support outbound sales, lead generation, government procurement research, and bid preparation.



This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys building business relationships through cold calling while also having practical experience supporting U.S. government contracting opportunities.



The ideal candidate has a strong background in B2B outbound sales, hands-on familiarity with 
, and previous experience assisting with government bids, RFQs, or RFPs.



This is not a general virtual assistant or entry-level appointment-setting role. We are looking for someone who can independently manage their responsibilities, communicate confidently with U.S. business decision-makers, and contribute to both commercial sales growth and government contracting initiatives.



Key Responsibilities



1. B2B Sales & Business Development



• Conduct outbound B2B cold calls to U.S.-based distributors, wholesalers, institutional buyers, procurement teams, and commercial organizations.

• Research potential customers and identify key purchasing decision-makers.

• Generate qualified sales opportunities through targeted cold calling,
 outreach, and consistent follow-up.

• Build and maintain relationships with prospective buyers, distributors, and government contractors.

• Present products and solutions professionally, identify customer needs, and handle initial objections.

• Qualify prospects based on purchasing needs, budgets, timelines, and business requirements.

• Schedule qualified sales meetings and follow-up conversations.

• Maintain accurate prospect information, activities, and pipeline records in Salesforce.

• Track outreach performance, leads generated, meetings booked, and pipeline development.



2. U.S. Government Contracting & Bid Coordination

• Research and monitor government contracting opportunities through 
 and other relevant procurement platforms.

• Identify relevant federal and state government solicitations and purchasing opportunities.

• Review Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and related procurement documents.

• Evaluate solicitation requirements, eligibility criteria, documentation needs, and submission deadlines.

• Assist with preparing government bid packages, proposals, compliance checklists, and supporting documentation.

• Coordinate pricing information, product specifications, and other bid requirementswith management.

 • Organize and track government contracting opportunities, proposal progress, and submission deadlines.

• Prepare bid documentation for management's final review and approval.

• Maintain accurate procurement records and follow up on submitted proposals as directed.



Required Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of professional B2B outbound sales, cold calling, or business development experience.

• Proven experience calling U.S. businesses and communicating with decision- makers.

• Previous hands-on involvement in U.S. government procurement, bid preparation, or proposal coordination.

• Working knowledge of 
 and the ability to research and review federal contracting opportunities.

• Experience assisting with RFQs, RFPs, or other government solicitation responses.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with a professional and confident telephone presence.

• Strong research, organization, documentation, and follow-up skills.

• Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM software.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and online research tools.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.

• Reliable internet connection, quiet workspace, and availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting U.S.-based government contractors, procurement teams, or federal contracting businesses.

• Familiarity with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) requirements.

• Experience working with government agencies such as FEMA or the Department of Defense.

• Background in product distribution, wholesale sales, emergency preparedness, food supply, or related industries.

• Experience preparing proposal documentation, bid compliance checklists, or government procurement reports.

• Previous experience managing both business development and administrative coordination responsibilities.



What Success Looks Like

• Consistent and effective B2B cold-calling activity.

• A growing pipeline of qualified commercial sales opportunities.

• Strong relationships with prospective buyers and decision-makers.

.

• Accurate and timely preparation of bid documentation for management review.

• Organized CRM records, procurement tracking, and consistent follow-up.

• Strong ownership, accountability, and the ability to work independently.

title: Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer (AI-Assisted Production)
description:
WebDone is a UK website and marketing agency working with small businesses. We’re building a more productive creative team by combining our designer’s assets, client footage, motion graphics and AI-assisted video. We’re looking for a video editor who is, above all, a strong visual storyteller.



The role: A part-time, ongoing opportunity for someone who can take a brief, make strong creative decisions and deliver polished, publish-ready content reliably. You’ll turn footage, copy, brand templates and our designer’s assets into engaging reels, short videos and paid social ads, using a mix of traditional editing, motion graphics and AI video tools.



Your responsibilities:



Edit short-form videos (reels, short videos and paid social ads) for Instagram,
, TikTok and other platforms, telling a clear, well-structured story.

Animate static designs, logos and layered assets supplied by our designer.

Create kinetic typography, animated headlines and transitions.

Animate website mockups, scrolling websites and before-and-after comparisons.

Produce subtle logo animations, including looping GIFs.

Use AI video generation tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Seedance or similar) alongside traditional editing and motion graphics.

Add accurate captions, text overlays, music and sound treatment, and export correctly for Reels, Stories and Feed.

Work from Figma, SVG or layered design files and supply editable project files.

Keep files organised and flag missing materials or deadline risks early.



What we’re looking for:



Strong storytelling and creative judgement, the ability to turn footage and assets into a complete, well-told piece, not just well-edited clips.

A strong portfolio of short-form video editing and motion graphics.

Confident use of After Effects (or equivalent) and an editing tool such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.

Experience with, or willingness to learn, AI video generation tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Seedance). We won’t exclude a strong editor for not having used a specific platform, and we provide a paid Higgsfield subscription.

Ability to animate a designer’s supplied assets into polished, professional motion (not advanced 3D).

Ability to work independently from a brief without needing constant creative direction.

Strong written English, attention to detail and reliable communication.

Ability to follow different client brands without making every video look the same.



Hours and pay:



Initially around 10 hours per week, with potential to grow.

$8 to $10 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability to deliver finished, publish-ready content.

Rate agreed before any paid work begins. Flexible hours, with agreed availability for UK-team communication.



Our hiring process:



Application and portfolio review.

A short paid task for shortlisted applicants (brief, payment and deadline agreed beforehand).

We intend to offer one candidate the ongoing position.



How to apply: Use the subject line “WebDone Video + Motion + AI” and include:



Two or three short-form video examples. Explain exactly which parts you created, and what story you were telling.

Two or three examples of motion graphics or animation you personally created.

If you’ve used any AI video tools, tell us which and share an example.

Your editing, motion and AI software, and your experience with Figma or layered design files.

Your requested hourly rate within the advertised range.

Your weekly availability, time zone and earliest start date.

A brief example of how you handled an unclear brief or missing assets, working independently.



Please share direct links we can open without requesting access. A small, relevant selection is more useful than a large portfolio.

title: Video Editor & Social Media Production Specialist
description:
WebDone is a UK website and marketing agency working with small businesses. We’re looking for a skilled video editor who can also produce polished social media content using existing brand templates.



This is a part-time, ongoing opportunity for someone who can take a clear brief, make good creative decisions and deliver finished work reliably.



THE ROLE



Video editing is the main focus. You’ll turn supplied footage, copy and creative direction into engaging reels, short videos and paid social ads.



You’ll also produce carousels and static posts using our existing templates, prepare content for approval and upload approved assets into our scheduling system.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Edit short-form videos for Instagram,
, TikTok and other social platforms.

• Select strong footage and create effective openings, clear stories and well-paced edits.

• Add accurate captions, text overlays, music, sound effects and appropriate audio treatment.

• Produce branded carousels and static posts from supplied copy and templates.

• Check spelling, branding, audio, framing and export settings before submitting work.

• Apply feedback carefully and consistently.

• Keep project files, versions and final exports organised.

• Work to an agreed content calendar and flag missing materials or deadline risks early.

• Upload and schedule approved content, following our approval process.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• A strong portfolio of short-form video editing.

• Good judgement around pacing, footage selection, typography and sound.

• Confident use of your chosen editing software, such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.

• Ability to work with Figma templates, or willingness to learn.

• Strong written English and attention to detail.

• Reliable communication and realistic time estimates.

• Ability to follow different client brands without making every video look the same.



Experience producing paid social ads or using GoHighLevel is useful, but not essential.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



You’ll work alongside our founder, content coordinator and designer. We provide briefs, brand guidance, approved messaging, templates and available footage.



We want your creative judgement on how to execute the brief. You should be comfortable asking useful questions, suggesting improvements and taking responsibility for the finished asset.



HOURS AND PAY



• Initially around 10 hours per week, with potential to increase as workload grows.

• $8–$10 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability to independently deliver finished, publish-ready content.

• Your rate will be agreed before any paid work begins.

• Flexible working hours, with agreed availability for communication with our UK team.

• Workload and deadlines agreed in advance.



OUR HIRING PROCESS



1. Application and portfolio review.

2. A short paid editing task for shortlisted applicants. The brief, payment and deadline will be agreed beforehand.

3. Two finalists will be invited to a paid two-week trial with agreed hours.

4. We intend to offer one candidate the ongoing position.



Both finalists will know that there is one ongoing position. All agreed trial work will be paid, whether or not you are selected.



HOW TO APPLY



Please use the subject line “WebDone Video Editor” and include:



1. Three relevant video examples, including a paid social ad if available. Explain exactly which parts you created.

2. One example of a carousel or static social post you produced, if available.

3. Your editing software and experience with Figma.

4. Your requested hourly rate within the advertised range.

5. Your weekly availability, time zone and earliest start date.

6. A rough estimate of how long a typical 30-second reel takes you, including what affects that estimate.

7. A brief example of how you handled an unclear brief or missing footage.



Please share direct links that we can open without requesting access. A small selection of relevant work is more useful than a large, unfiltered portfolio.

title: CRO Shopify
description:
At Lantern Sol, we’re a dynamic, multicultural team of developers, designers, project managers, and SEO experts dedicated to building exceptional e-commerce websites on Shopify. We’ve helped companies generate over $100 million in e-commerce sales, developed 500+ custom websites and apps, and have been featured speakers on Shopify and Amazon.

Shape the future of commerce – Your work will directly impact businesses worldwide.

Flexible work environment – Work from anywhere, set your own schedule.

Join a thriving global team – Collaborate with top talent across multiple time zones.

Professional growth – Stay ahead with continuous learning opportunities and challenging projects.

Lantern Sol is looking for a part-time CRO Specialist to support our Shopify and eCommerce clients. This person will provide the deeper CRO expertise behind each account.



They will analyze customer and website data, develop testing hypotheses, guide experiment planning, evaluate results, and help communicate the business impact of the work to clients.

Each account will still have a Lantern Sol project manager responsible for the overall relationship, timelines, and coordination. Our internal design and development teams will handle execution. The CRO Specialist will own the strategy, analysis, and interpretation that guide the work.

What You’ll Do



Complete initial CRO audits using data from GA4, Shopify, testing platforms, heatmaps, session recordings, and other available sources.

Compare data across platforms to identify conversion issues, customer behavior patterns, and areas of opportunity.

Participate in recurring ideation sessions with project managers, designers, and developers.

Turn findings and ideas into clear, testable hypotheses.

Build and prioritize testing plans based on potential impact, available traffic, confidence, and level of effort.

Recommend an appropriate testing cadence for each client rather than applying the same process to every account.

Plan tests across different areas of the customer journey, such as the homepage, navigation, product pages, cart, and checkout.

Help structure simultaneous tests appropriately so results remain accurate and clients are not exposed to conflicting experiments.

Define the audience, success metrics, and measurement approach for each test.

Review experiment results and determine whether a hypothesis was confirmed, denied, or requires another iteration.

Translate both positive and negative test results into useful insights and clear next steps.

Estimate the potential business impact of test results using conversion rate, traffic, average order value, and projected revenue.

Update client reporting with results, screenshots, findings, and recommendations.

Join client calls when needed to explain testing strategy or present results.

Help Lantern Sol improve and document a consistent CRO process that can scale across accounts.

title: Senior AI-First Airbnb Operations VA
description:
Full time, 10-hour shifts, 6 days a week (about 60 hours/week) · Remote, U.S. Eastern hours



ABOUT US

We run 280+ short-term rental units across Philadelphia and Dallas. We lease apartment buildings and operate them as furnished stays, mostly booked through Airbnb. Day-to-day operations run through a remote VA team working with local cleaning and maintenance teams in both cities.



We also build our own operations software, and AI is already part of how we work. We're hiring a senior VA who works the same way.



THE ROLE

You'll handle guest communication and daily operations across our portfolio, using Claude and ChatGPT throughout the day to do it faster and better. You'll also help us build agentic workflows that take repetitive work off the team.



AI drafts, you d
. We need someone who can tell when an AI answer is wrong, when a guest needs a real person, and when to escalate.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

A self-starter who takes initiative and doesn't need to be told what to work on next. You notice gaps in how the business runs and bring a fix, like a guest question that keeps getting answered from scratch or a report someone rebuilds by hand every week. When you see work being done manually, you look for a way to automate it and you're willing to build it yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Guest communication

• Reply to guest messages in Guesty and Airbnb before, during and after each stay. Slow or missed replies are the biggest driver of bad reviews for us, so speed matters.

• Handle check-in and access issues, Wi-Fi, house rules, booking changes, cancellations, and early check-in, late checkout, pet and parking requests.

• Calm down unhappy guests and fix the problem before it becomes a bad review, including refunds within our guidelines.

• Answer questions about our Damage Protection Program and other fees, and apply our waiver policy.

• Ask guests who had a great stay to leave a review.



Reviews and Airbnb

• Track review scores at the unit level and flag units that are slipping.

• Respond to reviews and work with Airbnb Support on removal requests for reviews that break Airbnb policy.

• Handle Resolution Center cases and damage claims.



Operations

• Dispatch and follow up on cleaning and maintenance issues with our local teams until they're closed.

• Keep listings, check-in guides and unit details (door codes, Wi-Fi, instructions) accurate.

• Keep our Notion workspace current: tasks, maintenance tracker, SOPs.

• Pull daily and weekly reports on guest issues, reviews and unit performance.



AI and agentic workflows

• Use Claude and ChatGPT every day to draft guest replies, summarize long threads, analyze review and reservation data in Google Sheets, and write SOPs.

• Build and maintain the knowledge our AI tools work from: property details, house rules, policies, prompt libraries, Claude Projects and custom GPTs.

• Help build and run agentic workflows in Claude and ChatGPT (connectors, MCP, agents) for routine steps like inbox triage, flagging at-risk stays, logging issues to Notion and sending daily reports.

• Spot repetitive work, propose how to automate it, and document what you build so the rest of the team can use it.

• Review AI output before it reaches a guest. Protect guest data and logins, and never paste passwords or API keys into AI tools.



TOOLS WE USE

Airbnb, VRBO, Guesty, our in-house platform, Stripe, PriceLabs, Notion, 
, Google Workspace, Claude, ChatGPT.



You don't need every one on day one. You do need to have worked inside a PMS (Guesty preferred) and be comfortable in Google Sheets and Notion.



MUST HAVE

• 3+ years in short-term rental guest communication or operations, with Airbnb as a main channel

• A self-starter who spots gaps and manual work and fixes or automates them without being asked

• Daily use of Claude and ChatGPT in real work, with examples you can show

• Hands-on experience with at least one agentic or automation setup: Claude Code, Claude with connectors or MCP, custom GPTs with actions, Make or Zapier with AI steps, or an AI agent you've built or run

• Excellent written English that reads warm and natural, not scripted

• Good judgment on when to fix, when to refund and when to escalate

• Comfortable in Google Sheets: filters, formulas, pivot tables

• Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

• Available full time on U.S. Eastern hours (Philippine night shift)



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience at Airbnb Support or with a property manager running 100+ units

• PriceLabs or Stripe experience

• Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks and JSON

• Experience writing SOPs and training other VAs



WHAT WE OFFER

• Full-time, long-term role

• Team bonuses tied to portfolio review scores

• Raises based on performance reviews

• A team that is building AI into every part of its operations



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Your application must include all of the following:



1. Start your message with "AIRBNB AI" so we know you read the full post.

2. Your resume (PDF).

3. A 3 to 5 minute screen-share video (Loom, or unlisted YouTube or Google Drive) walking us through one real AI workflow you use or built in Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool. Show it working and explain what it saves you.

4. Your reply to the guest message below, plus 2 to 3 lines on what you'd do behind the scenes. Use AI the way you normally would, and include the share link to the chat or the prompt you used.

"Hi, the door code you sent isn't working. We've been outside for 25 minutes with two kids and it's 11pm. If we're not inside in 10 minutes I want a full refund."

5. In 3 to 5 sentences: one agentic workflow you would build in your first 30 days for a 280-unit Airbnb operation, and which tools you'd use.

6. In 3 to 5 sentences: a manual process you noticed in a past role and fixed or automated on your own initiative. What was it, what did you build, and what did it save?

7. A screenshot of your internet speed test.



Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed.

Starfix.ai removes Amazon reviews that break Amazon's Community Guidelines. We are paid only when a review is actually removed. Our customers are Amazon brands in the US, UK and EU.

THE ONE THING WE NEED



Right now our free Review Checker is where leads come in:





A seller pastes an ASIN, fills in a short form, and gets a report within 24 hours showing which of their reviews can be reported for removal.



Your job is to get more of the right sellers onto that page, and to get more of them to finish the form. Not traffic. Qualified sellers with real catalogues.

 flows: welcome, nurture, follow-up after an audit, and our newsletter

 where, with a budget and a target cost per qualified lead

- SEO plus GEO: getting us found when a seller asks ChatGPT or Perplexity how to remove a fake Amazon review

- Lead magnets: we already have the raw material, you turn it into something people trade an
 for

- Short marketing videos and customer case study videos: you handle the brief, the edit and where it gets published

- Look at our site with fresh eyes and tell us what is broken





MUST HAVE



- You have built landing pages that convert and you can show them

- You know GA4 and Google Tag Manager well enough to set up conversion tracking from scratch

- You can set up an
 tool properly, including SPF, DKIM and DMARC

- You have worked inside a CRM (we use HubSpot): forms, contact properties, lifecycle stages, workflows

NICE TO HAVE

OUR STACK



HubSpot, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Slack, Notion, Next.js on Vercel. If you prefer different tools and can justify it, we listen.





HOURS AND PAY



Full time or part time, both work. Long term, not a one-off project. We pay monthly. Tell us your rate in your application.





HOW TO APPLY



Start your reply with the word INBOUND so I know you read this.



Then answer these four. Short answers are fine, but they have to be specific.



1. Send me a link to one landing page you built that converts. Tell me the conversion rate and how you measured it.



2. A seller lands on our Review Checker page. One came from a LinkedIn post, one from a cold
, one from asking ChatGPT. All three hit the same URL. How do you tell them apart in HubSpot? Be specific about the mechanics.

4. Look at 
. Name three concrete things you would change or build in your first 30 days to get more qualified leads from that page. Tell me what you would measure to know if it worked.



If your answers fit, we do a short call so you can tell us how you would support us.





PLEASE READ BEFORE YOU APPLY



Do not
 me personally. We only reply here on the platform.



Your profile has to fit. We need someone experienced who has actually built an inbound engine before, not someone who has read about it.

title: Direct Response Video Editor – High-Converting VSLs for Supplement Brands (70% Real B-Roll, 30% AI)
description:
Direct Response Video Editor – High-Converting VSLs for Supplement Brands (70% Real B-Roll, 30% AI)



We are a fast-growing DTC supplement brand doing $3.5M+ per month in revenue, with subscriptions, and we are going to $100M next year. We spend $2M+ per month on ads, and video is the engine.



We are looking for a video editor who knows how to edit high-converting VSLs (video sales letters) for paid traffic. Not pretty videos. Not fully AI content. Real direct response VSLs that hook people in the first 3 seconds, hold them until the end and make them buy.



STYLE WE WANT

Think of the VSL and ad style of brands like SmoothSpine, Relivex, Koprez, Noroo and Hike Footwear. If you have studied their ads and you know why they work, you are who we are looking for.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit full VSLs and video ads from our scripts and voiceovers.

- Build each video with about 70% real b-roll (real people, real situations, real footage) and about 30% AI-generated visuals.

- Find and select strong b-roll that matches every line of the script: the symptom, the pain, the root cause, the mechanism, the solution and the result.

- Create AI visuals where real footage doesn't exist: mechanism animations, body/organ visuals, before-and-after style scenes and product shots.

- Edit for retention: strong hooks, fast pacing, pattern interrupts, no dead moments.

- Add effects, zooms, text overlays, captions and sound design (SFX, risers, whooshes, music) that keep people watching.

- Make multiple hook variations and iterations of winning VSLs.

- Work with our creative strategists and use our AI workflows to produce at high volume.



WHAT A GREAT VSL MEANS TO US

- The first 3 seconds stop the scroll (hook rate).

- Every few seconds something changes on screen, so people keep watching (hold rate).

- The visuals match the story and make the mechanism easy to understand.

- Sound design and music build emotion and tension toward the offer.

- Captions and text make it work without sound.

- It feels real and trustworthy, not like an AI video.



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience editing direct response VSLs or video ads for supplement, health or DTC brands.

- A portfolio of VSLs you edited yourself, ideally with results (spend, hook rate, hold rate or ROAS).

- You understand pacing and retention editing and can explain why your edits keep people watching.

- You know how to find and use real b-roll and how to blend it with AI generations so it still feels real.

- Experience with AI video and image tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway or similar).

- Strong in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve.

- Strong sound design skills.

- Fast and consistent. You can produce at high volume without losing quality.

- Fluent English and clear communication in Slack.



BONUS POINTS

- You have edited VSLs in the style of SmoothSpine, Relivex, Koprez, Noroo or Hike Footwear.

- Experience with Claude Code or AI workflows to speed up editing.

- You know direct response copywriting and awareness levels.



HOW TO APPLY

We only review applications that answer all questions and include a portfolio.



1. Send 3-5 VSLs or video ads you edited yourself. Tell us what you did on each one and, if you know them, the results.

2. Pick one VSL from SmoothSpine, Relivex, Koprez, Noroo or Hike Footwear and explain why it works: the hook, pacing, b-roll, effects and sound design.

3. How do you keep hold rate high in a 2-5 minute VSL?

4. How do you blend real b-roll with AI visuals so the video still feels real?

5. How many VSLs or video ads can you edit per week at a high quality level?



PAID TEST (for shortlisted candidates)

We send you a script and voiceover. You edit the first 120 seconds of a VSL in our style with 70% real b-roll and 30% AI.



Start your application with the word "RETENTION" so we know you read the whole post.



Start date: as soon as possible.
salary: 1500 USD P MONTH FULL TIME + bonus

title: # Professional Voice Training Specialist / Vocal Coach — One-on-One Remote Training
description:
**Remote | One-on-One Training | Professional Voice Development**



I am looking for an **experienced professional voice training specialist / vocal coach** to work with me one-on-one remotely.



My goal is to improve my voice as much as realistically possible — including making it **clearer, stronger, more pleasant, better controlled, more confident, and more professional-sounding.**



This is **NOT simply a singing teacher position.**



I am specifically looking for someone who understands the **voice itself** and can professionally assess and train an individual's voice.



## WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



You should have strong professional knowledge and experience in areas such as:



- Vocal training and voice development

- **Vocal and throat anatomy**

- Breathing and breath support

- Vocal production

- Resonance

- Projection

- Pitch and pitch control

- Tone and vocal quality

- Articulation and clarity

- Vocal placement

- Voice strength and control

- Proper vocal technique

- Identifying weaknesses in a person's voice

- Creating exercises specifically for an individual's needs



You should be able to **listen carefully to my voice, identify what can be improved, explain what is happening, and create a structured training program to work on it.**



I am looking for someone who can determine **what is actually limiting the quality of my voice** and then develop exercises and techniques specifically for those areas.



## REMOTE ONE-ON-ONE TRAINING



Training will be conducted remotely through live video sessions.



You should be comfortable:



- Demonstrating exercises through video

- Listening carefully to my voice

- Watching my technique

- Correcting me in real time

- Explaining exactly what I am doing incorrectly

- Demonstrating the correct technique

- Having me repeat an exercise until I understand it

- Giving me exercises to practice between sessions

- Tracking my progress from session to session



I am looking for a **personalized training program**, not a generic lesson plan.



If there are certain things that genuinely require an in-person professional, I can arrange that separately locally. The primary training will be done remotely.



## IMPORTANT — REMOTE AUDIO QUALITY & VOICE ASSESSMENT



Because this is voice training, **being able to accurately hear my voice is extremely important.**



I am not looking for someone who simply knows how to conduct a Zoom call.



You should understand the limitations of remote voice training and know how to get the **clearest and most accurate representation of the voice possible through technology.**



You should be able to recommend the best setup for our sessions, including:



- Which platform you recommend for voice training — **Zoom, Google Meet,
, or another platform — and why**

- What type of microphone you recommend

- Whether I should use headphones or a headset

- How I should position myself in relation to the microphone

- What audio settings you recommend

- Whether any platform features such as **noise suppression, echo cancellation, automatic gain control, compression, or other audio processing** could interfere with accurately evaluating the voice

- Whether any settings should be changed or disabled during voice training

- Whether you recommend live sessions alone or also using **high-quality voice recordings**

- What type of recordings you would want me to provide before our first session

- How you distinguish actual characteristics of my voice from artifacts caused by the microphone, room, software, or internet connection



### I want you to be able to hear my actual voice.



If you believe another platform or setup would allow you to evaluate the voice more accurately than standard Zoom settings, **tell me what you recommend and why.**



You should have a thoughtful answer to this rather than simply saying, "Zoom is fine."



## VIDEO TEACHING EXPERIENCE



I am particularly interested in seeing **how you actually teach**, not just hearing about your qualifications.



If available, please provide a **short video of yourself actually teaching or coaching someone's voice.**



I would especially like to see how you:



- Listen to a student's voice

- Identify a problem

- Explain what you hear

- Demonstrate an exercise

- Correct the student

- Give feedback

- Adjust your approach based on the individual student



A singing performance or promotional video is **not as useful to me** as a video showing you actually teaching.



If you do not have a teaching video available, please explain your previous experience conducting one-on-one voice training.



## WHAT I EXPECT FROM THE TRAINING



I want the training to be structured and progressive.



I would like you to:



1. Assess my current voice

2. Identify the main areas that need improvement

3. Explain what you are hearing and why it matters

4. Establish specific goals

5. Create exercises for those areas

6. Teach me how to perform the exercises correctly

7. Give me a practice routine between sessions

8. Monitor my progress

9. Adjust the exercises as my voice develops

10. Help me build better control and consistency over time



I am interested in **actual voice development**, not simply being told to "speak with confidence."



## IMPORTANT



I am looking for a **professional**, not someone who simply enjoys singing or has casual experience.



Professional voice coaching, vocal training, singing instruction, speech/voice training, or related professional experience is strongly preferred.



A strong understanding of **vocal/throat anatomy and how the voice physically works** is particularly important.



You should also be able to explain the **reason behind the exercises** you recommend.



If you recommend an exercise, I want to understand what it is intended to change or improve.



## EXPERIENCE



Please tell me:



- How many years you have professionally trained voices

- What type of clients/students you normally work with

- Your professional qualifications or training

- Whether you specialize in singing, speaking voice, vocal development, or multiple areas

- Your experience conducting voice training remotely

- Your experience specifically using video sessions

- Your experience assessing voices through microphones/remote audio

- Any particularly difficult voice-development cases you have successfully worked with

- Whether you have experience creating individualized voice-training programs



## APPLICATION — PLEASE ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS



Please apply through **OnlineJobs.ph**.



In your application, answer all of the following:



**1. Tell me about your professional voice-training experience.**

How many years have you trained voices, and what types of clients have you worked with?



**2. How strong is your knowledge of vocal/throat anatomy?**

Please explain your education, training, or professional experience in this area.



**3. What areas of the voice do you specialize in?**

For example: speaking voice, vocal development, resonance, projection, articulation, tone, breath support, singing, etc.



**4. How would you approach improving someone's voice through remote one-on-one training?**

Please describe what you would actually do during the sessions.



**5. What would you normally assess during the first session?**



**6. Please provide examples of the types of voice problems or weaknesses you have helped people improve.**



**7. How would you set up the technology to accurately hear and evaluate my voice remotely?**

Which platform would you recommend, what microphone/headphone setup would you use, and are there any audio-processing settings you would change or disable? Please explain why.



**8. Do you have a video of yourself actually teaching or coaching someone's voice?**

If yes, please provide the link. I am more interested in seeing you teach than seeing a performance or promotional video.



**9. Please provide your HOURLY RATE or SESSION RATE.**



**10. How long is one standard training session?**



### IMPORTANT



**You MUST state how much you charge in your application.**



Applications without a clear hourly or session rate may not be considered.



Please also provide a **website, professional profile, teaching video, portfolio, or other evidence of your professional voice-training experience if available.**



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



I am looking for someone who is:



- Professional

- Highly knowledgeable about the human voice

- Strong in vocal/throat anatomy

- Experienced in individualized voice training

- Patient

- Detail-oriented

- A careful listener

- Good at explaining concepts

- Good at demonstrating techniques

- Comfortable correcting students

- Experienced with remote/video training

- Technically knowledgeable about remote audio quality

- Genuinely interested in helping me maximize the quality of my voice



Most importantly, I want someone who can **listen to my voice carefully, figure out what can realistically be improved, teach me exactly how to improve it, and track my progress over time.**



## RATE



Please clearly state your **hourly or per-session rate** in your application.



I am open to discussing rates with the right professional based on experience and qualifications.

title: # Cold Calling & Sales Role-Play Coach — 1-on-1 Training
description:
I am looking for an experienced **Sales Coach / Sales Trainer / Cold Calling Trainer** to work with me one-on-one.



I am **not looking for someone to make cold calls for me**. I am looking for someone who will **personally train and coach me so I become much better at cold calling and selling.**



The right person should be comfortable actively coaching me, challenging me, correcting me, and doing realistic role-plays with me.



## What I Want to Learn



I want to become confident and effective on the phone, including:



* How to start a cold call confidently

* How to create and deliver a strong pitch

* What exactly to say and how to say it

* How to sound confident, natural, and conversational

* How to avoid sounding nervous, robotic, or overly scripted

* How to ask good questions

* How to keep the prospect engaged

* How to identify the prospect's needs

* How to transition naturally into the offer

* How to ask for the appointment or sale

* How to handle rejection

* How to handle difficult prospects

* How to overcome common objections

* How to think on my feet when the prospect says something unexpected

* How to become more comfortable and confident through repeated practice



## I Want REAL Role-Playing



This is extremely important.



I want you to actually **play the role of the prospect** while I practice calling you.



For example, you might act like a prospect who says:



> "I'm not interested."



Then I respond.



You challenge me again.



You might say:



> "Just send me an
."



Or:



> "We already have someone."



Or:



> "How much does it cost?"



Or:



> "Where did you get my number?"



Or give me another realistic objection.



I want you to **challenge me instead of making the role-play easy.**



After the role-play, I want you to explain:



* What I did well

* What I did poorly

* Where I sounded uncertain

* What I should have said instead

* How I could improve my wording

* How I could sound more confident

* Where I talked too much

* Where I should have asked a question

* Where I should have pushed back

* How I could have moved the conversation toward an appointment or sale



Then I want to **do the role-play again** and apply your corrections.



## I Want a Coach Who Will Push Me



Please don't simply tell me that everything sounds good.



I want someone who will respectfully **challenge me and point out my weaknesses**.



If my pitch is weak, tell me.



If I sound nervous, tell me.



If I'm talking too much, stop me.



If I'm asking the wrong question, explain what I should ask.



If I'm avoiding asking for the sale, challenge me to actually ask.



The goal is for me to improve through **repetition, feedback, and realistic practice.**



## Help Me Build My Pitch



I would also like help developing and improving my actual sales pitch.



You should be able to help me:



1. Understand the product/service I'm selling

2. Create a strong opening

3. Develop the pitch

4. Create good discovery questions

5. Prepare responses to common objections

6. Practice the entire conversation

7. Adjust the script so it sounds natural rather than memorized

8. Practice until I can deliver it confidently



## Experience I'm Looking For



You should have significant experience in one or more of the following:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* B2C sales

* Sales training

* Sales coaching

* Sales management

* SDR/BDR training

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Closing

* Objection handling

* Phone sales

* Sales role-playing

* Sales performance coaching



**Teaching/coaching ability is very important.**



Being a good salesperson alone is not enough. You need to be able to **teach another person how to sell.**



## Sample Video — VERY IMPORTANT



If you have a video showing yourself doing any of the following, please send it with your application:



* Sales coaching

* Cold-call training

* Role-playing a sales call

* Teaching someone how to sell

* Demonstrating a cold call

* Handling objections

* Training salespeople



It does **not** have to be a professionally produced video.



I mainly want to see **how you actually teach and coach.**



If you don't have an existing video, you may record a short sample explaining how you would coach someone through a cold call.



## Please Include Your Desired Rate



Please tell me **how much you are asking per hour** for this type of one-on-one coaching.



Do not simply write "negotiable."



Please provide your actual requested hourly rate.



## Please Answer These Questions



1. How many years of sales experience do you have?

2. How many years of sales training/coaching experience do you have?

3. Have you personally trained people to cold call?

4. Have you done live sales role-play with students or salespeople?

5. What types of products/services have you sold?

6. What type of sales were you involved in — B2B, B2C, high-ticket, appointment setting, closing, etc.?

7. How do you normally structure a one-on-one sales coaching session?

8. How do you teach someone to sound more confident on the phone?

9. How do you teach objection handling?

10. Are you comfortable challenging the student rather than simply giving encouragement?

11. Do you have a sample video? **Please provide the link.**

12. What is your desired hourly rate?



## Top 3 Skills



Please make sure your profile/application highlights these three skills:



**1. Cold Calling & Sales Training**



**2. Sales Role-Play & Objection Handling**



**3. Sales Pitch, Confidence & Communication Coaching**



I am looking for someone interested in **ongoing one-on-one coaching**, not just a one-time session.



Please apply with your experience, sample video if available, and desired hourly rate.

title: Service Dispatcher – Field Service / Technician Scheduling
description:
AAA Forklifts, Parts & Service is looking for an experienced Service Dispatcher to coordinate our field service technicians and help keep our daily service schedule running smoothly.



Dispatch experience is strongly preferred for this position. We are looking for someone who has experience scheduling and coordinating technicians, drivers, contractors, delivery personnel, or other field/mobile employees—not simply general customer service experience.



What You'll Do

As our Service Dispatcher, you'll be at the center of our daily service operations.

You'll receive service calls from customers, gather the necessary equipment and repair information, and coordinate those requests with our field technicians.



Throughout the day, you'll:

- Schedule and dispatch field service technicians

- Assign service calls based on technician availability, location, and workload

- Coordinate routes to reduce unnecessary travel and improve efficiency

- Handle schedule changes, urgent service calls, cancellations, and delays

- Communicate with customers regarding technician arrival times and service updates

- Gather accurate equipment information and details about the customer's service issue

- Verify service requests, warranties, parts requirements, and other job information

- Keep technicians updated throughout the day

- Follow up with customers after service

- Maintain accurate service notes, records, and communications in our service software

- Coordinate with our Service Advisors, Parts Department, and Service Manager



This is a fast-moving position. Priorities can change throughout the day, so we're looking for someone who can stay organized, communicate clearly, and make good decisions without losing track of the details.



What We're Looking For

Strong candidates will have previous dispatching experience, particularly coordinating field employees or mobile service teams.



Experience may include:

- Automotive or equipment service dispatch

- HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or appliance service dispatch

- Roadside assistance or towing dispatch

- Trucking, transportation, or delivery dispatch

- Construction or contractor scheduling

- Field service technician coordination

- Fleet or logistics dispatch



Forklift experience is not required. We can teach you our equipment and processes. What we're looking for is someone who already understands the pace and responsibility of dispatching.



Requirements

- Previous dispatching, field service coordination, or technician scheduling experience strongly preferred

- Strong spoken and written English

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone throughout the workday

- Excellent organization and multitasking skills

- Able to manage multiple technicians and service calls simultaneously

- Comfortable making schedule adjustments when priorities change

- Strong computer and typing skills

- Detail-oriented with accurate documentation

- Able to work independently while communicating closely with the service team



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience working with a U.S.-based company

- Automotive, forklift, heavy equipment, or industrial service experience

- Experience using dispatch, CRM, ERP, or field-service management software

- Bilingual English/Spanish



About AAA Forklifts

At AAA Forklifts, Parts & Service, we help customers with equipment repair, maintenance, parts, buying, selling, and trading.

We're a growing team that values communication, accountability, teamwork, and people who take ownership of their work. You'll work closely with our service and parts teams and play an important role in making sure our customers receive fast, organized, and reliable service.



How to Apply



Put SERVICE FIRST in the subject line and answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your dispatching experience.

What type of technicians, drivers, contractors, or field employees did you dispatch, and approximately how many did you coordinate at one time?



2. Walk us through how you managed a typical dispatch schedule.

How did you assign jobs and keep track of technician locations, availability, travel time, and changes throughout the day?



3. Give us an example of a difficult dispatch situation you handled.

For example: an emergency service call came in, a technician was running late, a job took longer than expected, or a customer needed immediate service. What did you do?



4. Have you worked for a U.S.-based company?

If yes, tell us about the company, your position, and your main responsibilities.



5. This position involves answering incoming service calls and speaking with American customers throughout the day.

Rate your phone communication skills from 1–10 and briefly explain your rating.



6. What dispatching, scheduling, CRM, or field-service software have you used?



7. Voice Recording



Using Vocaroo, send us a 60–90 second recording introducing yourself and answering:

“Tell us about your dispatch experience and why you would be good at coordinating field service technicians and communicating with customers.”



We look forward to hearing from you!

We help small and mid-sized businesses across the country, including companies in regulated industries, with IT support, cybersecurity, cloud services, and compliance. Our clients count on us for secure, reliable systems and support they can trust.



What matters to us:

> Honesty and integrity, without exception

> Accountability

> Professional conduct with clients and teammates

> Open communication, mutual trust, and always getting better



Our team moves quickly and works closely together to keep our clients' critical systems running. We look for people who are dependable, pay attention to detail, get ahead of problems, and care about the quality of what they deliver.





THE ROLE

- - - - - - - -



We're hiring a Level 3 Helpdesk Technician to provide advanced remote support to our business clients. You'll be the person the team relies on for escalated and complex issues, so strong troubleshooting, clear communication, and hands-on experience with MSP tools and processes are essential.



Day to day, you'll work escalated tickets, support projects, partner with our PSA system, and coordinate with SaaS and software vendors. Security comes first in everything you do.



Typical issues you'll handle include:

• Business applications (M365, SaaS platforms, Azure AD)

• Microsoft Admin Portal, Entra, and Azure

• Google Workspace

•
 delivery problems on both the client and server side

• Firewall/UTM configuration changes

• Account access, password resets, and MFA setup

• Slow PCs and general system troubleshooting

• Printers and scanners

• VPN and remote access



** You must write and speak English fluently and be comfortable on the phone with clients throughout your shift. **





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- - - - - - - -



• Take ownership of escalated Level 3 support requests from business clients.

• Troubleshoot and fix problems involving servers, workstations, M365, Azure, networks, and cloud applications.

• Identify recurring issues and technical deficiencies and work with the management team to develop long-term solutions

 Manage tickets from start to finish in Our PSA system Manage: triage, updates, and resolution.

• Coordinate with our PSA system/helpdesk and internal staff.

• Keep clients informed with clear, courteous, professional communication.

• Contribute to projects, migrations, and automation work.

• Work directly with software and SaaS vendors to get client issues resolved.

• Keep IT Glue documentation accurate and current.

• Apply security best practices in every task.

• Write ticket notes that are thorough, client-ready, and updated as you work.

• Stay on top of daily routines such as board cleanup, ticket follow-ups, and mailbox maintenance.

• Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for the rest of the helpdesk team.





REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

- - - - - - - -



• Proven MSP experience (Level 3 required)

• Strong English communication (written + verbal)

• Deep understanding of troubleshooting Windows, networks, and cloud environments

• Ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently and efficiently

• Proficiency with:

-- PSA Systems

-- RMM Solutions

-- IT Glue Documentation (advantage)

-- Microsoft 365 Admin Centers (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams)

-- Entra ID / Azure AD (Identity, groups, MFA, SSO, access policies)

-- Azure (VMs, networking, storage – preferred)

-- Google Workspace

-- Firewall portals: Sophos, SonicWall, Fortinet, Ubiquiti (preferred)



• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, routing, VLANs, VPN)

• Ability to follow SOPs and update documentation clearly & accurately

• Must demonstrate Respect, Excellence, Action, Collaboration and Trust in all work.





PREFERRED SKILLS (Bonus but not required)

- - - - - - - -



• 2+ years technical support experience

• Experience with Autotask and Datto RMM

• Experience deploying and supporting macOS for business clients

• Experience with Windows and macOS MDM solutions

• Experience with Intune, Endpoint Manager, M365 Compliance

• Experience with Ubiquiti hardware and cloud controllers

• Familiarity with IT Glue, Confluence, or ITBoost

• PowerShell scripting and command-line experience

• API/Webhook configuration experience

• Vendor certifications (Microsoft, Cisco, SonicWall, Sophos, CompTIA)





HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS

- - - - - - - -



> Dedicated work area (quiet, distraction-free & video appropriate)

> Backup power (UPS or similar)

> Stable internet: 10 Mbps minimum

> Modern PC (currently 12GB+ RAM, Intel i5+ CPU and SSD)

> Modern Windows OS (currently Windows 11 Pro)

> Dual Monitors (3 monitors preferred)

> Webcam (must be on during all internal calls and meetings)

> Noise-cancelling headset

> Mobile phone for MFA









WHAT WE OFFER

- - - - - - - -



> 100% work from home

> Healthy work/life balance

> A team that supports and values you

> Medical insurance reimbursement after 90 days (full-time employees)

> 13th month pay

> Paid time off (full-time employees)

> Paid US holidays





HOW TO APPLY

- - - - - - - -

Every step below is required. Applications missing any step will not be reviewed.



1 — Confirm that you have Level 3 MSP experience

2 — Upload your resume

3 — Record a short video from your work desk telling us why you're the right fit

    * You MUST mention "UPTIME IT" in your video *

4 — In the same video, answer these questions:

    > A. Describe your MSP experience.

    > B. Which MSP tools have you worked with (PSA, RMM, documentation, etc.)?

    > C. What is your experience with M365, Entra, and Azure?

    > D. What hourly rate (USD) are you looking for?

5 — Send everything through OnlineJobs.ph only.
ed applications will not be accepted.

6 — Use at least 5 Apply Points when applying





A NOTE ON HONESTY

- - - - - - - -



We do not tolerate dishonesty at any stage, during hiring or after. Providing false information, submitting someone else's work, using AI without disclosing it, or overstating your experience will result in immediate rejection and a permanent block from future openings.

title: Admin & Operations Support (Detail-Oriented)
description:
Full-Time Virtual Assistant

Admin & Operations Support (Detail-Oriented)



About Us



We are a growing, patient-focused eye care practice with multiple locations. We take operations seriously. Accuracy, follow-through, and clean systems matter here.

This role is not creative, not sales, and not marketing.



This is for someone who:

Likes order, structure, and checklists

Notices mistakes others miss

Feels uncomfortable leaving things unfinished

Takes pride in clean work and clear reporting

If that sounds boring, this role is not for you.



Who This Role Is For



You might be a great fit if you:

Are extremely detail-oriented and methodical

Enjoy admin, billing support, and patient coordination

Follow instructions carefully and exactly

Like clear expectations and accountability

Want a stable, long-term, full-time role

You will support insurance, billing, patient communication, and internal operations so the office runs smoothly.



Core Responsibilities

Insurance & Billing Support

Verifying vision insurance coverage

Sending copay and invoice emails before appointments

Submitting, correcting, voiding, and tracking insurance claims

Monitoring insurance payments and applying EOBs

Following up on denied or unpaid claims

Tracking insurance receivables and aging balances

Patient & Front Desk Support

Confirming upcoming appointments

Messaging patients about scheduling and rescheduling

Communicating insurance issues clearly and professionally

Sending prescription, invoice, and contact lens quote emails

Following up with patients when prescriptions expire

Admin & Documentation

Uploading and organizing patient files

Checking for incomplete charts and billing issues

Reminding the team of missing information

Managing fax uploads and document cleanup

Updating frame inventory and order status

Reviews & Orders

Sending review requests

Responding to patient reviews professionally

Cancelling contact lens orders when prescriptions expire

Following up with patients as needed





This role includes daily and weekly reporting.

You will be responsible for:

A daily end-of-day admin summary

A weekly operations report for leadership

Tracking KPIs related to appointments, billing, and insurance

If you do not like reporting or tracking numbers, this role is not a fit.



Requirements (Read Carefully)

Resourceful 

Excellent written English

Strong attention to detail

Comfortable with repetitive admin work

Reliable internet and quiet workspace

Willing to learn healthcare workflows

Able to follow SOPs exactly

Experience with:

Medical or vision insurance (preferred, not required)

Admin, billing, or operations support

Practice management systems (a plus)

Schedule & Pay

Full-time, 40 hours/week

US Eastern Time overlap required

Long-term position

Pay based on experience



HOW TO APPLY (VERY IMPORTANT)

Applications that do not follow these steps will be ignored.



Step 1: Short Video (Required)

Record a 2–3 minute Loom video answering:

Why this role appeals to you

Why you believe you are detail-oriented

An example of a mistake you caught that others missed

No scripts. Be clear and natural.



Step 2: Written Task (Required)

In your application, include the following:



A. Attention to Detail Test

Reply with the phrase:

“Accuracy builds trust.”

If this exact phrase is missing or incorrect, the application will not be reviewed.



B. Scenario Question

Answer this in writing:

A patient is scheduled tomorrow, but insurance cannot be verified and the information on file is incomplete.

What steps would you take?

We are looking for process, not perfection.



Step 3: Resume

Attach your resume or work history.



Final Note

This is a long-term role for someone who wants stability, clear expectations, and to grow inside an operations-focused company.

If you enjoy bringing order to chaos and being relied on for accuracy, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Real-Time Vehicle Dispatch Specialist
description:
We’re hiring our first dedicated Dispatchers to support our growing operations, particularly on a network of autonomous vehicles and food-delivery robots across U.S. markets. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day dispatch including monitoring live fleet operations, coordinating with field teams, troubleshooting issues as they happen, and helping build dispatch workflows that will support the operation as it scales. 



You’ll be working across multiple systems and communication channels, keeping track of what’s happening across different markets and jumping in when something needs attention. You’ll work closely with field operators and internal teams, make quick calls when issues come up, and speak directly with customers when needed. 



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable making quick decisions, switching between different tools, and working with both internal teams and external customers. You’ll be working closely with U.S.-based field teams every shift, so previous experience supporting U.S. operations remotely is a strong plus. Since this function is still being built, you’ll also have a real opportunity to help shape the workflows, escalation paths, and processes that the team will use as it grows.
