title: Cold call and sales Coach 1 on 1
description:
I am looking for an experienced **Sales Coach / Sales Trainer / Cold Calling Trainer** to work with me one-on-one.



I am **not looking for someone to make cold calls for me**. I am looking for someone who will **personally train and coach me so I become much better at cold calling and selling.**



The right person should be comfortable actively coaching me, challenging me, correcting me, and doing realistic role-plays with me.



## What I Want to Learn



I want to become confident and effective on the phone, including:



* How to start a cold call confidently

* How to create and deliver a strong pitch

* What exactly to say and how to say it

* How to sound confident, natural, and conversational

* How to avoid sounding nervous, robotic, or overly scripted

* How to ask good questions

* How to keep the prospect engaged

* How to identify the prospect's needs

* How to transition naturally into the offer

* How to ask for the appointment or sale

* How to handle rejection

* How to handle difficult prospects

* How to overcome common objections

* How to think on my feet when the prospect says something unexpected

* How to become more comfortable and confident through repeated practice



## I Want REAL Role-Playing



This is extremely important.



I want you to actually **play the role of the prospect** while I practice calling you.



For example, you might act like a prospect who says:



> "I'm not interested."



Then I respond.



You challenge me again.



You might say:



> "Just send me an
."



Or:



> "We already have someone."



Or:



> "How much does it cost?"



Or:



> "Where did you get my number?"



Or give me another realistic objection.



I want you to **challenge me instead of making the role-play easy.**



After the role-play, I want you to explain:



* What I did well

* What I did poorly

* Where I sounded uncertain

* What I should have said instead

* How I could improve my wording

* How I could sound more confident

* Where I talked too much

* Where I should have asked a question

* Where I should have pushed back

* How I could have moved the conversation toward an appointment or sale



Then I want to **do the role-play again** and apply your corrections.



## I Want a Coach Who Will Push Me



Please don't simply tell me that everything sounds good.



I want someone who will respectfully **challenge me and point out my weaknesses**.



If my pitch is weak, tell me.



If I sound nervous, tell me.



If I'm talking too much, stop me.



If I'm asking the wrong question, explain what I should ask.



If I'm avoiding asking for the sale, challenge me to actually ask.



The goal is for me to improve through **repetition, feedback, and realistic practice.**



## Help Me Build My Pitch



I would also like help developing and improving my actual sales pitch.



You should be able to help me:



1. Understand the product/service I'm selling

2. Create a strong opening

3. Develop the pitch

4. Create good discovery questions

5. Prepare responses to common objections

6. Practice the entire conversation

7. Adjust the script so it sounds natural rather than memorized

8. Practice until I can deliver it confidently



## Experience I'm Looking For



You should have significant experience in one or more of the following:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* B2C sales

* Sales training

* Sales coaching

* Sales management

* SDR/BDR training

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Closing

* Objection handling

* Phone sales

* Sales role-playing

* Sales performance coaching



**Teaching/coaching ability is very important.**



Being a good salesperson alone is not enough. You need to be able to **teach another person how to sell.**



## Sample Video — VERY IMPORTANT



If you have a video showing yourself doing any of the following, please send it with your application:



* Sales coaching

* Cold-call training

* Role-playing a sales call

* Teaching someone how to sell

* Demonstrating a cold call

* Handling objections

* Training salespeople



It does **not** have to be a professionally produced video.



I mainly want to see **how you actually teach and coach.**



If you don't have an existing video, you may record a short sample explaining how you would coach someone through a cold call.



## Please Include Your Desired Rate



Please tell me **how much you are asking per hour** for this type of one-on-one coaching.



Do not simply write "negotiable."



Please provide your actual requested hourly rate.



## Please Answer These Questions



1. How many years of sales experience do you have?

2. How many years of sales training/coaching experience do you have?

3. Have you personally trained people to cold call?

4. Have you done live sales role-play with students or salespeople?

5. What types of products/services have you sold?

6. What type of sales were you involved in — B2B, B2C, high-ticket, appointment setting, closing, etc.?

7. How do you normally structure a one-on-one sales coaching session?

8. How do you teach someone to sound more confident on the phone?

9. How do you teach objection handling?

10. Are you comfortable challenging the student rather than simply giving encouragement?

11. Do you have a sample video? **Please provide the link.**

12. What is your desired hourly rate?



## Top 3 Skills



Please make sure your profile/application highlights these three skills:



**1. Cold Calling & Sales Training**



**2. Sales Role-Play & Objection Handling**



**3. Sales Pitch, Confidence & Communication Coaching**



I am looking for someone interested in **ongoing one-on-one coaching**, not just a one-time session.



Please apply with your experience, sample video if available, and desired hourly rate.

title: Marketing Data & Analytics Lead
description:
Marketing Data & Analytics Lead 



Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Full-Time | Long-Term

Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time, 8:00 - 5:00 PM EST



About the Opportunity:



Do you love turning complex data into clear, meaningful insights? Are you the kind of person who enjoys figuring out why numbers don't match, building dashboards that make people's lives easier, and finding smarter ways to work?



We're looking for a Reporting & Analytics Lead to join a growing U.S.-based media and advertising company.



In this role, you'll work with advertising data from platforms like Google Ads, Meta, and other digital media channels, helping ensure that client reporting is accurate, connected, and easy to understand.



You'll collaborate with data engineering, analytics, and client services teams while taking ownership of reporting processes, data integrations, and performance insights.



If you're analytical, organized, comfortable speaking with clients, and excited about using AI to work smarter, we'd love to meet you!



What You'll Be Doing:

- Connect and manage client data: Help onboard new clients by connecting advertising and analytics platforms through tools like Improvado, Supermetrics, or similar solutions.

- Keep data accurate: Investigate reporting discrepancies, validate numbers across platforms, and troubleshoot data issues.

- Build dashboards and reports: Create clear, useful dashboards that help teams and clients understand campaign performance.

- Analyze advertising performance: Review campaign spend, pacing, conversions, and other key metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and potential issues.

- Use SQL and AI tools: Query data, investigate issues, and use tools like Claude to improve reporting, analysis, and workflows.

- Own reporting documentation: Maintain client KPIs, data definitions, reporting standards, and onboarding progress.

- Collaborate with clients and teammates: Participate in client meetings, explain findings, ask thoughtful questions, and help teams make better data-driven decisions.

- Improve reporting processes: Help transition existing reporting into newer systems and find opportunities to make reporting more efficient and reliable.



What We're Looking For:

- Approximately 4–7 years of professional experience in data analytics, marketing analytics, business intelligence, or advertising reporting.

- Strong hands-on SQL skills, including the ability to query data and investigate discrepancies independently.

- Experience analyzing digital advertising performance, with an understanding of platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, and common media metrics.

- Experience using reporting, dashboarding, or data integration platforms such as Supermetrics, Funnel, Fivetran, Tableau, - - - Looker, Power BI, or similar tools.

- A solid understanding of how data moves between platforms, including API-based integrations and data validation.

- Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to support analysis, reporting, or workflow improvements.

- Strong English communication skills and confidence participating in meetings with U.S.-based clients.

- Excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to independently follow through on problems until they're resolved.

- A proactive mindset—you enjoy asking questions, sharing ideas, and speaking up when something doesn't look right.



A Few Extras That Would Be Great:

Experience with Improvado, Python, AWS, programmatic advertising, connected TV (CTV), linear TV, or marketing measurement techniques would be helpful, but none of these are required.



We're more interested in finding someone with strong analytical skills, solid digital media knowledge, and the curiosity to learn new tools.



What Makes This Opportunity Exciting?

You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership of reporting and analytics for a U.S.-based media company, work closely with experienced technical and client-facing teams, and help shape how data and AI are used across the business.



This isn't a role where you'll simply generate reports and wait for instructions. Your insights, recommendations, and problem-solving skills will make a real difference.



How to Apply: Follow this link: 



Please submit your updated resume along with a short video (approximately 2 minutes) introducing yourself and answering these questions:

- Tell us about your experience with SQL, reporting dashboards, and connecting data from different platforms.

- Share an example of a time you discovered a reporting discrepancy or data issue. How did you investigate and resolve it?

- What experience do you have analyzing digital advertising performance, and how have you used AI tools to improve your work?



We're excited to learn more about you!

• Timely and trending: game-day and playoff posts, holiday videos, and trend-based formats



One interview often becomes two long-form videos and a set of shorts. You will be expected to find those angles yourself.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Editing and Creative

• Edit vertical shorts (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and horizontal long-form (YouTube) to platform specs

• Write and place strong hooks in the first 2 to 3 seconds; add accurate, on-brand captions and text overlays

• Color correct footage so interiors, exteriors, and lighting look natural and consistent across clips

• Mix audio cleanly: balanced music, no clipping, speaker always clear

• Match the Q&U look: black-and-white editorial branding, one consistent modern font, and a refined luxury feel

• Pitch ideas based on what is performing, rather than waiting for every brief



AI Tools, With Accuracy

• Use AI tools for virtual staging, photo-to-video, cleanup, and B-roll generation

• Check every AI output against the real listing photos before submitting. No added doors, rooms, or features, and no altered finishes. Listing content must represent the property accurately.



Process and Communication

• Work from the production queue in Notion: check the brief, update status, and add approved video links

• Post drafts in Slack with the video title, and turn around revision notes quickly

• Flag blockers early (missing footage, unclear brief, a deadline at risk) instead of going quiet

• Keep footage, project files, and exports organized in Google Drive so any video can be revised later

• Report weekly output (long-form and shorts completed) every Monday



OUTPUT AND TURNAROUND



Deadlines are firm. A listing video that misses its go-live date loses most of its value.



• Weekly output: 10+ finished videos per week, a mix of long-form and shorts from new footage and backlog clips

• Timely posts (game days, breaking market news): same business day

• New listing videos: first draft within 1 business day of receiving footage or photos

• Interview footage: first long-form and shorts within 3 business days

• Revisions: within 24 hours, or same day when flagged urgent

• Status updates: same day when asked, and proactively if a deadline is at risk



REQUIREMENTS



• 2+ years editing social-first video, with a portfolio of Reels or TikToks that show strong hooks, pacing, and captions

• Real estate, luxury, or lifestyle brand experience

• Proficiency in a professional editor (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro) plus color correction skills

• Hands-on experience with AI video and image tools for staging, photo-to-video, or cleanup, and the judgment to spot when AI gets it wrong

• A proven record of meeting deadlines at volume

• Clear, responsive written communication in Slack

• Reliable internet and backup power, and availability from 9am-5pm EST, Monday through Friday



NICE TO HAVE



• Motion graphics and animated text (After Effects or similar)

• Canva for simple graphics and thumbnails

• Ability to repurpose one recording into a full set of long-form and short-form cuts

• A feel for trending audio and formats on Instagram and TikTok



ROLE DETAILS



Location: Remote

Type: Full-time 

Reports to: Marketing Manager

Compensation: $800

Tools: Slack, Notion, Google Drive, Riverside, Canva, AI video tools, and a professional video editing software



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. A portfolio with at least 3 short-form videos and 1 long-form video

2. One example of AI-assisted real estate or interior content, with the original source photos

3. A short note on how you manage deadlines when several projects land at once



Finalists complete a paid test edit: one listing walkthrough short with a 24-hour turnaround, plus one round of revisions. We review it for hook, pacing, brand fit, listing accuracy, and how well you communicate along the way.

title: Web Designer & WordPress Developer
description:
We are seeking a motivated and talented Web Designer & WordPress Developer with hands-on experience in WordPress, particularly Elementor, to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for website design and development, a strong foundation in HTML and CSS, an eye for design, and a desire to learn and grow in a collaborative environment.



You will work closely with our experienced design and development team to create, customize, and maintain visually appealing, user-friendly, and SEO-friendly websites for clients across different industries.



Responsibilities

Design and Mockups:



Create website layouts and mockups in Figma that align with project goals and client requirements.



Collaborate with the team to refine designs before moving into WordPress development.



Coding and Development:



Build and customize websites primarily using WordPress and Elementor.



Use HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript to customize website layouts and functionality.



Work with Divi and other WordPress page builders when required.



Testing and Debugging:



Conduct thorough testing to identify and fix bugs, ensuring website functionality.



Ensure websites are responsive and work properly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.



Assist in troubleshooting and resolving issues with WordPress themes and plugins.



WordPress Expertise:



Demonstrate hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor to create visually appealing and user-friendly websites.



Customize WordPress themes, page layouts, headers, footers, and website elements to meet project requirements.



Follow website development best practices to ensure performance, usability, and consistency.



Basic SEO and Website Optimization:



Understand and implement basic on-page SEO practices, including proper heading structure, meta titles, meta descriptions, image alt text, and SEO-friendly URLs.



Understand technical SEO fundamentals, including website structure, internal linking, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and indexing basics.



Ensure websites are built with a proper SEO foundation and follow SEO-friendly development practices.



Collaboration:



Work closely with cross-functional teams, including designers and project managers, to understand project requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.



Participate in team discussions and contribute ideas to improve website design and functionality.



Learning and Growth:



Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in website design and development, particularly within the WordPress ecosystem.



Proactively seek opportunities to expand skills and knowledge through training and self-directed learning.



Project Management:



Assist with project planning and estimation of development tasks.



Manage time effectively, handle multiple assignments, and meet project deadlines.



Qualifications

Associate degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).



Hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor.



Experience using Figma for website layouts and mockups.



Good understanding of HTML and CSS, with basic knowledge of JavaScript.



Familiarity with Divi and other WordPress page builders is an advantage.



Good understanding of responsive web design principles.



Basic knowledge of on-page SEO and technical SEO fundamentals.



Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and willingness to learn.



Portfolio

Applicants are encouraged to provide a portfolio showcasing their previous website design and development projects, especially those involving WordPress, Elementor, and Figma. Personal, freelance, and academic projects are also welcome.



Technical Assessment

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a live technical assessment as part of the hiring process. The assessment will include practical tasks related to Figma, WordPress, Elementor, HTML, CSS, and responsive website development.



Work Hours and Employee Time Tracking

We use Apploye for employee time tracking and productivity monitoring. Employees are required to use Apploye during working hours to record work time and track project activities. Applicants should be comfortable using this application as part of our standard work process.



Apply Now

If you are passionate about website design and development and enjoy building modern, user-friendly, and SEO-friendly websites using WordPress and Elementor, we invite you to apply. Join us in building high-quality websites and contributing to exciting projects. We value creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning.

title: Senior Digital Marketer
description:
<aside>

📝



**Before posting (internal):** This ad is ready to post. The body below is plain text so you can copy paste it into OnlineJobs.ph. Do not copy this note. Attention check:
s that do not end with Wolfpack are screened out. Applications go to 
 and 
 and must use the subject line own the question. Round one asks only for a CV, a 60 to 90 second video, and city plus Sydney overlap hours. Contract, not employee, for the trial. If converted to employment in the Philippines later, 13th month pay is mandatory and leave and public holidays need setting.



Post first on OnlineJobs.ph. Then LinkedIn and JobStreet, with location set to the Philippines. Do not post on Seek.



Round two brief for shortlist: a gardening brand has a tool that answers customer questions on Instagram and their website. When their posts stop, conversations drop by 80% within a week. Give us your two week plan to get them back up: channels, content, links, and how you would report it.



</aside>



---



We're hiring a senior digital marketer to grow Digital Experts and keep our clients in market. You'll also lead digital marketing for Nice Wolf clients.



Nice Wolf is an Australian creative studio. Digital Experts is the product we own. It turns what an organisation already knows into answers that show up on websites, on socials and in the real world. When a client stays in market, people use it. When the posts stop, conversations fall away within days. You will own both sides of that: the client work that keeps every expert visible, and the LinkedIn, search and
 work that brings in the next clients.



You will work directly with the founders, and brief and lead our project and marketing manager and designers on content. The role is hands on, senior and judged on results, not on busyness.



Who we are

Nice Wolf is a boutique creative and strategy studio in Australia and the employer for this role. We do brand strategy, identity, content systems and art direction for organisations that have a marketing lead and more work than hands. Our founders come from agencies like M&C Saatchi and Clemenger BBDO.



Digital Experts is our software product and it's the new discovery channel. A lot of your work will be here. We take what an organisation knows and turn it into knowledge areas that answer customer questions in the organisation's own words. Those answers show up on websites and socials, and in the real world through QR codes. Our clients include universities, hotels, councils, environmental groups, consumer brands and a commercial property agency in Paris.



The product works in four steps: 1. Know, 2. Deploy, 3. Answer, 4. Learn. Then it repeats.



Why this is a marketing role

The platform is easy to set up. What makes or breaks a client is marketing: consistent content, smart ads, the right links in the right places, and reporting that shows what's working.



You'll work closely with our clients, so outstanding communication and organisation matter just as much as your campaign skills.



Our success has two layers. First, our clients need to use Digital Experts well. Then their customers, students, guests and communities need to find it and ask it questions. You'll own both.



Three things we won't compromise on



1. You're proactive.

This is the big one. You see the dip before the client does. You never miss a scheduled post, and if something slips you flag it before anyone asks. You will uncover insights and turn them into creative briefs and opportunities. You'll be obsessed with experimenting and testing to find the ideas that cut through the noise. You notice a client has gone quiet and you act. If you're waiting for instructions, this isn't the role for you.

2. Your English is excellent.

Written and spoken. You'll be the voice of our business to clients across Australia, Europe and beyond, so every
, report, caption and call needs to be clear, warm and confident.

3. Your attention to detail is exceptional.

You check the numbers before a report goes out. You catch the typo, the broken link, the wrong date and the post that went out on the wrong channel. In a product built on accurate answers, almost right isn't good enough.



What you'll do

Keep every client expert in market, and prove it



- Plan and run the content and campaigns that keep each client's expert visible across their channels, including newsletters, socials, websites,
 signatures and QR codes in the real world

- Run paid social within agreed budgets, and recommend when to spend more

- Show, with tracked links and clear monthly reporting, which placements start conversations and which go quiet

- Turn the questions people ask into insights, content ideas and campaign hooks, and help clients use that data to make better decisions



Grow Digital Experts



- Build and run the product's own pipeline through LinkedIn, search, blogs and our fortnightly
 programme

- Turn real client usage into case studies and proof points

- Create simple launch kits so clients' own teams can promote their expert with confidence



Own the client relationship



- Help onboard new Digital Experts clients, especially how and where they'll launch

- Be the calm, organised voice clients hear from every week

- Chase approvals and answers early, so deadlines never sneak up

- Spot clients who are going quiet and bring them back before they drift

- Pass product feedback to our team, with clear examples



Brief and lead our team



- Work hand in hand with our project and marketing manager to plan and schedule content across clients

- Write clear, sharp briefs for our designers and follow them through to on time, on brand work

- Review creative before it goes out and give feedback that makes it better

- Keep the content pipeline moving so nothing waits on you



Deliver Nice Wolf client briefs



- Take on digital marketing briefs from Nice Wolf clients, from social and paid campaigns to
 and content plans

- Turn a brief into a clear plan, timeline and team brief

- Report results back to the client in plain language



How we work

This is not a traditional role. You will work alongside AI agents that handle routine work such as inbox triage, draft replies, conversation reviews, report drafts and CRM updates, all from our operating system in Notion. That frees you to make the judgment calls, approve what goes out, build real relationships, run the campaigns that move adoption, and own the outcome.



You will review and approve drafts before they reach a client, improve the instructions when something is off, and help us d
 what can safely run on its own.



If you like working this way, and want to make it better, you'll thrive here.



You'll also bring



- 5+ years in digital marketing, ideally agency side or at a SaaS company, with real client facing experience

- Hands on experience running social calendars and paid social campaigns on Meta, and ideally TikTok and LinkedIn

- Confidence with the platforms themselves: how to drive people to a link, when to use comments, stories or tracked bio links, and how to get an expert into a client's own channels

- Confidence with Google Analytics and platform reporting, and the ability to find the story in the numbers and explain it in two sentences

- Working knowledge of SEO basics

- Experience briefing designers and content creators, and managing work through to delivery

- A track record of owning client relationships end to end, without someone checking your work

- Comfort working with AI tools in your daily work, and curiosity about getting more from them

- The ability to manage several clients at once without anyone feeling second priority

- Hours that overlap with Sydney weekdays. If you have read this far, end your
 with the word Wolfpack.



Bonus points



- Experience with Notion, Claude, Grok or other AI tools, and ManyChat or similar social automation

- Experience building knowledge bases, help centre content or agent instructions

- Experience with Slack, Google Workspace or a CRM



What we offer



- Full time contract, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, AUD 3,000 to 3,500 a month depending on skill, paid monthly

- Fully remote, offshore, in the Philippines or a similar timezone, with at least four of those hours overlapping Sydney, ideally from 10am Sydney time

- Starts as a three month trial contract, with longer term terms agreed after the trial

- Direct work with the founders, and close work with our project and marketing manager and design team. No layers, no politics

- Exposure to a growing software product and real brand and creative work



How to apply

 
 and 
 with the subject line "own the question". If the subject line is missing, we will not review it.



Include all of the following:



1. Your CV, attached or linked.

2. A Loom (or similar) link to a 60 to 90 second video of you talking to camera. Walk us through one campaign you ran. Cover the goal, what you did and the result. We want to hear how you think and how you communicate.

3. The city you work from and the hours you can overlap with Sydney each weekday.



Shortlisted applicants will be sent a short practical brief.



We read every complete application. Short and specific beats long and generic. We will notice the details.



For more about us: www.nicewolf.co and

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
EDUSFERE

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

K–12 Independent Schools  |  Work From Home (Philippines-Based)  |  Full-Time Hours | US School Hours



About the Role



Edusfere is a B2B SaaS edtech company that offers cutting-edge curriculum mapping software for K–12 schools. We are looking for a driven and articulate Sales Development Representative to work with our team as an independent contractor, engaged directly by Edusfere (no agency). In this role, you will be the first point of contact for independent K–12 schools primarily in the United States, plus selected international markets, generating qualified pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting and inbound lead management.



The ideal candidate brings B2B sales experience in SaaS or edtech, and direct experience in education, either as a former teacher, school administrator, or someone who has sold products and services into K–12 schools. You understand the language of educators, the rhythms of the school year, and how purchase decisions are made at independent schools. This domain expertise, paired with strong sales acumen and clear, confident English, will set you apart.



Key Responsibilities



* Outbound prospecting: Research target schools and contact school leaders (Heads of School, Principals, Directors of Learning) by phone,
, and LinkedIn, using lead lists and outreach campaigns we provide, to generate qualified demos.

Inbound lead management: Respond to and qualify inbound leads in a timely manner; assess fit, educate prospects on Edusfere’s value proposition, and book qualified demos with our sales lead.

* Book demos: Qualify interest and book qualified demos with our sales lead. After approval, run demos and sales conversations through to signed contracts.

* Callbacks and inquiries: Respond promptly to schools that call back or reply.

* CRM: Log every call, note, and outcome in HubSpot the same day.

* Feedback: Share what you hear from schools each week so we can improve our pitch and targeting.

* Market intelligence: Stay current on trends in independent school education, edtech adoption, and competitive landscape to refine messaging and targeting.



Required Qualifications



* 2+ years of experience in a sales, business development, or SDR role with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota.

* Native or near-native English proficiency with excellent written and verbal communication skills—you must be able to hold natural, confident conversations with US-based school leaders.

* Proficiency with CRM tools (HubSpot or similar).

* Available about 8 hours a day, Monday–Friday, on a schedule you set within US school hours (8:00 AM Eastern to 5:00 PM Pacific, roughly 9:00 PM–9:00 AM PHT).

* Work-from-home setup: reliable internet of at least 25 Mbps, backup internet (e.g. mobile data or pocket Wi-Fi) and backup power, a noise-cancelling headset, a webcam, a mobile phone, a quiet workspace, and a laptop or desktop in good working condition with a secure operating system and antivirus.

* Registered, or willing to register, with the BIR as self-employed.



Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience in the K–12 education sector: prior work as a classroom teacher, school administrator, admissions officer, or in an education-focused sales role.

* Experience selling into schools, school districts, or education institutions (independent, private, or international schools preferred).

* Familiarity with international school markets (Asia, Middle East, Latin America, Europe).

* Background in edtech, SaaS, or education services sales.

* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Communications, or a related field.



What Success Looks Like



* After ramp-up, consistently booking 15–20+ qualified demos per month with school decision-makers (Heads of School, Directors of Learning, Directors of Curriculum, or similar titles).

* Building a healthy pipeline of opportunities across US independent schools, plus selected international markets.

* Becoming a trusted first impression of Edusfere—school leaders feel they are speaking with someone who genuinely understands their world.

* Contributing insights from the front lines that improve Edusfere’s messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy.



Fees & Incentives



* Monthly fee: ₱45,000–65,000, depending on experience.

* Uncapped incentive pay: Under our current Sales Incentive Plan, a bonus for every qualified demo held, plus commission on deals that close.

* Training: Paid onboarding on our product, the US school market, and our sales process.

* Growth: A path to closing deals yourself at a higher commission rate, and into a senior sales role as Edusfere scales.

* Work from home: Fully remote; no commute.

* Collaborative, mission-driven team culture focused on transforming K–12 education.



How to Apply



If you are passionate about education and thrive in a fast-paced sales environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit:

* Your resume.

* A brief cover note explaining your B2B sales experience, any connection to education, and why this role interests you.

* A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself in English.

* A screenshot of a recent internet speed test.



Engagement type: This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. The selected candidate will provide services under an Independent Contractor Agreement with Edusfere, LLC, a US company, and will not be an employee of Edusfere or of any Philippine entity. You will set your own schedule within US school hours and decide how and where you perform the work. As an independent contractor, you will be responsible for your own taxes and BIR registration, government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), equipment, internet, and workspace. You will not be entitled to employee benefits such as leave, 13th-month pay, overtime, holiday pay, or night-shift differential. Fees are paid monthly in Philippine pesos against your invoice. You may provide services to other clients, provided there is no conflict of interest.



Edusfere welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and is committed to equal opportunity.

title: YouTube Video Editor: Vlogs & Talking Head Videos
description:
We’re looking for a reliable, talented video editor to help bring our vlogs and talking head videos to life. We create content about love, relationships, purpose, kindness, generosity, and living a meaningful life. We also work on humanitarian projects that bring clean water to communities around the world.



Editing speed and the ability to learn our style are key to this role. We have an established editing style, and your initial priority will be to study our videos and follow it closely. We’re looking for someone who can pick up our preferences, apply feedback consistently, and edit efficiently while maintaining quality and attention to detail. 



You’ll help us work toward publishing 2–3 YouTube videos per week, plus reels, so reliable turnaround times and clear communication are essential. As you become familiar with our content, there will be room to contribute your own creative ideas. We're looking for someone excited to grow a thriving Youtube Channel and make the content better and better. We’re looking for someone who wants to grow, is hungry to learn, passionate about video content and considers themselves an essential part of our team.



What we’re looking for:



- Experience editing YouTube vlogs and talking head videos.

- Efficient editing skills and the ability to keep multiple videos moving through production.

- Ability to study reference videos, match our established style, and carry feedback into future edits.

- Strong storytelling instincts, pacing, and the ability to shape raw footage into a clear, compelling story while preserving our natural personalities and voice.

- Clean audio, consistent colour, and thoughtful use of music, B-roll, and on-screen text.

- Excellent attention to detail, clear communication, and openness to feedback.

- A reliable computer and internet connection capable of handling large 4K video files.

- Familiarity with AI is a huge asset. We want you to use AI for anything you can get done faster.

- A strong sense of what makes video content "tick", for both Youtube and Reels/Shorts

- Strong organization and project management skills to make sure our content production system and footage stays organized

Editing reels and YouTube Shorts.

Animation, Motion Graphics

Creating YouTube thumbnails and descriptions

Writing compelling YouTube titles and testing A/B titles or thumbnails.

YouTube channel management and strategy

Cinematography and visual eye

Social Media Management

Photo Editing



Hours and compensation:

Starting at approx. 15 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow. 



Our goal is to publish 2–3 Youtube videos weekly, plus reels.  Some edits are relatively simple, others may require more detail.  We’ll establish realistic editing hours and turnaround times based on the footage and complexity of each video, but we want someone who enjoys getting a timely edit done fast and published.

We look forward to seeing your application!

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer + AI Creative (Higgsfield) - UK/US Lead Gen Agency
description:
META ADS MEDIA BUYER + AI CREATIVE (HIGGSFIELD) | UK & US AGENCY | PERFORM WELL, GET PAID WELL

Full time | USD 700-1,000/month base + uncapped performance bonuses | Remote | Long-term



READ THIS FIRST

This is not a fixed-salary job where doing more gets you nothing. Your base pay is only the starting point. Every client you keep, every result you deliver and every extra skill you bring adds money to your monthly pay. Our best people should earn far more than the base.



WHO WE ARE

PipelineX is a UK lead generation agency for construction and home improvement businesses in the UK and the US: driveways, paving, roofing, landscaping, plumbing and heating. We run Meta ads that bring our clients serious enquiries for high-value jobs, and we track every lead in GoHighLevel.



We are growing fast and need one person to own fulfilment: making the ads AND running them.



HOW YOU GET PAID MORE

1. CLIENT RETENTION BONUS: +USD 30 every month for every client you manage who has stayed with us 90+ days. Keep 10 clients happy = +USD 300/month on top of your base.

2. RESULTS BONUS: +USD 150 every month all your clients hit their cost-per-lead target.

3. LAUNCH BONUS: +USD 25 for every new client whose ads go live within 5 working days.

4. EXTRA SKILLS = EXTRA PAY: +USD 100 to 300/month for each extra service you run for our clients, such as SEO, Google Ads, landing pages/funnels or GoHighLevel automations.

5. PAY REVIEWS EVERY 90 DAYS: consistent performers get a raise to their base. Top performers can realistically earn USD 1,500-2,000+/month.

6. GROWTH: as we add clients, our best performer leads the next media buyers we hire.



THE ROLE

You will create AI video and image ads in Higgsfield, launch them on Meta, and manage the campaigns until they produce leads at the right cost. You own the full loop: creative, launch, optimisation and reporting.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Create scroll-stopping AI ads in Higgsfield (video and static) for construction businesses: before/after transformations, job showcases, offers and seasonal promotions

- Write ad copy and hooks for UK and US homeowners

- Build and launch Meta campaigns 
 and Instagram) with lead forms and landing pages

- Manage budgets, audiences and creative testing across several client accounts at once

- Watch cost per lead and lead quality every day, and fix problems before anyone asks

- Refresh creatives before they fatigue: new angles every week

- Check every lead lands in GoHighLevel

- Send a short daily update and a weekly results report per client



YOU MUST HAVE (we test all of this)

- 1+ year running Meta ads yourself, with results you can show (not boosting posts)

- LEAD GENERATION experience: service businesses, local businesses or B2B. You know the difference between cheap leads and good leads

- AI ad creative you have made: Higgsfield preferred. If you have used a similar AI video tool and can learn Higgsfield fast, still apply

- Strong written English: you will write ad copy for UK and US audiences

- Reliable internet with a backup, and a quiet place to work

- Available 4pm-1am Manila time, Monday to Friday



BONUS POINTS (each one can mean more pay)

- Construction, home improvement or trades clients

- SEO, Google Ads, landing pages/funnels

- GoHighLevel experience

- Video editing (CapCut, Premiere)

- UK or US clients



HOW WE HIRE (so you know what to expect)

1. Application review

2. One interview where we test your Higgsfield and Meta ads skills live, including a real ad account

3. 30-day paid trial, then a permanent role

Every applicant who follows the steps below gets a reply.



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application that follows these steps. Applications that skip a step are not reviewed.

1. Start your message with the words: TRADES LEADS

2. Send 2-3 AI ads you created (Higgsfield or similar): links or files

3. Send a screenshot of a Meta ads account you managed showing spend, leads and cost per lead (blur client names)

4. Answer in 2-3 sentences each:

   a) What is the biggest difference between running lead generation ads and e-commerce ads?

   b) A client gets plenty of leads but says none of them are serious. What do you check and change?

   c) What is the highest monthly ad spend you have managed, and what was the cost per lead?

5. Tell us which extra skills you have (SEO, Google Ads, funnels, GoHighLevel, editing)

6. Your expected monthly base salary in USD

7. A 3-5 minute Loom video (REQUIRED - no Loom, no review): introduce yourself on camera, then share your screen and walk us through a Meta campaign you ran (the structure, what you tested and the result) and one ad you made in Higgsfield

We’re looking for a full-time salesperson to sell lessons and sign-ups. You’ll be the front line to make sales over the phone to customers, all of whom are inbound warm leads (no cold calling). This is an entry-level position that is eligible for promotion after 12 months of tenure.





About Us



Started in 2017 and we're growing like crazy.

Growing FAST - We sold 2663 lessons in 2026 and we're on pace to sell 3328 lessons in 2027.

We sell manual transmission driving lessons in the United States. Yes, really.

100% inbound leads from Organic Search (SEO). We don’t do cold calling.

No competition - in 90% of the markets we serve, we have no competitors. Because of this, our sale is pretty easy to make.





Compensation and Benefits

Competitive compensation package - $5 per hour

Health Insurance

Paid Two weeks off for Christmas Season



Type of Employment

Full Time

40 hours per week





Entry Level Details

Note that this is an entry-level job.

We do NOT expect you to have any prior sales experience.

If you’re looking to switch careers and get your foot in the door, this could be great for you.

We will train you on how to take customers through the sales process.

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Customer Service, Nursing, Nurse Practitioners, Hotel and Hospitality, Front Desk, Secretary, Retail, Receptionist, Recruiting, Teachers and anyone with teaching experience, Tutoring, Inbound Representative, Inbound Sales, Outbound Caller, Appointment Setting, Cold and warm calling, Lead qualification





Duties and Responsibilities

Sell Stick Shift Driving Lessons

Inbound Call Handling - Answer phones and talk to prospects through the sale or sign up

Outbound Follow-Up - Call, text, and
 to get the prospect to the finish line

Qualify Prospects - Make sure their needs fit our model

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINK ELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Outbound Dialing - Dialing prospective customers and leaving voi
s.

Text Message and
 Handling - Quickly handle inbound text messages and
s that are sent to the salesperson.

Paperwork Follow-Up - Follow up with prospective customers who have not yet signed up to make sure they got the paperwork. Handle any issues they had with doing the paperwork.

Review Solicitation - Follow up with customers after the lesson to request a review on Google and Yelp

Edit customer records in our CRM (HubSpot)





Qualifications

At least three years of work experience, preferably interacting with people.

Must have your own computer, reliable high-speed internet, and good quality headset and microphone.

English Grammar and Language: You must be fluent in English

Strong Problem-Solving skills

Customer Service Oriented and ability to adapt/respond properly to different types of scenarios

Ability to Multitask, prioritize and manage time effectively





What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experienced with lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

www.stickshiftdrivingacademy [dot] com/work-opportunities/administration-agent

title: Operations & Supply Chain Support Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are a UK-based operations and supply chain consultancy supporting startup and challenger FMCG brands and manufacturers. We work closely with founders and their teams to establish practical, scalable ways of working — managing the operational detail required to keep products, information, and orders moving.



We’re looking for an organised, proactive, and commercially aware Operations & Supply Chain Support Specialist to work alongside our founder and support several client accounts. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role — you’ll be working across multiple businesses at different stages of growth, so managing changing priorities and communicating clearly is key.



Work Structure & Requirements



🏠 Location: Remote / Virtual

📅 Schedule: Part-time, 20 hours per week

🌏 Time Zone: UKT (UK Time)

💵 Compensation: $10 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



1. Order Management & Fulfilment



Process customer orders and maintain accurate sales order records

Coordinate order fulfilment with manufacturers, warehouses, and logistics providers

Prepare and check delivery notes, shipment information, and operational documentation

Track orders through to confirmed delivery and obtain proof of delivery where required

Support the management of returns, shortages, damages, and delivery discrepancies



2. Supply Chain & Production Coordination



Support day-to-day management of multiple client supply chains

Coordinate with suppliers, co-manufacturers, and external production partners

Monitor production schedules, manufacturing timelines, and material availability

Proactively chase outstanding actions and escalate potential delays or supply risks

Provide concise progress updates and flag decisions required from the team or client



3. Planning & Inventory



Support demand forecasting, production planning, and material requirements planning

Monitor inventory against forecast demand, lead times, shelf life, and stockholding targets

Identify potential shortages, excess stock, ageing inventory, and supply risks

Help maintain an accurate view of stock across manufacturers, warehouses, and other locations



4. Procurement & Purchasing



Prepare and issue purchase orders following required approvals

Monitor supplier acknowledgements, production commitments, and delivery schedules

Track inbound materials, packaging, and finished goods

Support supplier research, onboarding, and documentation

Maintain accurate purchasing records and follow up on discrepancies



5. Logistics & 3PL Coordination



Coordinate with third-party logistics providers, couriers, and warehouses

Monitor inbound and outbound shipments and communicate updates to stakeholders

Resolve delivery issues and follow them through to a clear conclusion

Ensure inventory movements and shipment statuses are accurately recorded

Support warehouse coordination, stock counts, and inventory reconciliation



6. Systems & Process Support



Maintain accurate records across spreadsheets, trackers, ERP, and inventory systems

Reconcile information between POs, production records, inventory reports, and delivery documentation

Investigate discrepancies, escalate risks promptly, and follow agreed actions to resolution

Help document and improve operational processes, trackers, and standard ways of working



Required Skills & Experience



⚠️ Supply Chain / Operations Experience: Minimum 2 years in supply chain, operations, procurement, production planning, inventory management, order processing, or logistics — required

⚠️ FMCG / Manufacturing Experience: Background in FMCG, manufacturing, or food and drink highly desirable

Spreadsheets: Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills — formulas, filtering, lookups, and data reconciliation

Systems: Confidence learning and working across multiple software platforms and client systems; ERP or inventory system experience advantageous

Organisation: Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple client accounts

Proactivity: Takes ownership of tasks and follows through without needing constant direction

Communication: Strong written and spoken English; confident communicating with clients, suppliers, and logistics partners



What Success Looks Like



Orders, POs, shipments, and operational records are accurate and up to date

Supply, production, or delivery issues are identified early and communicated clearly

Clients, suppliers, and logistics partners receive timely, professional communication

Agreed tasks are owned and completed without constant direction

Client systems provide a reliable view of current operational activity and outstanding actions

Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We're seeking a super smart, hungry, and resilient individual who is passionate about technology and healthcare to join us as a Program Manager. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and brings a strong organizational mindset to complex projects. You will be responsible for overseeing multiple complex programs across various departments to ensure successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget. This role requires a self-motivated individual who can work independently and adapt to the dynamic nature of a growing startup in the healthcare technology space.

- Impact the strategy and execution for AnsibleHealth's general operations, clinical operations, and technology initiatives, working closely with cross-functional teams.

- Define program scope, objectives, and success criteria in collaboration with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

- Establish program governance structures and processes, including risk management, issue management, and change management.

- Monitor and report on program progress, status, and performance to stakeholders and executive leadership.

- Ensure effective communication and alignment with stakeholders at all levels.

- Continuously identify and mitigate program risks and issues.

- Facilitate program-related meetings and workshops.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders to drive program success and identify growth opportunities.

- Bring a continuous improvement mindset to our operations to ensure we're ready to scale.

- Anticipate issues, propose solutions, manage dependencies, and identify areas for tool/process improvement.

- Collaborate with and steer internal teams, including Marketing, Engineering, Program Management, and Clinical Operations.



The ideal candidate should be comfortable to be in a constantly changing role with a high level of ambiguity - as we are a fast-moving startup operating in an ever-evolving environment. He or she should have excellent analytical, communication and management skills to succeed in this role.



Education

Bachelor's degree from one of the top five universities in the Philippines.



Required Qualifications and competencies

- Demonstrated passion for technology and ability to quickly adapt to new digital tools and platforms.

- Exceptional organizational skills.

- Resilient mindset with the ability to bounce back from challenges and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Keen interest in healthcare and improving patient outcomes; prior healthcare experience is a plus but not mandatory.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively.

- Enthusiasm for continuous learning and process improvement.



The ideal candidate is a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare. We're looking for someone who can bring fresh perspectives, adapt quickly to new challenges, and contribute to our innovative and fast-paced work environment.

The Role

title: Direct-Response Video Editor: UGC Ads for Meta (Hooks, Bodies, CTAs)
description:
About Qlayon

Qlayon is a Shopify brand selling travel comfort essentials. Our hero product is the Travel Rest, a sleep mask with head support that attaches to the plane seat. Our mission: help travelers arrive rested. We are a small team that values ownership, honest feedback and growing together.



The role

You will turn raw footage from our UGC creators into direct-response video ads for Meta 
 and Instagram), every week. We write most hooks, but we need an editor who understands why an ad sells and can write strong hooks too.



One concept = 3 different hooks + 1 shared body (with its CTA) = 3 finished ads. Only the opening changes, so we can test which hook wins.



What you will do

- Edit 15–45 second vertical ads from UGC creator footage.

- Build 3 hook variations per concept on the same body.

- Write and propose your own hooks, based on the angle of each ad.

- Keep a clear structure: hook, body, CTA, with captions, music and sound design.



This role is for you if

- You have 2+ years editing Meta ads for e-commerce or DTC brands.

- Your ads actually ran with ad spend, and you can show them.

- You have built multi-hook concepts: several openings on one body.

- You have edited raw UGC creator footage (talking head, product in use, testimonials).

- You write hooks yourself and can explain why one should work.

- You understand hook rate, hold rate and retention, and edit to improve them.

- You work in CapCut, Premiere Pro or After Effects.

- You communicate clearly in English and deliver on time.

- Bonus: you have edited TikTok Ads.



This role is NOT for you if

- Your experience is mostly YouTube, vlogs, weddings or corporate videos.

- You only do motion graphics or animation.

- You are just starting out in ad editing.

- You only fill AI templates and don't edit real footage.

- You are looking for hourly pay. This role is paid per concept.



How you get paid



Base pay: $10 per concept. Every new ad concept you deliver that we approve earns you $10. Each concept must come with at least 3 different hooks.



Bonuses for winning ads:

- +$50 when one of your concepts spends $1,000 on Meta and stays profitable (ROAS 2.0 or more) within its first 30 days.

- +$100 more if that same concept reaches $5,000 in spend and is still profitable within its first 60 days.

- +$500 more if that same concept reaches $100,000 in spend and is still profitable within its first 6 months.



So one concept can earn you up to $660 ($10 + $50 + $100 + $500).



Track your results in real time. You will get a link to our ad database. Every ad you make is named with your name, so you can see exactly how much each one has spent and how it performs. The data updates in real time, so you can refresh the page anytime to see the latest numbers.



Simple rules:

- A concept is a new idea, meaning a new angle or new script. Different versions of the same idea (hooks, music or formats) count as one concept, for the $10 and for the bonuses.

- No limit. If you make 3 winners in a month, you get 3 bonuses.

- We pay everything on the 1st of each month, based on the numbers in the database.



The better your ads perform, the more you earn. 🚀



How to apply (please follow every step)

Your application must include all six items below:

1. Keyword: include the word WINDOWSEAT anywhere in your application, so we know you read the full post.

2. Experience: how many years you have edited Meta ads, and for which kinds of brands.

3. Tools: the editing tools you use (for example CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects).

4. Ad links: 3–5 Meta ads you edited, including at least one concept with several hooks on the same body. Meta Ad Library links are a big plus. Say what you did on each ad.

5. Loom (2–3 minutes): break down one of your ads: the hook, the body, the CTA, and why it works.

6. 3 hook ideas for our Travel Rest (you can find it on our website), one line each.



Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. We look forward to seeing your work!

title: Senior Digital Marketer – Take Full Ownership of Our Marketing
description:
About Nexus 360



Nexus 360 is a UK business growth partner for established SMEs, typically owner-led companies with 5 to 100 staff that want to grow but are held back by manual processes and knowledge that lives in people’s heads. Our founder spent over 25 years delivering technology programmes for organisations such as RBS, Direct Line Group, Greencore and Thomas Cook. He now brings that experience to business owners through our Memory to System Method, where we design and build the CRM, client portals and integrations that let a business run on systems, then stay alongside the owner as a long-term partner.



The Role in One Sentence



As our Senior Digital Marketer, you’ll take full ownership of Nexus 360’s marketing, with one clear goal: filling our diary with discovery calls from the right business owners.



What We Need From You



We already have a lot in place, including our GoHighLevel setup, a website, LinkedIn profiles, client testimonials and content to build on. What we need now is a senior marketer who can take charge of all of it from day one. You’ll work out what’s working, fix what isn’t and push it further, so that qualified business owners are booking discovery calls with us. You’ll set the direction, make the decisions and be accountable for the results.



What You’ll Own



Marketing strategy: You’ll set our marketing direction, d
 where we show up, what we say and how prospects move from first contact to a booked call, then refine it based on results.

LinkedIn: You’ll lead the founder’s personal brand and the company page, turning client projects, testimonials and decades of delivery experience into content that attracts business owners and starts conversations.

Lead nurture and conversion: You’ll own the
 campaigns, newsletters, follow-up sequences and booking journeys in GoHighLevel that turn interest into appointments.

Website and SEO: You’ll take responsibility for making sure the website converts visitors and gets found by UK business owners looking for help.

Performance and reporting: You’ll track leads, calls booked and return on effort, and share a short weekly update so decisions are based on numbers.



As the business grows, this role will expand into leading marketing for our Growth Partner clients, with more hours and responsibility to match.



How You’ll Work With Us



This role is yours to own. You’ll be the person we rely on to know our business, our market and our numbers better than anyone, and you’ll lead the marketing without waiting for direction. Each week, you’ll tell us what’s happened, what results it produced, what you’re changing and why, so the founder always has a clear picture without having to ask. When a decision needs the founder’s input, you’ll bring a recommendation along with the question.



Who You Are



You’re an experienced digital marketer who has taken full ownership of marketing for a business before, ideally a B2B service business, and you can show the leads and appointments you generated. You think in terms of pipeline and results, you’re confident proposing ideas and challenging them, and you take responsibility when something needs fixing. You write clear, persuasive English for business owners, speak fluent English, and are highly capable in GoHighLevel, along with LinkedIn, WordPress, Canva and Google Analytics. You can also overlap some of your working hours with UK business hours. You’re used to being the person a business owner relies on for marketing, and you’d rather report results than ask what to do next.



What We Offer



A senior remote role starting at 20 hours per week, with a clear path to full-time

From $7 USD per hour, with more for the right experience, paid reliably through OnlineJobs.ph

A bonus for every qualified discovery call booked

Full ownership of our marketing, working directly with the founder, with your results clearly visible

The opportunity to lead marketing across multiple client industries as the role grows



How to Apply



Please begin your application with “Memory to System” and include:



A results example: a short case study of marketing you owned for a business, covering your strategy, the channels you used and the leads or appointments it produced, with numbers wherever possible.

Your first move: having looked at our website and LinkedIn, describe in a few paragraphs what you’d improve first to generate discovery calls, and why.

A GoHighLevel walkthrough: a short screen recording of a nurture sequence or booking journey you’ve built.

A short introduction video, with links to your portfolio and writing samples.

Your availability, in hours per week and the UK hours you can cover.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid trial task before any final decision.

title: Remote Claims Specialist
description:
# Claims Specialist (m/f/d) – Remote



**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Independent Contractor**



## Join IronMaxx – #BEcomeMAXX!



At IronMaxx, we're passionate about sports nutrition, performance, and growth. As an international sports nutrition brand based in Germany, our products reach customers through leading retailers, discounters, drugstores, and online marketplaces across Europe.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Claims Specialist (m/f/d) to strengthen our international Finance team.



Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and persistent when it comes to resolving financial discrepancies? Do you enjoy investigating complex cases, challenging unjustified deductions, and ensuring that every claim is properly resolved?



Then we want to hear from you!



## Your Mission



As our Claims Specialist, you will take ownership of customer claims and payment deductions, ensuring that every deduction is investigated, supported by evidence, and resolved efficiently.



Working closely with our Claims Manager in Germany, you'll play an important role in protecting our revenue, improving financial accuracy, and building efficient claims management processes.



## Your Responsibilities



- **Claims Management:** Record, investigate, and manage customer deductions, including delivery shortages, returns, pricing discrepancies, promotional charges, and delivery penalties.

- **Dispute Resolution:** Review claims against contractual agreements, invoices, and delivery documentation, challenging unjustified deductions with clear supporting evidence.

- **Accounts Receivable Reconciliation:** Match customer payments, deductions, and outstanding invoices using SAP Business One, ensuring accurate documentation and resolution.

- **Stakeholder Coordination:** Collaborate with Sales, Logistics, Accounting, external warehouses, carriers, and suppliers to obtain documentation and resolve discrepancies.

- **Recovery Management:** Identify financial losses caused by logistics partners or suppliers and support recovery claims.

- **Case Ownership:** Independently manage your claims portfolio, prioritise cases, meet deadlines, and ensure accurate tracking through to closure.

- **Reporting & Analysis:** Prepare regular claims reports, monitor outstanding cases, identify recurring issues, and recommend process improvements.

- **Month-End Support:** Assist with reconciliations and ensure claims-related adjustments are accurately reflected in financial records.



## What You Bring



- Professional experience in **claims management, customer deductions, accounts receivable, dispute resolution, or order-to-cash processes**.

- Ideally, experience in **FMCG, consumer goods, retail, e-commerce, or logistics**.

- A strong understanding of customer deductions, payment discrepancies, and invoice reconciliation.

- Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as **SAP Business One, SAP, NetSuite, or Microsoft Dynamics**.

- Strong **Excel skills**, including XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and working with large datasets.

- Excellent **English communication skills**, both written and spoken.

- An analytical, detail-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

- A proactive and persistent approach, with the ability to independently manage cases and follow them through to resolution.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams.



**Nice to Have:**

- Experience with Amazon Vendor Central, retailer supplier portals, or EDI processes.

- Familiarity with European retail customers and logistics documentation.

- Basic German language skills.

- A degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.



## What We Offer



- **100% Remote:** Work from your home office while collaborating with our team in Germany.

- **Long-Term Opportunity:** A full-time, long-term collaboration as an independent contractor.

- **International Environment:** Become part of a growing international sports nutrition brand.

- **Structured Onboarding:** Receive comprehensive training, clear procedures, and support from our experienced claims team.

- **Ownership & Impact:** Take responsibility for your own portfolio and actively contribute to improving our claims processes.

- **Growth & Development:** Be part of a growing Finance function with evolving processes, digital tools, and opportunities to contribute your ideas.

- **Collaborative Team:** Work closely with colleagues across Finance, Sales, and Logistics in an international environment.



## Key Details



- **Location:** 100% Remote (Home Office)

- **Employment Model:** Full-Time, Independent Contractor

- **Working Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM German time

- **Reporting Line:** Claims Manager, Germany

- **Start Date:** As soon as possible



## Ready to #BEcomeMAXX?



If you're passionate about accuracy, enjoy solving complex financial challenges, and want to make a measurable impact in a growing international company, we'd love to get to know you!



**Apply now and become part of the IronMaxx team!**

About Us:

Tameka Foster Raymond is a celebrity stylist, creative director, four-time published author and fashion influencer who has been in the business since 1994. She's also the founder of Eli Kish, a lifestyle brand of comfortable luxury clothing in silk, cotton-silk and linen, released as limited capsule collections. Body care and beauty are coming soon. We need a creative editor to keep Tameka's personal social media fresh and trendy, and to bring the Eli Kish brand to life on screen.



The Role:

We're looking for a video editor and content creator with a brilliant creative mind and serious editing skills. This is not a templates-and-trending-audio job. We want someone who can turn everyday footage into scroll-stopping content and knows how to make fashion move.



What You'll Create:



For Tameka's personal pages:



 • Look of the Day and outfit edits that feel modern and editorial

 • Travel content that turns trips into stylish, cinematic short edits

 • Personal style, behind-the-scenes and event appearance content

 • Trend-driven Reels and TikToks that keep her page current



For the Eli Kish brand:



 • Speed ramp edits where clips speed up, slow down and hit on the beat

 • Floating and levitation effects that make clothing and models look weightless

 • Outfit transitions where pieces "pop" from one model to the next

 • Digital runway shows edited to music so they feel like a real fashion show

 • Lookbooks, launch teasers, product content and pop-up event recaps



For both:



 • Motion graphics, animated text and 3D/VFX touches

 • Short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts



Responsibilities:



 • Edit footage Tameka sends from her travels, events and daily looks, often with a quick turnaround

 • Come up with concepts, storyboard and edit original content for each Eli Kish collection drop

 • Plan shots ahead of time so transitions and effects work, and suggest what to film

 • Pick music that matches the mood of each piece

 • Stay ahead of fashion, music and editing trends, and pitch fresh ideas without being asked

 • Keep each feed's look elevated and consistent

 • Deliver final edits formatted for each platform

 • Communicate on Zoom,
 and WhatsApp, and hit launch and posting deadlines



Requirements:



 • 3+ years of video editing experience (portfolio or reel required)

 • Advanced skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve and/or CapCut

 • Experience with speed ramping, masking, rotoscoping, motion tracking, keyframing, compositing and color grading

 • A great ear for music and editing on rhythm

 • A strong understanding of what performs on Instagram and TikTok right now

Nice to Have:



 • Experience editing for influencers, fashion, beauty, music videos or luxury brands

 • Blender or Cinema 4D skills

 • Basic social media management (captions, scheduling, trend research)

Send your portfolio or reel, links to 3 edits you're most proud of (at least one influencer or personal-brand edit), one quick idea for how you'd bring an Eli Kish piece to life on video, and your rates and availability. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to do a short paid test edit.
