title: AI Video Editor For 8 Figure E-commerce Brand
description:
The Role



We're looking for a DTC AI Video Editor with proven experience working with 7-, 8- or 9-figure e-commerce brands.



You need to understand direct response, not just editing.



Our creative strategists will provide the script, angle and brief — roughly 50% of the ad. Your job is to own the other 50%:



- Choose the strongest footage from our B-roll library.

- Identify where the concept needs stronger or more specific visuals.

- Generate new AI content when existing footage isn't good enough.

- Make every visual congruent with the script, hook and emotional beat.

- Edit for attention, clarity, retention and conversion.

- Proactively improve the visual concept rather than simply executing instructions.



The goal isn't to make videos that look good. The goal is to make ads that perform.



What You'll Own



You'll be responsible for producing a minimum of 12–15 finished concepts per week, with some concepts requiring original AI content generation.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form DTC direct-response ads across multiple formats.

- Translating scripts and briefs into strong visual narratives.

- Selecting B-roll based on the psychology and intent of each line.

- Generating missing visuals using AI rather than settling for weak footage.

- Creating high-quality AI UGC, animation and other AI-native creative formats.

- Using tools/models such as Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling to a professional standard.

- Building strong hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing and visual escalation.

- Maintaining script-to-visual congruence throughout every creative.

- Finding ways to increase viewer retention without distracting from the sales message.

- Bringing new visual ideas to the creative strategists.

- Learning from winning and losing ads and improving future execution accordingly.

- Taking ownership of the finished creative rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.



Who We're Looking For



Non-negotiables



- Proven video-editing experience with successful DTC/e-commerce brands, ideally at 7-, 8- or 9-figure scale.

- Strong knowledge of direct-response advertising fundamentals.

- A portfolio demonstrating performance-focused paid social creative — not only polished brand content.

- High-level AI content generation ability.

- Hands-on experience with modern AI video workflows, ideally including Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling.

- Ability to create convincing AI UGC, animation and other visual formats.

- Strong instinct for matching visuals to copy.

- Understanding of hooks, pacing, pattern interrupts, curiosity, emotion, proof and retention.

- Ability to work at volume without allowing quality to collapse.

- Comfortable receiving a brief and independently solving visual problems.



The mindset



We're looking for someone who is:



- Obsessed with getting better.

- Extremely motivated.

- Proactive rather than reactive.

- Comfortable taking ownership.

- Curious about why an ad works, not merely how it was edited.

- Hungry to become an elite direct-response marketer, not just an editor.

- Excited by a fast-moving environment where standards continue to rise.



If you need every visual decision mapped out for you before you can start editing, this isn't the right role.



What Great Looks Like



A great editor on our team doesn't read a line in a script and ask:



> "What clip should I put here?"

> 



They ask:



> "What does the viewer need to see here for this line to hit as hard as possible?"

> 



If the right clip exists in the B-roll folder, use it.



If it doesn't, create it.



If the brief can be made stronger visually, say so and improve it.



You should be thinking about:



- What stops the scroll?

- Does the first visual strengthen the hook?

- Is every shot supporting what the voiceover is saying?

- Where could attention drop?

- Can this claim be demonstrated instead of stated?

- Is there a stronger visual proof?

- Does the edit build desire, belief or curiosity with every beat?

- What could we generate that would make this concept substantially stronger?



AI Capability



AI generation is a core part of this role — not an optional extra.



You should be comfortable generating production-ready creative across formats such as:



- AI UGC

- Character-led scenes

- Product-integrated scenes

- Cinematic B-roll

- Animations

- Visual metaphors

- Scroll-stopping hook visuals

- Scenes that would be difficult or expensive to shoot traditionally



We want to see real examples of your AI work and understand which tools/models you used to produce them.



Output & Working Rhythm



- Minimum 12–15 concepts per week.

- Mix of traditional editing and AI-assisted/generated concepts.

- Fast iteration based on creative feedback and performance learnings.

- Consistent communication with our creative strategists.

- High standards for both speed and execution.



We care about output, but volume without quality is not the goal. We want someone capable of building a repeatable workflow that delivers both.



Growth Opportunity



This is intended to be a long-term position.



For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to grow into:



- Lead Video Editor, taking ownership of editing standards and potentially helping develop other editors.

- Creative Strategist, if you develop strong enough direct-response, research and concepting ability.



We'll actively coach and train you in direct response while you work with us. We want someone who wants to compound their skill set and become a significantly stronger marketer over time.



Team Environment



You'll be joining a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand with a highly driven team.



We're ambitious about where we're taking the brand, and creative is one of the most important growth levers in the business.



That means this role comes with real ownership and real expectations.



Only apply if you're genuinely excited by a fast-moving, high-performance environment and want to take responsibility for an area that directly impacts the growth of the company.



Application Process



Start your application with the word “STRATEGIST”



If your application doesn't begin with that word, we'll assume you haven't read the full brief.



Then include:



- A short introduction and the DTC brands you've worked with.

- Links to your 3–5 strongest direct-response ads.

- Links to your best AI-generated video work.

- The AI tools/models you currently use and what you use each for.

- A brief explanation of your goals/vision for role development over the next 1-2 years.

title: Clay Expert / GTM Engineer
description:
Ultra Labs is hiring a GTM Engineer to build and run the technical backbone of our revenue engine. You will own the automation, integrations and AI-powered systems behind our go-to-market motion, from first touch through closed-won.

This is a builder role. You will connect our CRM, enrichment platforms, AI orchestration layer and internal tools so every rep has the right data, the right intelligence and the right automation at every stage of the funnel.



Ultra Labs is a U.S.–based Business Incubator/Accelerator focused on software and tech-driven businesses.



What you'll do

• AI and MCP architecture. Design, build and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect LLMs to our CRM, project management, communication and data platforms. Own the LLM integration layer: prompt engineering, agent orchestration and tool-use patterns.

• Agentic workflows. Build AI agents that automate prospect research, account planning, competitive intelligence, deal analysis and personalized outreach. Own an agent-per-rep framework that multiplies each rep's capacity.

• CRM automation and intelligence. Design multi-step workflows for lead scoring, lifecycle stages, lead routing, deal stage automation and custom objects. Build CRM card extensions and AI-powered UI that surface insights inside the rep's workflow.

• Integration architecture. Own the connections across the revenue stack: CRM, enrichment, project management, contracts, billing, compensation and communication tools. Build and maintain APIs, webhook handlers and middleware that keep systems in sync.

• Enrichment pipelines. Build waterfall enrichment, ICP scoring models, credit governance and per-rep enrichment limits. Own the data flow from enrichment providers into the CRM for both high-touch and automated segments.

• Outbound infrastructure. Own SDR sequence architecture: deliverability, domain and sender rotation, A/B testing and performance monitoring. Make sure outbound scales with headcount without manual bottlenecks.

• Data quality and governance. Maintain deduplication rules, field mapping standards and data hygiene across [10,000+] accounts. Monitor provider reliability and manage failover between enrichment sources.

• Ship weekly, document everything. Release on a weekly sprint cadence with leadership demos before production. Every change ships with release notes, updated guidance and documentation.



What you'll need

• 3+ years in GTM Engineering, Revenue Systems, Marketing Ops Engineering or Sales Ops Engineering at a B2B SaaS company.

• Deep CRM expertise (HubSpot preferred; Salesforce welcome): workflows, custom objects, calculated properties, lead scoring, lifecycle management and API integrations.

• Hands-on experience with enrichment platforms (Clay preferred): waterfall logic, ICP list building, credit management and pipeline design.

• Production experience with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI or similar): prompt engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs and agentic workflow design.

• Working knowledge of MCP or similar tool-use frameworks, and the ability to build, deploy and maintain MCP servers.

• Comfort with middleware (n8n, Make, Zapier) and with writing JavaScript or Python to bridge systems directly through APIs.

• Experience owning the tooling stack for an outbound SDR team of 3 to 10+ reps.

• A track record of building GTM infrastructure from scratch at a scaling company, not only maintaining existing systems.

• A documentation-first mindset: release notes, runbooks and walkthrough recordings for everything you ship.



Nice to have

• Experience with sales engagement tools (Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo or Instantly) and
 deliverability tooling.

• Familiarity with data warehouses and reverse ETL (Snowflake, BigQuery, Hightouch or Census).

• Experience building internal tools or lightweight front ends for reps.

title: Finance & Executive Assistant (Accountant / Bookkeeper, Part-Time Sideline)
description:
Philippine Technical Labor & Infrastructure Group — Telecom, Power, Logistics



Location: Mostly online. Preference for candidates living in or near Taguig / Makati / Metro Manila or in Mindanao, for occasional meetings, bank and BIR errands, and notarization. Our office is in Taguig.



Role Purpose:

Finance first. Keep the books of a growing group of companies accurate, then act as the CEO's right hand so admin, follow-ups and records never fall behind. Ideal for a working accountant or bookkeeper who wants a sideline now and can grow into full-time.



Core Traits Required:

- Already an accountant or bookkeeper: you can do bank reconciliations and month-end on your own, without training

- Very good with numbers and details: you catch the one wrong digit and check before you send

- Diskarte with order: you start the slow steps first, ask for help early, and never let work sit still

- Trustworthy with confidential business and personal matters

- Clear in written English and Filipino



Core Responsibilities:

- Bookkeeping: entries, receipts and payments in Odoo; weekly bank and card reconciliations; month-end close

- Billing and collections, paying suppliers and subcontractors, payroll support

- Company papers: BIR, SEC, DOLE filings and permits with our CPA and Operations Manager

- CEO support: calendar, meeting notes, follow-ups with clients and contacts, bookings and logistics

- Board papers and minutes, shareholder updates and a short weekly report



Minimum Qualifications:

- Accountancy, Finance or related degree, or solid bookkeeping experience (CPA or CPA reviewee is a plus)

- Strong in Excel / Google Sheets; Odoo or another accounting system is a plus

- Shortlisted applicants take a short numbers and accuracy test



Work Arrangement:

- Starts part-time, about 20 hours a week, contractual

- First 3 months are a paid trial; the rate is reviewed after, with a path to full-time



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days:

- Bank and card accounts reconciled every week with no unexplained differences

- Month-end numbers ready on time without being chased

- The CEO's open admin tasks shrinking week by week, nothing late

title: Inbound Sales Representative – Aggregates (US Market)
description:
We are looking for a reliable and resourceful Inbound Sales Representative to manage customer orders for a US-based aggregates business.



We sell aggregates and landscaping materials to homeowners and small contractors across the United States. Customers place and pay for their orders through our website. Your role is to ensure each order is properly coordinated, from understanding the customer's requirements and sourcing local suppliers to negotiating prices and overseeing delivery.



You will work directly with both customers and suppliers, ensuring orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered smoothly.



Responsibilities

● Contact customers to clarify project requirements, product specifications, quantities, and delivery preferences.

● Recommend suitable products based on customer needs.

● Source local suppliers who can fulfill orders and deliver to the customer's location.

● Request and compare supplier quotes and negotiate competitive pricing.

● Confirm product availability, delivery costs, schedules, and other order requirements.

● Coordinate order fulfillment between customers and suppliers.

● Provide timely updates and address customer questions or concerns.

● Monitor deliveries and follow up with suppliers to ensure orders are completed as scheduled.

● Resolve order discrepancies, supplier issues, and delivery delays.

● Maintain accurate order records, supplier information, and communication notes in the CRM.



Requirements

● Previous experience in US sales and customer service..

● Excellent spoken and written English.

● Confident and professional when communicating with US customers and suppliers.

● Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

● Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

● Ability to manage multiple orders and follow through on tasks independently.

● Resourceful and proactive in finding solutions.

● Comfortable using CRMs,
, and phone systems.

● Reliable internet connection and a professional working environment.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who takes ownership, communicates effectively, and knows how to get things done.

You should be comfortable dealing with different types of customers and suppliers, negotiating prices and resolving problems.

A strong customer service mindset, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through are essential. We value practical experience and problem-solving ability more than formal education.



REQUIRED: Video Introduction

Applications without a video will not be considered.

Please submit a 2–3 minute video recording introducing yourself and answering the following

questions:

1. Tell us about your previous work experience, particularly in sales or customer service.

2. What products or services have you handled?

3. Have you worked with US-based customers or suppliers before?

4. Tell us about a time you had to deal with a difficult customer or resolve an order-related

issue. How did you handle it?

5. Why do you think you would be a good fit for this role?

Please speak naturally. We are primarily evaluating your communication skills, English

proficiency, confidence, and problem-solving ability. Professional video production is not

required.



How to Apply

Please send us:

● Your updated resume.

● Your 2–3 minute video introduction.

● A short description of your most relevant work experience.



Important: Previous relevant work experience and the video introduction are mandatory.

Applications without both will be automatically rejected.

title: SEO Specialist Needed – Shopify E-Commerce | Project-Based + Long-Term Opportunity
description:
SEO Specialist Needed – Shopify E-Commerce | Project-Based + Long-Term Opportunity



Job Type: Freelance / Project-Based (Potential Long-Term Work)



Experience Level: Experienced SEO Specialist



ABOUT US



We are a U.S.-based e-commerce company specializing in paint and coating products for both the DIY consumer market and B2B commercial customers.



We're looking for an experienced SEO specialist to help improve our organic Google rankings, increase qualified website traffic, and generate more sales.



We already have a Shopify website developer and an active Semrush account, which will be our primary SEO research and optimization platform. We're looking for someone experienced with Semrush who can develop an effective SEO strategy and work alongside our existing developer.



INITIAL PROJECT RESPONSIBILITIES



- Conduct a comprehensive SEO audit of our Shopify website using Semrush.

- Analyze our primary competitors' organic keywords, Google rankings, estimated traffic, and backlink profiles.

- Use Semrush to perform keyword gap analysis and identify opportunities.

- Research and prioritize high-value keywords for both DIY consumers and B2B customers.

- Review on-page SEO, including product pages, titles, meta descriptions, headings, and internal linking.

- Identify technical SEO issues affecting search visibility and indexing.

- Evaluate backlink opportunities and recommend a legitimate link-building strategy.

- Develop a clear, actionable SEO plan to improve organic rankings.

- Coordinate with our existing Shopify developer on implementation.



REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience improving organic Google rankings for e-commerce websites.

- Strong knowledge of Shopify SEO.

- Hands-on experience using Semrush for keyword research, competitor analysis, site audits, and ranking tracking.

- Understanding of technical SEO, keyword research, on-page SEO, and quality backlink building.

- Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

- Ability to demonstrate actual SEO results from previous projects.

- Strong communication skills and ability to provide clear recommendations.

- Experience with both B2C and B2B SEO is a plus.



INITIAL PROJECT DELIVERABLES



1. Comprehensive website SEO audit.

2. Competitor keyword and backlink analysis.

3. Prioritized keyword research report.

4. Technical and on-page SEO recommendations.

5. Clear 90-day SEO action plan.

6. Recommendations for ongoing SEO maintenance and growth.



POTENTIAL LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



Although this position will begin on a project basis, we have a history of developing long-term working relationships with the freelancers and specialists we hire.



Many of our project-based assignments naturally grow into ongoing opportunities as we continue working together.



We're looking for someone who can help us establish a strong SEO foundation and potentially continue managing and improving our organic search performance over time.



Ongoing responsibilities may include keyword tracking, SEO maintenance, content optimization, backlink outreach, competitor monitoring, and continued improvements in Google rankings.



We value reliable, knowledgeable professionals and prefer building lasting working relationships with people who consistently deliver quality work.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



1. Your hourly rate in USD.

2. Your experience with Shopify and e-commerce SEO.

3. Your experience using Semrush.

4. Examples of websites you've helped improve in Google rankings.

5. Your approach to competitor research and improving organic rankings.

6. Your availability for project-based work and potential ongoing assignments.



Please begin your application with "Shopify SEO Specialist" so we know you've read the entire posting.



We look forward to connecting with experienced SEO professionals who take pride in their work and are interested in building a lasting professional relationship.

title: Head of Marketing (Social, Video, Community & Partner Growth)
description:
Job Description: Head of Marketing (Social, Video, Community & Partner Growth)



Company: 1P Algorithms (
)



Role: Head of Marketing / Senior Growth, Content & Community Lead

Location: Remote (US/Global — overlap with US market hours preferred)

Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus



About 1P Algorithms



1P Algorithms is a fast-growing financial technology company building automated futures trading software for NinjaTrader 8. With over 500+ active traders and $50M+ in traded volume, we bridge the gap between institutional-grade algorithmic execution and everyday traders. Our suite of 15+ proprietary strategies serves two core audiences: futures traders looking to pass prop firm evaluations consistently, and busy investors seeking hands-free, emotionless capital growth directly in their own regulated brokerage accounts.



The Role



We are looking for a hands-on, data-obsessed Head of Marketing to own our entire customer acquisition and community engine. Right now, 100% of our growth is driven organically through Instagram (Reels), short-form video, and our 
 community.



Your mission is to take what is already working on Instagram and 
, systematize it, and scale it aggressively across three core pillars:



 ●Owned Short- & Long-Form Video (Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube)

 ●
 Community Leadership & Conversion (running the day-to-day 
 server, turning free traffic into high-trust leads, and supporting active clients)

You will start as a player-coach who can script videos, run the 
 floor, and recruit creator partners directly while building out a lean team of video editors, community moderators, and affiliates.



What You Will Own & Execute



     ●
 Community Leadership, Operations & Conversion:



      ●Own and run our 
 server end-to-end—serving as the face and driving force of both our public prospect community and our gated client channels.

      ●Architect the member journey from social/influencer viewer → free 
 member → active trial/demo call → paid Prime/Premium/Platinum subscriber.

      ●Drive daily community energy: post daily/weekly algo performance recaps, facilitate trader discussions, celebrate member prop-firm payouts, and run live voice/video AMAs, Q&As, and onboarding walkthroughs.

      ●Design high-converting 
 onboarding flows, role-gating, automated welcome sequences, announcements, and channel structures that reduce churn and nudge lurkers to book Demo Calls.

      ●Establish moderation standards, handle support escalations smoothly, and eventually recruit/train community moderators as member volume scales.

     ●Translate complex trading metrics (win rates, drawdown control, backtested ROI, prop firm payout proofs) into high-retention, scroll-stopping visual narratives.



     ●Performance-Based Influencer & Affiliate Ecosystem (Peripheral Niches):

 

            ●Source, pitch, onboard, and manage a network of influencers and content creators across peripheral industries—including prop firm reviewers, manual futures/forex day traders, personal finance educators, wealth-building/passive income creators, and FinTech/SaaS reviewers.

     ●Structure and scale performance-based partnerships (CPA / $ commission per conversion, recurring revenue-share, and tiered affiliate incentives) where creators earn directly for bringing qualified traffic,

/link-in-bio funnels, and joint livestreams).

     ●YouTube Growth Engine (Short & Long-Form):



     ●Build and scale our YouTube channel 
 into an authoritative inbound machine.

     ●Produce high-converting long-form formats: live prop-firm challenge series, transparent strategy deep-dives, NinjaTrader/VPS walkthroughs, and real customer video case studies.



     ●Product-Led Content & Funnel Optimization:

     ●Integrate our interactive web assets—such as the Strategy Analyzer, Prop Firm Finder, and Futures Masterclass—into owned social posts, 
 announcements, and influencer funnels as high-converting lead magnets.

     ●Track full-funnel attribution (views → affiliate clicks → 
 joins → demo calls booked → license sales & LTV) and double down on winning acquisition channels.



     ●Compliance-Smart Brand Positioning:



     ●Craft persuasive, high-trust messaging (and provide clear creative guidelines to affiliate creators) that converts skeptical traders while respecting financial marketing standards (proper risk disclosures, realistic framing, zero "get-rich-quick" spam).



Who You Are (Qualifications)



 ●Proven Social & Video Growth Track Record: 6+ years in growth marketing, content strategy, or social media leadership, with demonstrable success scaling brands via Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube.

 ●Hands-On

/Whop/Skool community)—you know how to keep channels lively, host live sessions, set up bots/roles, and convert community members into paying customers.

 ●Sharp Creative & Editing Instincts: You know what makes a 3-second hook work, how to pace retention edits, how to design high-CTR YouTube thumbnails, and how to turn raw screen recordings/P&L charts into compelling stories.

 ●Analytical & Scrappy Builder: Comfortable owning KPIs (CAC, 
-to-Demo conversion rate, affiliate ROI, MRR/license revenue) and operating with startup speed—willing to get your hands dirty in CapCut/Premiere, 
 server admin, and analytics dashboards before hiring out.



Bonus Points

Wolf of Washington is a Dutch-language investment platform built on one uncomfortable fact: US politicians structurally outperform the market, and they trade on information regular investors don’t have. Who we’re looking for



Proven experience as a creative strategist in paid social: ads you’ve scripted or briefed that actually scaled, with numbers to show

You think in data: hook rates, hold rates, CPL, CAC

title: Spanish-Speaking Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home

• Languages: fluent spoken Spanish and English. You call patients in both.



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her sixties with COPD who speaks only Spanish. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number, and says her daughter usually deals with her doctors. In Spanish, you explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit. Your next call is in English.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. Many of them speak Spanish. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit. For a patient who speaks Spanish, you are the first person at AnsibleHealth they can talk to in their own language.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voicemail, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one decide whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



WHAT YOU NEED



• Fluent spoken Spanish that a Spanish-speaking patient in the US understands the first time, including medicine names, numbers and times

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or calls handled in Spanish at work are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or email work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 20 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/spanish-speaking-medical-virtual-assistant/apply?ref=vtk2amhw . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions in English.

3. Complete the Spanish section of the form. Its instructions are below, in Spanish only.

4. Record your voice on the form, first in English and then in Spanish. Each time you read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about ten minutes in all).

5. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.



EN ESPAÑOL

Esta parte del anuncio está solo en español, a propósito: en este trabajo usted llama a pacientes que hablan español. En la solicitud le pedimos tres cosas en español:



1. Escribir la palabra clave. Cuando el formulario le pida la palabra clave, escriba GIRASOL.

2. Responder por escrito una pregunta breve.

3. Grabar su voz: leer tres frases de una llamada real y responderle a una paciente con sus propias palabras.



If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: AI Engineer | Australian start up
description:
AI Engineer

Full-time | Remote | AUD $2,500 AUD per month | Melbourne business hours



ABOUT OXYSCALE



OxyScale is a fast-growing Australian startup that builds custom analytics platforms for medium to large businesses with complex operations. We’ve signed 15 clients in three months, and our goal is to reach 100 clients over the next 12 months.



Our clients rely on a mix of accounting, payroll, rostering, CRM, practice management and job management systems, alongside spreadsheets. We bring that information together into one platform their teams can rely on every day.



Every platform is built around the questions that particular business needs to answer. A recruitment agency might track placements, margins and consultant performance. An allied health group might track clinician hours, utilisation and clinic profitability. We also work with disability services providers, surveying firms, migration law practices and wealth management groups.



THE ROLE



You’ll manage client builds from start to finish, then maintain and improve each platform once it’s live. You’ll report directly to the two founders and work closely with us every day.



Over the past year, we’ve developed a fulfilment process built around AI coding agents, step-by-step procedures, automated quality checks and independent AI reviewers. The agents handle much of the technical implementation. You’ll direct them, review their work, test the results and take responsibility for the finished product.



WHAT A TYPICAL CLIENT BUILD LOOKS LIKE



1. Scoping

Guide the agents as they review the client’s call transcripts, proposal and available data. Check that the proposed dashboard answers the client’s questions and flag anything the agents missed.



2. Data warehouse setup

Run and verify the scripted setup for the client’s private data warehouse in Microsoft Azure. Check that credentials, permissions and access are configured securely.



3. Data connections

Connect the client’s systems using APIs, scheduled exports,
 feeds or browser automations. We already have a library of connectors, and the agents build new ones as needed. You’ll test historical data loads and ongoing updates against the live source systems and troubleshoot any issues.



4. Metrics and data accuracy

Every metric has a written definition, stored centrally, that explains how it’s calculated. The agents develop the calculations and independent reviewers challenge them. You’ll check that the final figures are accurate, consistent and explainable.



5. Dashboard development

Direct the agents using our existing chart library and design standards. Review each tab from the client’s perspective and check that it answers the questions agreed during scoping.



6. Quality assurance

Run the automated checks and final audit, reconcile the figures against the client’s own records and resolve outstanding issues before release.



ONCE A PLATFORM IS LIVE



The founders manage client communication. Behind the scenes, you’ll:



• Implement client requests, build new tabs and improve existing dashboards.

• Investigate discrepancies when a client questions a figure.

• Troubleshoot issues, such as a nightly refresh that stops working after a source system changes. Find the cause, make the correction and verify the result before releasing the update.

• Suggest and build internal tools, scripts, monitoring systems or automations that save the team time and improve reliability.



Your primary responsibility will always be building and maintaining high-quality client platforms.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We’re looking for someone with hands-on experience using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar AI coding agents to build real, working products. That could be an application, dashboard, automation or internal system you built for yourself, an employer or a client.



We’re particularly interested in something people actually use. We’d like to see how it works and hear about the decisions you made along the way.



Must have



• Experience directing AI coding agents through multi-step builds, reviewing their work, testing the results and correcting issues.

• At least one substantial AI-built project you can demonstrate.

• Strong written and spoken English. You’ll communicate with the founders daily through chat and voice, follow written procedures, provide clear updates and contribute your own ideas.

• Comfort using the terminal and Git, and reading SQL, Python or TypeScript well enough to understand and review changes.

• Experience handling sensitive information responsibly. Our clients trust us with financial, payroll, employee and customer data.

• Excellent attention to detail and the confidence to speak up when something doesn’t look right.



Highly regarded



• Experience building dashboards, analytics platforms or reporting tools.

• Hands-on experience with messy datasets, investigating incorrect figures, data modelling, dbt, PostgreSQL or cloud data warehouses.

• Experience with APIs, scheduled workflows or automation tools such as n8n, Make or Zapier.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform.

• Previous experience working in a startup or small, fast-moving team.



If your background is in BI or data analytics, we’d love to hear about your experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, SQL or data modelling. For this role, we’re particularly interested in how you direct AI agents, check their work and take ownership of the result.



You don’t need a computer science degree or an extensive engineering career. What you’ve built and how you approach problems matter most to us.



WORKING WITH US



You’ll enjoy this role if you take initiative, enjoy solving problems and are comfortable working independently in a startup where things move quickly. We’re looking for someone who wants to learn, contribute ideas and grow with the business.



As OxyScale grows, there’s an opportunity for this position to develop into a leadership role overseeing our fulfilment operations.



PRACTICAL DETAILS



• Employment: Full-time and remote. This must be your only job.

• Working hours: At least six hours of overlap with Melbourne business hours (9 am to 5 pm) each working day.

• Salary: AUD $2,500 per month.

• Software: OxyScale pays for your Claude subscription and any other software or accounts required for the role.

• Reporting: You’ll work directly with the founders through daily chat and voice communication. Much of your work will be independent, supported by clear written progress updates.

• Confidentiality and security: A confidentiality agreement and background check are required due to the sensitive data you’ll handle.

• Probation: Three months.

• Start date: As soon as practical.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Record a video walkthrough of your favourite AI-built project.



This is the most important part of your application. Please use Loom or another screen recorder to show the project and explain in your own voice:



• What you built and what it does.

• How you approached the build.

• Which AI coding agents you used and what they handled.

• What you personally contributed, corrected or improved.

• What the finished product made possible for you, your employer or your client.



2. Attach your CV.



3. Include any portfolio or project links you’d like to share (optional).



Please
 your application to both 
 and 
 with the subject line JOB APPLICATION.



Shortlisted applicants will meet directly with the founders, demonstrate their work live and complete a short practical exercise.

title: Supplier Ordering & GrabMart VA – Singapore Convenience Store (Part-Time, 9AM–1PM)
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read to the end. The application instructions are at the bottom, and applications that skip them will not be read.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We run 
 a small 24-hour convenience store in Singapore that also sells on GrabMart. The owners still place most supplier orders themselves on WhatsApp, often late at night. Your job is to take that over: every product ordered on time, in the right quantity, from the right supplier, without overfilling a very small storeroom.

Singapore and the Philippines are in the same time zone, so this is a normal morning schedule.



SCHEDULE

• Monday to Saturday, 4 hours a day (24 hours/week), 9:00 AM–1:00 PM, at fixed times:

   9:00–9:30 AM: GrabMart orders keyed into the shop POS

   10:00 AM: 10-minute call with the shop staff on duty

   10:10–11:15 AM: build and send supplier orders

   11:15 AM: short WhatsApp report to the owners

   12:30 PM: check every order is confirmed before the suppliers' cut-off times



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Supplier ordering (your main job). We work with about 78 suppliers, each in its own WhatsApp group: drinks, milk, bread, eggs, vegetables, snacks, beer, household items. You turn the shop's low-stock list into one clear order per supplier, respecting minimum order amounts, carton sizes, cut-off times and delivery days. You get every order confirmed and tell the shop what is arriving.

• Supplier records. For each supplier you record how they work (cut-off, delivery days, minimum order, payment rules) in our Google Sheet, so ordering gets faster every week.

• Unpaid-bill watch. Some suppliers will not key in a new order while an old invoice is unpaid. You keep the list of due invoices and send it to the owners twice a week so nothing blocks an order. You never make payments yourself.

• Deliveries. Chase short, damaged or wrong deliveries until they are fixed.

• GrabMart. Every morning, export the latest GrabMart orders and key them into our POS through a remote desktop, then check that the totals match.

• A short daily call with the shop and a short report to the owners.

• Over time, help us move routine ordering onto a simple order sheet and later a bot, so you supervise exceptions instead of typing every order.

• Tools: WhatsApp (company number), Google Sheets, the GrabMerchant portal and our Edgeworks POS through RemotePC. We train you on our setup.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

• Make or approve payments, or change any supplier's bank details.

• Change prices, start promotions or order beyond your approved limits without the owners' OK.

• Use your personal WhatsApp. We give you a company number.

• Share supplier prices or customer information outside U-Mart.



IF THE SHOP DOES NOT ANSWER YOUR 10:00 AM CALL

It will happen; the staff may be serving customers. When it does:

1. Send a WhatsApp message: "Calling back in 10 minutes."

2. Call again at 10:10, then at 10:20.

3. If there is still no answer, order only what you can confirm from the order history and the shop camera, and flag the missed call in your 11:15 report.



WHO YOU ARE

• At least 1 year in purchasing, inventory, retail, e-commerce or order-processing work (as a VA or in-house)

• Clear, natural written and spoken English; comfortable on WhatsApp calls

• Careful with numbers: cartons vs pieces, "15+1 free" deals, days of stock

• Good with Google Sheets and fast, accurate data entry

• You close loops without being reminded and speak up early when something is wrong

• Reliable setup: laptop, headset, fibre internet AND a backup (mobile data / power bank / UPS)

• Nice to have: GrabMerchant, Shopee or Lazada seller centre; any POS system; Singapore suppliers



PAY AND TERMS

• USD 300 per month for 24 hours/week (part-time, long-term)

• Paid every two weeks via Wise or PayPal

• Shortlisted applicants do a paid 30-minute test task, then a paid 1-week trial

• NBI clearance required before starting

• Pay review after 90 days; more hours are planned as the role grows



HOW TO APPLY

1. Begin your application with the word RIVERFRONT.

2. Include a 2-minute video introducing yourself (unlisted YouTube, Loom or Google Drive link).

3. Answer these in your own words (no AI tools):

   a) It is 12:20 PM. A supplier's cut-off is 2:00 PM. The supplier says they cannot key in our order until an overdue invoice is paid, and you cannot make payments. What do you do in the next 10 minutes?

   b) A drink costs $44 per carton, or "15+1 free" (pay for 15 cartons, get 16). The shop sells about 1 carton a day and has space for only 6 cartons. Should we take the deal? Show your maths.

   c) It is 10:00 AM and the shop staff does not answer your call. What do you do?

- Support leave and timesheet administration, working with our accounts team to resolve missing information.

- Help maintain practical HR policies, procedures and onboarding checklists.

- Handle routine staff enquiries professionally and escalate sensitive or complex matters to the Managing Director.

Virtual assistance and business support

- Manage calendars, coordinate meetings and prepare agendas and meeting notes.

- Track action items and follow up with managers and staff to keep work progressing.

- Draft professional
s, letters, reports and internal communications.

- Assist with travel arrangements, research, document preparation and general administration.

- Keep shared files and business systems accurate and organised.

- Help develop our internal staff portal, RenHQ, particularly employee profiles, onboarding, training and HR records.

What we’re looking for

- At least three years of relevant HR, recruitment or people operations experience.

- Experience supporting an Australian business; familiarity with Australian HR processes is highly desirable.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with confidence communicating directly with managers and staff.

- Strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.

- Sound judgement when handling confidential employee and business information.

- The confidence to follow up, ask sensible questions and identify issues early.

- Strong Microsoft 365 skills, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel and Teams.

- Experience with HR systems, Xero, Connecteam or similar platforms would be an advantage.

- A reliable computer, stable internet connection, suitable workspace and a practical backup plan for outages.

Experience supporting teams in construction, agriculture, forestry, trades, logistics or other field-based industries would be particularly valuable.



What we offer

- A remote role working directly with the business owner.

- Varied work across people management, administration and business improvement.

- The opportunity to shape how we recruit, onboard and support our team.

- Scope to grow your responsibilities and remuneration as you demonstrate results.

How to apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph using the subject line:



HR Manager & VA – Rencon Group – [Your Name]



Please include:

1. Your current CV.

2. A short introduction outlining your HR experience and any experience supporting Australian businesses.

3. One example of an HR or onboarding process you have managed or improved.

4. The software and systems you use confidently.

5. Your expected hourly rate in AUD, availability to work Melbourne business hours and earliest start date.

We’re looking for someone dependable, approachable and capable of becoming a trusted part of our team.

title: LinkedIn Lead Generation Specialist
description:
We work with small and mid-sized service businesses. You'll get a full service and niche brief (target titles, industry language, groups, associations, message scripts).



What you'll do

1. Build targeted prospect lists

    • Run and save LinkedIn Sales Navigator searches from the niche brief (titles, keywords, company size, geography) 

    • Score each prospect on our 10-point ideal-customer scorecard before contacting them 

    • Find buying signals: job posts for receptionists or dispatchers, Google ads, reviews that mention unanswered calls, growth news 

    • Keep the prospect tracker complete and up to date 

3. Run outreach 

    • Send about 20 personalized connection requests every weekday (about 100 per week), within LinkedIn's limits 

    • Follow our multi-touch sequence: opening question, follow-ups, demo-line invitation, polite close 

    • Personalize every first message with a real detail (their post, their company, a buying signal) 

    • Reply to responses within 4 business hours during your shift 

    • Book interested prospects onto the founder's calendar 

4. Engage in niche communities

    • Join and vet 10 to 15 relevant LinkedIn groups per niche 

    • Leave 5 to 10 thoughtful comments per day on prospects' posts, groups and industry association pages 

    • Find active commenters on industry posts and add qualified ones to the prospect list 

5. Support content

    • Schedule 3 posts per week from drafts we provide (or draft them yourself from our templates, for approval) 

    • Reply to comments within the first hour where possible 

    • Suggest post ideas based on the questions and objections you hear in conversations 

6. Report weekly

Every Friday, send a short report with:

    • Connection requests sent and acceptance rate 

    • Conversations started and reply rate 

    • Demo-line calls prospects said they made, and sales calls booked 

    • What's working, what isn't, and one suggested change for next week

description:
I'm looking for a passionate and versatile music arranger/orchestrator for long-term freelance collaborations, working on original music for my YouTube channel, films, and other creative projects.



Firstly, before musical skills, I'm looking for someone I can share a long-term collaboration with. I'm a big believer that working with the right people will be both more productive, but also much more fulfilling.



Therefore, I want to share the core values I myself believe in, and am looking for in the people I work with:



Excellence: We take pride in our craft and strive to create work we're genuinely proud of.



Integrity and Honesty: We are honest and authentic, even when and especially when it's difficult. Our words are honest to how we feel, and our actions reflect our promises.



Growth: We're not just interested in getting the job done, but always striving to improve our skills and understanding of the world. Every project is an opportunity to grow and develop! Every setback is an opportunity to reflect and learn!



Passion and Engagement: We make creative decisions we are genuinely passionate about, and bring an enthusiastic attitude to life and work. Because life is short, it's best to have fun, even if it's work!



Abilities



Next, after values, I'm looking for the following attributes. Someone with:



A strong musical ear: An intuitive sense of what sounds good, including harmony, melody, rhythm, texture and instrumental color.



Musical imagination: The ability to hear possibilities beyond what's written and envision how a simple musical idea could become something extraordinary.



Understanding of musical expression: An intuitive ability to shape tension, release, contrast and emotional development through music.



Stylistic versatility: The ability to understand and work across different musical styles, rather than being confined to one particular sound.



Skills



Lastly, I'd expect you to have the following skills:



Orchestration: Able to arrange and distribute musical ideas across different instruments and ensembles, with a strong understanding of instrumental ranges, timbres, textures and techniques.



Harmony & Music Theory: Strong understanding of harmony, counterpoint, voice leading and musical structure. Able to develop and enrich existing compositions harmonically.



Musical Development: Able to expand and develop existing themes, motifs and musical ideas while preserving the composer's original vision.



Musical Expression: Able to use orchestration, dynamics, articulation and texture to create emotional impact, tension, contrast and musical interest.



Music Notation: Proficient in notation software such as MuseScore, Dorico, Sibelius or Finale, and able to produce clear, playable scores and parts.



MIDI Mockups: Able to create convincing demonstrations of orchestral arrangements using virtual instruments and sample libraries.



Additional skills that would be helpful



Experience composing or arranging film scores, game soundtracks or other cinematic music.



Experience with jazz harmony, chromaticism and contemporary orchestral techniques.



Experience with music production and DAWs such as Logic Pro, Cubase or Ableton.



Experience arranging for live musicians and recording sessions.



Familiarity with a wide range of musical styles, from classical and orchestral music to jazz, minimalism and contemporary film music.



First Project



The first project will be to orchestrate and develop an original 2–3-minute composition that I've already started composing and partially orchestrating.



I'll provide my existing musical material, including the main themes, harmonies, and orchestration ideas. I'm looking for someone who can help complete and elevate the arrangement, bringing creative ideas of their own while staying true to the musical vision.



The final deliverables would include an editable score, individual instrumental parts where needed, and an audio mockup.



Future collaborations may involve a variety of original compositions for cinematic films, YouTube videos and other musical projects, ranging from intimate chamber music to larger orchestral arrangements.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your 2–3 best compositions or arrangements, particularly examples that showcase your orchestration, harmony and musical creativity. Please explain your specific contribution to each project.

2. Which notation software, DAWs and orchestral sample libraries you use, and your relevant experience.

3. A brief introduction explaining why and how you began your musical journey, and your future goals and aspirations.

4. What you're looking for in an ideal creative partnership.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short paid trial, giving us an opportunity to explore how we work together creatively.



I'm looking forward to hearing your work and hopefully finding someone to make great music with!

title: Meta Ads Growth Partner – U.S. Home Improvement Company
description:
$400 Guaranteed Monthly Minimum + Performance Commissions





About the Opportunity:



Hill Country Turf Co. is a newly launched artificial turf installation company serving homeowners throughout San Antonio, Texas, and the surrounding communities. We help homeowners transform ordinary backyards into beautiful, low-maintenance outdoor spaces for families, pets, entertaining, and everyday living. 



We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Meta advertising specialist to help build our residential lead-generation program from the ground up.



This is not a traditional social media management position.



We're not looking for someone to schedule content, grow our follower count, or simply manage an advertising budget.



We're looking for someone who knows how to create compelling
 and Instagram advertisements, generate qualified homeowner inquiries, and turn advertising into measurable business opportunities.



Most importantly, we want someone who sees the potential to earn considerably more than a traditional fixed monthly salary by producing results.





Why This Opportunity Is Different:



Our expected average residential installation is approximately $10,000, although actual project values will vary considerably.

Some projects may be smaller, while larger backyard transformations, premium installations, and properties requiring extensive turf work could represent $20,000, $30,000, $40,000, or more.



We're especially interested in attracting higher-value residential projects. A single $40,000 installation can generate substantially more commission income than several smaller installations. Rather than paying a flat monthly salary regardless of results, we've structured this opportunity to reward the person responsible for helping us grow. You'll receive guaranteed monthly compensation, plus the opportunity to earn considerably more through performance-based commissions.



Our goal is to establish a long-term relationship with someone who wants to help build the business, improve advertising performance, and share financially in the success they help create.





Guaranteed minimum compensation: 



$400 USD per month. You will receive at least $400 per month for fulfilling your agreed responsibilities, even if earned commissions are lower. Your guaranteed monthly payment is credited toward your commissions for that same month. You receive whichever is greater: your $400 monthly guarantee or your earned commissions. The monthly guarantee resets each month. You will never owe the company money if commissions are below $400.





Commission Structure:



Commissions are calculated on qualifying installation revenue actually collected from customers generated through your advertising campaigns.



2% on the first $50,000 of qualifying monthly revenue.



3% on incremental qualifying revenue between $50,000 and $100,000.



4% on incremental qualifying revenue above $100,000.



Higher commission tiers depend on meeting agreed advertising-efficiency standards. Commissions and revenue thresholds will be defined in a written agreement.





What Could You Earn?:



Assuming completed installations are attributable to your advertising:



Closed Installations                                Installation Revenue           Your Potential Monthly Compensation



0–2 jobs averaging $10K                       $0–$20,000                          $400 guaranteed minimum



3 jobs averaging $10K                            $30,000                                $600



5 jobs averaging $10K                            $50,000                                $1,000



10 jobs averaging $10K                          $100,000                              $2,500



3 high-value jobs averaging $40K         $120,000                              $3,300



15 jobs averaging $10K                         $150,000                               $4,500



Examples assume all qualifying installation revenue is collected within the same monthly measurement period and commission accelerator requirements are satisfied. These figures illustrate potential earnings, not guaranteed results.



Consider the opportunity of generating just three $40,000 installation projects. That represents $120,000 in revenue. Under the proposed commission structure, you could earn $3,300 from those three customers alone.



This is why we're not simply trying to generate the highest possible number of inexpensive leads. We want to attract serious homeowners with valuable projects, strong purchasing intent, and the financial ability to invest in professional installations.



There is no predetermined maximum commission.



You are not responsible for personally selling or installing the turf. Your primary responsibility is generating qualified opportunities. HCTC handles customer consultations, onsite estimates, proposals, sales, and installation.





Our Expected Closing Rate:



Our target is to close approximately 25–35% of completed, qualified onsite estimates. This is a planning target, not a guaranteed historical conversion rate. As a new business, we will measure and refine our actual performance. We recognize that closing performance is a shared responsibility. HCTC is responsible for responding to customers promptly, providing professional estimates, following up, and converting opportunities into signed installations.



However, the quality of the leads you generate also has a substantial influence on closing rates. A homeowner actively considering a $30,000 backyard transformation is a different prospect from someone casually clicking an advertisement without understanding the potential installation cost.



For example:

Generating three closed installations at a 25–35% closing rate would generally require approximately 9–12 completed qualified onsite estimates.



Generating five closed installations would generally require approximately 15–20 completed qualified onsite estimates. Generating ten closed installations would generally require approximately 29–40 completed qualified onsite estimates. These estimates illustrate the relationship between qualified opportunities and completed sales. Actual results will vary.



Our priority is attracting homeowners who have real projects, realistic budgets, and strong intentions to move forward. HCTC funds all approved Meta advertising expenses separately. You are never expected to fund advertising from your own compensation.





Your Responsibilities:



1. Create Our Advertising Content



We're a new company, and we don't yet have a portfolio of completed installations.



You'll be responsible for building our initial advertising creative independently.



This includes:



Finding high-quality artificial turf photos and video footage with appropriate commercial usage rights OR using AI image-generation tools to create photorealistic backyard transformations and landscaping concepts when suitable original imagery is unavailable.



Creating professional
 and Instagram advertisements.



Editing compelling short-form videos and Reels.



Producing static advertisements, graphics, and visual concepts.



Writing engaging hooks, headlines, captions, and calls to action.



Developing new advertising concepts based on performance.



AI-generated imagery is absolutely welcome.



We're particularly interested in candidates who can produce convincing, photorealistic images of residential backyards, artificial turf installations, pet areas, and outdoor living spaces.



These visuals should look like authentic residential photography, with realistic lighting, landscaping, materials, proportions, and details—not obvious AI-generated artwork.



The objective is to help homeowners picture what their own property could become.



All advertising must accurately represent HCTC's capabilities. AI-generated concepts must not be presented as photographs of completed HCTC projects, and other companies' installations must not be misrepresented as our own. Concept renderings should be identified appropriately.



We'll provide our company branding, business information, and strategic direction.





2. Build and Manage Meta Advertising Campaigns



You'll be responsible for:



Setting up and managing
 and Instagram lead-generation campaigns.



Researching residential audiences and customer needs.



Developing and testing offers, messaging, and advertising creative.



Identifying opportunities to reach homeowners considering larger, premium outdoor transformations.



Managing campaigns within approved advertising budgets.



Monitoring lead costs and campaign performance.



Improving advertising efficiency through ongoing testing and optimization.



Developing recommendations for scaling successful campaigns.



We expect you to understand the difference between increasing advertising spend and actually improving performance.



Additional budget must be justified through results and a clear explanation of how the additional spending will create value.





3. Generate Qualified, High-Value Residential Leads



Our goal is to generate legitimate homeowner inquiries for residential artificial turf installations.



We're particularly interested in customers seeking:



Complete backyard transformations and lawn replacements.



Larger residential turf installations.



Premium outdoor living and landscape improvements.



Pet-friendly artificial turf.



Low-maintenance residential landscaping.



Family recreation areas and outdoor entertainment spaces.



Residential putting greens and specialty turf applications.



Our initial geographic focus is the San Antonio–New Braunfels market in Texas.



While the average installation is expected to be approximately $10,000, we want to actively pursue opportunities for larger projects.



Your goal is not simply to minimize cost per lead. It's to find the right homeowners and generate the greatest amount of profitable installation revenue possible.



A campaign that produces three highly qualified $40,000 projects could be considerably more valuable than one that produces dozens of small or unqualified inquiries.



You'll help develop lead forms, messaging, and targeting strategies that attract homeowners with realistic expectations and genuine interest in professional installation.



4. Track Results and Improve Performance



We believe the best marketers understand what happens after someone submits a lead form.



You'll work with HCTC's lead-tracking system to monitor:



Advertising expenditures.



Customer inquiries.



Qualified leads.



Scheduled and completed onsite estimates.



Estimated project values.



Signed installation contracts.



Attributable installation revenue.



Cost per qualified estimate and customer acquisition.



Revenue and customer acquisition efficiency by campaign.



You'll provide a concise weekly performance report explaining what worked, what didn't, and what you recommend changing.



HCTC will maintain responsibility for customer follow-up, estimating, and closing. You'll receive appropriate visibility into lead outcomes so your commission earnings can be verified.





Who We're Looking for - Required qualifications:



Proven experience managing Meta advertising for U.S. businesses.



Demonstrated ability to generate qualified customer leads.



Strong graphic design and short-form video editing skills.



Excellent direct-response advertising and copywriting abilities.



Ability to source appropriate visuals or produce professional, photorealistic AI-generated advertising concepts.



Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and conversion tracking.



Ability to work independently with limited supervision.



Strong written English and professional communication.



A performance-oriented mindset and sound judgment about advertising expenditures.





Preferred experience:



We'd particularly like to hear from candidates who have run campaigns for:



Landscaping companies.



Artificial turf installers.



Swimming pool builders.



Roofing contractors.



Home remodeling businesses.



Outdoor living and luxury backyard contractors.



Other residential home-improvement companies.



Experience advertising higher-ticket services to American homeowners is especially valuable.



You don't need previous artificial turf experience if you have demonstrated success in a comparable industry.





Working Arrangement:



Fully remote from the Philippines.



Approximately 8–12 hours per week initially, though this is a performance based job - if working more helps generate more leads, you make more money.



Some availability during U.S. Central Time for weekly meetings.



Initial 90-day engagement, with long-term potential.



Direct communication with the business owner.



Guaranteed $400 monthly minimum with performance-based commission upside.



We're interested in developing a sustainable relationship with someone who becomes increasingly valuable as the company grows.



If our advertising program expands significantly, we'll revisit responsibilities, workload, and the working arrangement accordingly.





How to Apply:



Please begin your application with the words "HCTC Growth Partner."



We want to understand what you've actually accomplished—not simply read a list of software you know how to use.



Please include the following:



1. Previous results



Describe your most successful Meta lead-generation campaign for a U.S. business.



Include the industry, approximate advertising spend, number of leads, cost per lead, qualified appointments (if tracked), and your personal responsibilities.



2. Creative portfolio



Provide three examples of
 or Instagram advertisements you personally created.



We would especially like to see short-form videos, photorealistic AI-generated advertising concepts, lead forms that qualify or rank customer profitability and closing likelihood, or advertisements designed to generate customer inquiries.



3. Relevant experience



Have you advertised for home-improvement, landscaping, roofing, remodeling, or similar businesses? Tell us about your most relevant experience.



4. Creating advertising from scratch



HCTC currently has no completed installation photographs or videos.



Explain how you would create professional advertisements for our business using properly licensed source materials, original creative concepts, or photorealistic AI-generated imagery.



Which AI tools, if any, would you use?



5. Advertising judgment



Imagine you spend $500 on Meta advertising and generate 18 leads, but only four are qualified and just one schedules an onsite estimate.



What would you investigate before asking us to increase the advertising budget?



6. High-value customer acquisition



If you were responsible for attracting homeowners considering $20,000–$40,000 backyard transformations rather than smaller turf installations, how would your advertising strategy differ?



7. Your availability



Tell us your current time zone, approximate weekly availability, and whether you're comfortable with our guaranteed minimum and performance-based commission structure.



IMPORTANT: APPLICANTS THAT DO NOT REPSOND TO ALL 7 OF THE INITIAL INQUIRY QUESTIONS ABOVE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.





Our Selection Process:



We'll review applicants based on demonstrated results, creative quality, analytical judgment, and their ability to work independently.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview and may be asked to complete a separately compensated creative and advertising assessment.



We are not looking for the cheapest person who knows how to run
 ads.



We're looking for someone talented enough to build a highly profitable customer-acquisition program - and ambitious enough to want to be rewarded for doing it.



If that sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Creative Strategist – E-commerce Video & Image Ads
description:
We’re looking for a creative and analytical person to help us plan, develop, and improve ads for our e-commerce brand.



You will research our customers, develop compelling advertising ideas, prepare clear creative briefs, and work closely with our copywriters, video editors, and media buyer. Your goal is to help the team consistently produce ads that capture attention, communicate our product’s value, and encourage purchases.



Your responsibilities:



1. Customer and product research

-Understand our products, benefits, target audience, and brand voice.

-Study customer reviews, comments, questions, and feedback.

-Identify customers’ needs, frustrations, buying motivations, and objections.

-Research competitor ads and relevant trends to find opportunities for original concepts.



2. Creative planning and concept development

-Develop ad ideas for different customer needs and levels of product awareness.

-Propose hooks, storytelling approaches, product demonstrations, and image ad concepts.

-Explain the audience, purpose, and reasoning behind each concept.

-Maintain an organized list of ideas and prioritize concepts for production.



3. Creative briefs and team direction

-Prepare briefs covering the hook, key message, script direction, visuals, references, and call to action.

-Give editors clear instructions about footage, pacing, captions, music, and product presentation.

-Work with copywriters to strengthen scripts and keep the message focused.

-Answer production questions and help the team resolve unclear instructions.



4. Performance analysis and testing

-Work with the media buyer to understand which ads perform well.

-Look for patterns in successful hooks, messages, formats, and visuals.

-Recommend what to test next and explain the reason for each change.

-Develop fresh versions of successful concepts.

-Document results so the team can apply what it learns to future ads.



What we’re looking for:



-Experience with e-commerce advertising or creative strategy.

-Strong customer research, copywriting, and storytelling skills.

-Ability to turn research into practical ad ideas and clear briefs.

-Understanding of paid social advertising and basic performance metrics.

-Strong English communication and attention to detail.

-Ability to manage multiple creative projects and meet agreed deadlines.

-Confidence giving constructive feedback and collaborating with a remote team.



How success will be measured:



-Clear briefs that help the team produce the intended creative.

-Consistent delivery of well-researched concepts.

-Thorough reviews and actionable feedback.

-Useful testing recommendations supported by research or performance results.

-Creative improvements that contribute to the brand’s advertising goals.



Schedule and Compensation



Work arrangement: Remote

Employment type: Full-time

Base salary: $2,000 per month

Additional earnings: Performance Bonuses



How to apply:



Complete the application form below: 



Please send your resume, portfolio, and 1 example of an ad you helped develop and explain the target audience, the idea behind the ad, your contribution, and any available results.

title: AI-Assisted Customer Support Specialist (Email & Social Media) | US Shopify Brand | Full Time
description:
➤ Who we are

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling to women in the US, Canada and the UK. Orders are growing fast. Our support team has two full-time agents today, and the volume now needs more.

We are not the average e-commerce brand that stops caring once the order is paid. We want every customer happy, and a brand reputation that is spotless. That is why this role matters to us.



➤ This is not a typing job. It's a thinking job.

Customer support here is not about writing replies anymore. Our AI drafts the replies, and most of them are already very good.

Your job is to think: read every draft, check the order and the facts, fix what's wrong, and d
 what gets sent. You will work with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) all day. We need a sharp brain, not a fast typist.

And you own your queue. Every customer gets an answer. Every order problem gets followed until it is solved. Nothing gets forgotten. You don't need anyone to remind you.



➤ The team and your shift

Support here runs around the clock, in three 8-hour shifts (Philippine time):

• Afternoon and evening: 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM

• Graveyard: 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM

• Morning: 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM

In the application form, tell us every shift you can work. We agree on yours together, and then it stays fixed.

Whatever your shift, the job is the same:

• You own the queue while you are on. Every customer gets an answer, every order problem gets followed.

• On the days one of your teammates is off, you carry a bigger part of the queue.

• Before you log off, you brief the next agent: what happened, what is open, what to watch.



➤ What you will do

Customers always come first: support and comments are your priority every day. Supplier follow-ups fill the rest of your shift, and creator partnerships come later.



1. Customer support 
, AI-assisted)

• Review every AI-drafted reply in our inbox (Help Scout): check the order in Shopify and the tracking, correct or rewrite with AI when needed, then send.

• Handle order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, exchanges and address changes.

• Handle sensitive cases calmly: upset customers, disputes and chargebacks.

• Spot when the AI gets something wrong, and report it so the system keeps getting better.



2. Social media moderation

• Check comments on our
 and Instagram pages and ads, every day.

• Reply, hide spam, and turn public complaints into solved tickets.



3. Supplier and fulfillment follow-up

• Follow up with our supplier and fulfillment partners on delayed, lost or wrong orders.

• Make sure every stuck order gets a solution, and the customer hears about it.



4. Content creator partnerships (later, as the role grows)

• We are starting to work with content creators and influencers. It is close to customer support: you write to people, answer their questions, and follow up until it is done.

• Reach out to creators, coordinate product shipments, and track the content we receive.

• This is not for day one. It comes when support is under control and you have time in your shift.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 6 days a week. One fixed day off, agreed together. It cannot be Saturday, Sunday or Monday.

• One fixed shift, agreed together (see the three shifts above): 8 hours with 1 hour of breaks inside, so 7 hours of work a day. No split shift.

• The shift can move by one hour when the US changes its clocks.

• Being open to a 7th day during peak season is a big plus (paid extra).

• 100% remote, from the South East Asia time zone (Philippines preferred). Fast, reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 2+ years of customer support for an e-commerce brand on Shopify. This is required.

• Must have: you already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) regularly. If you don't use AI today, this role is not for you. We will train you on our system.

• A sharp, analytical mind: you read carefully, check the facts, and catch mistakes, including the AI's.

• Excellent written English: warm, clear and professional.

• Organized and detail-oriented. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about the Shopify brands you supported with the word banana.

• Responsible. You follow up without being reminded, and you bring solutions, not only problems.

• Experience with a helpdesk (Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar).

• Experience with
 and Instagram comment moderation.

• Bonus: experience talking to suppliers or fulfillment partners.

• Bonus: experience with influencer or content creator (UGC) outreach.



➤ What's in it for you

💰 $1,000 a month, paid on time, twice a month.

📊 Performance bonuses.

🕐 A fixed shift, chosen with you. No split shift, no schedule that changes every week.

🚀 Room to grow: more responsibility and a higher salary as the brand grows.

🤝 A long-term, stable role with a brand that is actively scaling.

👤 Direct work with the founder, in a small team that already runs well.



Status: independent contractor. The salary is gross, and you handle your own taxes.

I am looking for someone with a brain, who takes responsibility. My goal is simple: within a few weeks, you are 100% autonomous. I don't double-check your work, because you handle it and I trust you. Every
 and every comment gets answered on time, every day. Nothing gets forgotten. If there is a problem, I hear about it from you first.
