title: Senior Bookkeeper | QuickBooks Online & Xero
description:
Hi, I’m Jon. I am the owner of an e-commerce business for over 10 years, and sold more than $20 million on Amazon. I’m starting a bookkeeping service for e-commerce owners and other small businesses, and I’m looking for an experienced bookkeeper to be my first hire.



I’ll bring in clients and manage the client relationships. You’ll own the bookkeeping for your assigned clients, from reviewing their books at onboarding through cleanup, and preparing their monthly profit and loss statement (P&L) and balance sheet. We’ll work directly together, including on calls to discuss questions and review the work.



What you’ll do

• Assess new clients’ books. Review the file, identify the last reconciled month, and flag missing records or balances that need investigation. Estimate initial cleanup hours separately from recurring monthly hours so I can quote the work accurately.

• Handle setup and cleanup. Set up books from scratch in QuickBooks Online or Xero, including the chart of accounts, opening balances, and bank feeds. For existing clients, complete approved catch-up work and document corrections.

• Own the monthly close. Categorize transactions, match payments to invoices, record transfers and processing fees, and reconcile bank, credit card, and other relevant accounts to supporting statements.

• Prepare and review financial statements. Deliver the monthly P&L and balance sheet with supporting reconciliations and a short note explaining unusual changes or items that need my attention.

• Keep each client’s work on schedule. Track deadlines and time spent. When you need information from a client, send me a concise list of questions with the dates, amounts, and details I need to get you an answer.



What I’m looking for

• Strong spoken and written English is required. You must be comfortable joining me on voice or video calls, explaining a bookkeeping issue clearly in plain English, and answering follow-up questions as we work through it together.

• Experience independently managing monthly closes for several small-business clients at the same time.

• Hands-on proficiency in both QuickBooks Online and Xero, including account setup, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

• Experience taking over an existing set of books, assessing the cleanup required, and completing the work.

• Good judgment about what you can resolve independently and when to bring a question to me.



Experience with U.S. small businesses or e-commerce clients is a plus. I also welcome applicants who have managed books for service businesses and other industries.



Pay and growth

This is an hourly role to start, with a small initial workload as the business launches and I build our client roster. There’s an opportunity to take on more clients and grow into a team lead / managerial role as we expand. Also open to performance bonuses as the role develops. 



How to apply

Please send your résumé, preferred hourly rate and currency, and weekly availability. Include brief answers to these four questions using examples from your own work.

1. How many clients’ books have you been responsible for closing in the same month? Which parts did you complete yourself, and who reviewed the finished work?

2. When did you last complete a monthly close in QuickBooks Online and in Xero? What kinds of businesses were they?

3. Tell me about a cleanup you handled. What did you find when you first reviewed the file, and how did you determine the books were ready for regular monthly bookkeeping?

4. For the average client, how many hours do/did you spend each month getting from statements to finished reports



I’ll invite shortlisted applicants to a brief call in English. We’ll discuss one bookkeeping issue you’ve handled, how you resolved it, and a few follow-up questions, just as we would when reviewing a client’s books together.

HOW TO APPLY: complete our application at 
/s/53du0aog (about 40 minutes). We only review applications submitted through this link; clicking Apply on OnlineJobs alone is not enough. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph or message us and we'll send it.



THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• Starts at US$4 per hour; raises are based on your performance with us

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

4. Final conversation with the owner

5. Two-week paid training



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here: 

We only review applications submitted through this link. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph, or message us here and we'll send it.

title: Full-Time TikTok Media Buyer (Spark Ads, CPA / App Offers) — Proven Buyers Only
description:
Full-Time TikTok Media Buyer — Proven Buyers Only



We run an in-house performance marketing team out of Cyprus. We buy TikTok Spark ads on CPA offers (reward apps and mobile games) across the DACH region, the Nordics, France, the UK, Poland, Italy, the Netherlands, Belgium, US, Japan and Korea.



We are scaling to seven figures per month. We fund the ad spend, the accounts and the tools. You bring the skill, the discipline and the hours.



Who we want

We're hiring only 1 to 2 people. We want genuinely motivated, disciplined buyers who want to work with us FULL TIME and scale campaigns with us for the long run. This is not a side gig, and it's not for dabblers, course-watchers or people "exploring opportunities". If you're serious and you'll put in the time and dedication, read on.



Earnings

Our buyers make $1,500 to $4,000 per month. Top performers make over $15,000 per month. What you earn depends on what you scale.



What you'll do

- Launch and manage TikTok Spark ad campaigns on CPA offers in multiple markets

- Test new hooks every day, kill losers fast and scale winners step by step

- Keep every ad compliant with TikTok's advertising policies

- Report daily on spend, results, ROAS and what you tested



What you need

- Real, hands-on TikTok Ads Manager experience with your own campaigns and results you can prove

- CPA / affiliate experience (reward apps, gaming or app installs is a big plus)

- Strong written English and comfort with the numbers (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM)

- Full-time availability, Mon–Fri, 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM Manila time

- Reliable internet, backup power or connection, and your own laptop



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY

Any application that does not answer EVERY question below will not get a response. No exceptions. No generic cover letters.



1. Write the keyword SCALEPROOF as the first line of your application.

2. How many years have you been running paid TikTok ads, and in which verticals (CPA/affiliate, reward apps, gaming, ecom)?

3. What is the biggest daily spend you've personally managed on TikTok, and what was the ROAS on it?

4. Attach screenshots of your own TikTok Ads Manager AND the matching affiliate/network dashboard for the same date range. You may blur brand names. NDAs are not an excuse for zero proof. Applicants without proof will not be considered.

5. Send links to 2 or 3 Spark ads you built yourself.

6. In your own words, explain how you test hooks and how you scale a winning ad group.

7. How many hours per week are you available, and what is your timezone? Confirm you can work full time.

8. Why you? 3 sentences max.



What happens next

Shortlisted applicants get a video call with a live screen-share of their TikTok Ads Manager and their network dashboard. No live screen-share, no trial. No exceptions.



If you've read this far and you can tick every box, we want to hear from you.

title: HEAD OF PERFORMANCE MARKETING
description:
This is not a media buyer role.



An Australian eCommerce performance agency is looking for a Head of Performance Marketing: someone who is better at performance marketing than our founder. You'll own client ad accounts end to end. You'll find the problems and the opportunities yourself, challenge our thinking, and be accountable for one thing above all: profitable revenue growth.



If you can look at a store's website, products, ad accounts and sales data and explain how that business makes money, and exactly how you'd grow it profitably, keep reading.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Full ownership of client Google and Meta ad accounts: strategy, structure, buying and scaling

- Auditing accounts and building growth plans without being asked

- D
 which products to push, which to hold back, and where traffic should land

- Diagnosing and fixing tracking issues yourself

- Product feeds and Merchant Center

- Working with our content team on creative strategy and testing

- Calls with Australian clients: walking them through results, explaining your decisions, and pushing back when there's a better way





MUST-HAVES

(Please only apply if you meet every one of these.)



- 7–10+ years in performance marketing, with heavy hands-on media buying

- Experience as Head of Paid Media, Performance Lead or Senior Performance Strategist

- Experience working for Australian agencies or major Australian eCommerce brands

- Excellent written and spoken English. You're comfortable leading calls with Australian clients

- A proven record of scaling eCommerce revenue while holding or improving profit, on substantial monthly budgets

- Google Ads: Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, account structure, feed segmentation and scaling

- Meta Ads: campaign strategy, creative testing, account structure, audiences and scaling

- Tracking: GTM, GA4, server-side tracking, Meta CAPI, Google enhanced conversions, Merchant Center and feeds, and Shopify conversion tracking. You can diagnose tracking problems without help

- A commercial brain. You think in margins, CAC, ROAS vs MER, AOV and conversion rate, not just platform metrics

- Ownership. You audit, plan and act without being told, and you speak up when you disagree





NICE-TO-HAVES



- You've managed and mentored other media buyers

- UK or US agency experience (especially if your Australian experience is lighter)

- Case studies or screenshots that show your results

- TikTok Ads, Amazon Ads (SP/SB) and Seller Central

- Large catalogues: custom labels, categorisation and feed troubleshooting

- Experience shaping creative strategy with content teams



Deep expertise in Google and Meta matters far more to us than being "expert in everything."





THE DETAILS



- Full-time, fully remote

- Your hours must overlap heavily with Australian business hours (AEST/ACST)

- AUD 3,000–3,500 per month, depending on experience and track record. The top of the range is for exceptional candidates

- A senior role with real ownership. Your strategy, your accounts, your results





HOW TO APPLY



We're taking our time to find the right person. Applications that skip any of these steps won't be reviewed.



1. Use the subject line: "Profit over ROAS"

2. Attach your CV or LinkedIn profile

3. In under 200 words, answer this: pick an Australian eCommerce store you know (not one of your clients). Based on its website and products, how do you think it makes money, and what's the first thing you'd do with paid ads to grow it profitably?

4. Share one account you scaled: monthly spend, revenue before and after, and what happened to profit. Screenshots are welcome; please hide client names

5. Include a 2–3 minute video or voice recording (Loom is fine) introducing yourself in English



We look forward to seeing how you think.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



Behind every ad that works is a lot of careful, unglamorous work: creatives uploaded and named correctly, campaigns checked every morning, numbers pulled and organized, competitors tracked, small problems caught before they cost money. When that work is done well, the media buyers and creatives can spend their time on the decisions that move the business.



This role does that work. You’ll support our Meta advertising and marketing initiatives day to day, keeping things organized, accurate, and moving. It’s a hands-on role with plenty of tasks, and you’ll see exactly how a fast-growing brand runs paid ads from the inside.



For a reliable, detail-minded person who wants to learn digital marketing by working next to people who do it well, this is a rare opportunity: a front-row seat to how a growing brand’s advertising really works.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Support the Meta ad account. Upload and set up ads, apply our naming and tracking conventions, and make sure everything is launched correctly and on time, following clear instructions from the media buyer.



Keep a daily eye on performance. Check campaigns and ad statuses each day, flag disapprovals, spend problems, or anything unusual straight away, and make sure the right person knows.



Pull and organize the numbers. Prepare reports and spreadsheets from Ads Manager and other tools, so the team always has clean, accurate data to make decisions from.



Organize the creative library. Keep ad creatives, scripts, copy, and brand assets sorted, labeled, and easy to find, so no one on the team loses time looking for a file.



Research what’s out there. Track competitor ads, collect examples and ideas from the ad library, and bring back what you find in a clear, usable format.



Support the creative team. Collect briefs, track what’s in progress, and follow up so that creatives get from idea to ad without slipping through the cracks.



Handle marketing admin. Take care of the small tasks that keep marketing running, such as updating trackers, preparing documents, and keeping records current.



Work smarter with AI. Use AI tools to speed up research, organizing, and drafting, and always check the output before it reaches the team.



What we look for



Reliability. You do what you say you’ll do, on time. People on the team can hand you a task and stop thinking about it.



Attention to detail. You catch the wrong budget, the mistyped link, and the file saved in the wrong folder before anyone else does.



Organization. You keep your work and everyone else’s files tidy, logged, and easy to follow.



Fast learning. You pick up new tools and processes quickly, and you ask a good question when you’re stuck instead of guessing.



Clear communication. You report what you’ve done, flag problems early, and write updates that leave no one guessing.



Team spirit. You support the people you work with, take feedback well, and are happy to do the work that helps the team win.



Relevant experience. [1+] years in a virtual assistant, marketing support, or operations role. Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, spreadsheets, and common online tools is a strong advantage, and so is any experience in e-commerce. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the good ones get heard.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Real learning. You’ll work next to experienced media buyers, creatives, and marketers and see how paid advertising is run from the inside.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, people who show reliability and curiosity move into bigger roles in marketing.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 
/?job=virasst_jazz

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your work ethic speaks for itself.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply here: 
/?job=virasst_onl_ph

title: Online Learning Coach + English & Humanities Tutor (UK Curriculum) – Part-Time, Daytime
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read to the end. The application instructions are at the bottom, and applications that skip

them will not be read.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a family in Singapore looking for a patient, creative Learning Coach for a 17-year-old student. He

studies a UK homeschool curriculum (Wolsey Hall Oxford, Lower Secondary Year 8–9) on the Canvas

platform.



Wolsey Hall's own tutors teach the courses and mark his work. Your job is different: help him show up, get

started, stay with it, and submit his OWN work, every weekday. You are his daily coach and the person who

keeps all six courses moving.



Singapore and the Philippines are in the same time zone, so this is a normal daytime schedule.



SCHEDULE

• Monday to Friday, 1.5 hours a day (7.5 hours/week), at fixed times:

10:00–11:10 AM: daily check-in + main subject block

12:20–12:40 PM: end-of-day wrap-up

• Live video sessions on a Zoom/Google Meet link we provide.



YOUR SUBJECTS

• English (Year 9)

• Geography (Year 8)

• Skills for Life (Year 9)

• Digital Literacy (Year 9)

A separate tutor handles Maths and Science. You coordinate with them and keep the overall picture.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Start each day with a 10-minute check-in: what is due on Canvas and 2–3 targets for the day.

• Run a focused 1-hour subject block. He shares his screen and does all the typing; you guide.

• Break each written assignment into 20-minute chunks, so every session ends with something saved or

submitted.

• Hook his interest through the films and characters he likes, then bridge to the real topic. Right now that

includes superheroes (The Flash, Spider-Man, Batman) and James Cameron's Avatar. Example: why would

a clan living on harsh volcanic land be small and spread out, while a clan near fertile forest and water is

crowded? That is population density. Now compare Singapore with Mongolia. His interests change over

time, so keep asking what he is watching.

• End each day with a 20-minute wrap-up where he shows what got done. Then post a 3-line report in the

family group chat: attended (Y/N), what was completed (with a screenshot), tomorrow's target.

• Send a short weekly summary of progress across all six courses.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

• Write, edit or "fix" his work. Wolsey Hall marks it as his own. No AI-written text goes into anything he

submits.

• Contact him privately (personal chat, phone calls, social media). All communication goes through the family

group chat.

• Ask for his Canvas login. You will see Canvas through his screen share.



IF HE DOES NOT SHOW UP

It will happen sometimes. When it does:

1. At the start time, post in the group chat that you are in the session.

2. At 5 minutes, post again.

3. Wait until 15 minutes. If he is still not there, use the rest of the slot to prepare the next session, and note

the no-show in your report.

You are paid for the scheduled time when you follow these steps. Following up with him is the family's job, not

yours.



WHO YOU ARE

• Licensed Professional Teacher (LET), or a degree in Education or English

• At least 2 years teaching teenagers (13–18), online or in a classroom

• Clear, natural spoken and written English

• Warm but steady: you can encourage him and still hold a line

• You treat a 17-year-old as a young adult. Never "this is easy".

• Reliable setup: laptop, webcam, headset, fibre internet AND a backup (mobile data / power bank / UPS)

• Nice to have: UK or Cambridge curriculum experience (KS3, Lower Secondary, IGCSE), Canvas, Google

Docs



PAY AND TERMS

• USD 7–8 per hour depending on experience (7.5 hours/week)

• Paid every two weeks via Wise or PayPal

OnlineJobs.ph job post · Post 1 of 2 · Lead Learning Coach Page 3

• Shortlisted applicants do a paid 45-minute live trial session, then a paid 1-week trial

• NBI clearance required before starting

• Long-term role for the right person



HOW TO APPLY



1. Begin your application with the word CANVAS.



2. Include a 2-minute video introducing yourself (unlisted YouTube, Loom or Google Drive link).



3. Answer these in your own words (no AI tools):



- a) He says his Geography assignment is done. He shares his screen and it is half a paragraph. What do

you say in the next minute?



- b) In 3–5 sentences, explain why some places are crowded and others nearly empty, using any film or

superhero a 17-year-old might like.



- c) It is 10 minutes past the start time and he has not joined. What do you do

title: Experienced Linked Ghostwriter
description:
🚀 We're Hiring: LinkedIn Ghostwriters & Copywriters (A-Players Only)



A rare opportunity to join a fast-growing business, work with ambitious clients and be rewarded for exceptional performance.



We're looking for experienced LinkedIn Ghostwriters and LinkedIn Copywriters who genuinely understand how to create content that builds authority, generates engagement and drives business results.



This isn't a role for general content writers or people who have only recently started using LinkedIn.



We're looking for specialists who live and breathe LinkedIn.



🎯 What We're Looking For



You must have proven experience in:



- LinkedIn hooks: Understanding different hook styles, why they work and when to use them.

- Content frameworks: Storytelling, PAS, AIDA, authority-building and other proven writing structures.

- Content funnels: Creating effective TOFU, MOFU and BOFU content for different business objectives.

- LinkedIn strategy: Understanding posting frequencies, content pillars, audience growth and engagement.

- Idea extraction: Taking raw client ideas, voice notes, interviews and research and turning them into outstanding LinkedIn posts.

- Content performance: Knowing how to analyse results, identify what works and continuously improve.



You should be confident taking a client from initial research and idea extraction all the way through to a polished, high-performing LinkedIn post.



⭐ Who We're Looking For



Someone who:



- Has a proven track record of writing successful LinkedIn content.

- Is actively using LinkedIn and understands what's working right now.

- Can demonstrate real results and traction.

- Has a clear, repeatable system for producing quality content.

- Takes ownership, thinks strategically and doesn't need constant direction.

- Has exceptional writing skills and attention to detail.



We want people who can explain not just what they write, but why they write it.



💰 Why Join Us?



This is a rare opportunity to join a growing business with serious ambitions.



We're building a high-performing team and want exceptional people to grow with us.



What we offer:



- Competitive salary based on experience and ability.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Salary increases for exceptional results.

- Opportunities for career progression and greater responsibility.

- The chance to work with ambitious businesses and personal brands.

- A team that values expertise, initiative and high standards.



We're willing to pay more for the right person. If you're an A-player, we want to reward you like one.



📩 How to Apply



We don't want a generic CV and cover letter.



To be considered, please provide these 4 things:



1. Your LinkedIn Profile



A direct link to your personal LinkedIn account so we can see your activity and understanding of the platform.



2. Your Portfolio



Examples of LinkedIn posts you've written, ideally with performance results.



We're happy for client work to be anonymised.



3. Your Content Creation System



Show us how you take research, raw ideas, voice notes or client conversations and turn them into finished LinkedIn posts.



This can be a document, workflow, Loom recording or real example.



We want to see how you think and work.



### 4. A 1–2 Minute Video Introduction



Introduce yourself, tell us about your LinkedIn experience, share a result you're proud of and explain why you're an A-player.



No professional editing required.



⚠️ Please Note



This is a specialist role for experienced LinkedIn writers.



Applications without all four requirements will not be considered.



We're not looking for average. We're looking for people who take pride in being exceptional at what they do.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply now and be part of something that's growing.

title: Amazon Brand Manager and Brand Manager Intern
description:
AMAZON BRAND MANAGER



We are looking for a talented and versatile Amazon Brand Manager! If you think that you have what it takes to be successful in this role, we welcome you to apply!



Do you like going from one meeting to another with non-stop action and solving problems every day while managing 8 people? Where you are trying to please clients and juggling tons of competing priorities? If so, this is the job for you.



Brand Managers own the relationships at our agency. It’s your job to make customers like us while delivering our team’s accurate non-stop activities.



Responsibilities:

• Manage clients' accounts assigned. The Brand Manager will act as the direct point of contact for the client, responsible for coordinating MAG's services, implementing strategy, communicating with clients, direct reports, and leadership.

• 2+ Direct Reports. In addition to client services, this position is also a managerial position, and following the completion of training, brand managers will be expected to lead a small team of Amazon specialists, who will assist the manager with delivering MAG services to the client.

• Brand managers are the company's backbone, directly responsible for our client accounts.

• Proactively provide a strategy for the account, communicate with the client, and ensure MAG process and deliverables are met.

• Delegate tasks properly to your direct reports and the MAG teams, follow up on delegations, hold staff accountable, and report back to the client.



Qualifications:

• Amazon Expertise: 1+ year with Seller Central (flat files, FBA, PPC, SEO, reinstatements, brand registry, Helium10, keyword research).

• Agency & Management: Experience handling multiple demands, leading teams, hiring, and performance management.

• Project & Client Management: Skilled in multitasking, project management, client communication, and account ownership.

• Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with tools like Zoom, Slack, Asana, and adapting in fast-changing environments.

• Passion for eCommerce: Independent, people-focused, and driven to grow client sales on Amazon.



Expectations:

• Competitive salary!

• Fun Fully Remote Culture – Community Culture, Team Oriented Environment

• You can have your OWN Amazon selling business and utilize company resources to build your own account! We love and ? encourage entrepreneurs, in fact, the majority of employees have their own selling accounts!

• Unlimited Learning and Growth – If you meet and exceed our core values and grow sales, you will have unlimited opportunities to grow, advance, promote, and earn more.

• 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day

• Permanent WFH setup

• The work schedule is in Eastern Standard Time (Monday to Friday only)

• A dual-monitor setup is required (at least 8GB of RAM)

• Good quality camera and microphone

• Must have at least 25 MBPS internet speed

• Must consistently maintain good performance and seek skills development for professional growth.





----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



AMAZON BRAND MANAGER INTERN



Want to catapult out of that “Walmart uniform” and into a world of digital marketing?



We're hiring a Brand Manager Intern at our agency. If you're a tech-savvy gamer who thrives amidst organized chaos, then you are the one that we are looking for!



We will train you how to manage people effectively, communicate better with clients, and navigate tools such as Slack smoothly, while you work at home on your computer. You also get to learn how to sell on Amazon which is the number 1 wealth generation platform in the USA for beginners.



Here's what you'd be doing with us:

• Mastermind core services like PPC, SEO, Design, Catalog merchandising, and troubleshoot like a pro.

• Take charge of at least 8-10 accounts in Seller Central Accounts under a Brand Manager.

• Be the communication bridge between clients and our agency.

• Train and mentor at least 2 AS Intern/BM Intern.



Yes, it's challenging. Yes, it's exciting. Yes, it could be the start of your new career!



We will train you on everything. MAG is an education company and we find it’s easier to find the right culture fit and then train the skills than the other way around.



We're looking for:

• High Drive

• Friendly Introverts

• Strategic Communication Skills

• Ability to take charge, and follow through on a plan



So what are you waiting for? Toss away that nametag and make the switch today.



Expectations:

• 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day

• You work on your own computer and dual monitors

• Must have at least 25 MBPS internet speed

• Know how to use basic Google Sheets and Excel functions



You’ve got the talent—we’ve got the opportunity. Take control of your career and apply now!



For any questions or follow-ups,
 us at

title: IT Developer
description:
The IT Developer is responsible for managing the end-to-end development of systems, applications, and web platforms. This role thrives in a remote, collaborative environment and provides support to cross-functional teams by delivering both front-end and back-end solutions, system integrations, automation, and technical troubleshooting.



The IT Developer is highly organized, detail-oriented, and technology-driven, with the ability to communicate effectively across teams, manage complex workflows, and quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and processes.



Key Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications, internal tools, CMS platforms, APIs, databases, and cross-platform integrations.

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across company systems, applications, workflows, and web platforms.

• Implement automation and integration solutions using tools such as Zapier, while maintaining company software and applications.

• Analyze data and create dashboards, reports, charts, and visualizations using Excel, Google Sheets, and other reporting tools.

• Ensure system security and compliance through appropriate security standards and practices.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



Growing brands rarely break at the idea or the ad. They break in the middle: the order that ships late, the handoff that nobody owned, the warehouse that raised its rates, the process everyone assumes someone else is running. Every new market, product, and launch adds more of that middle, and the brands that keep growing are the ones where someone owns it.



This role owns the middle. You’ll make sure the whole business runs well, from the moment a customer orders to the moment the box arrives. You’ll build the systems, clear the path for the people doing the work, and run the network of fulfillment partners behind every order: knowing who’s out there, keeping the conversations open, and negotiating so our costs keep coming down. The results show up everywhere: faster delivery, lower costs, calmer weeks, and a team that moves quicker.



For a sharp, driven operator who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Build and maintain our 3PL network. Keep a living map of fulfillment partners across the markets we serve: who they are, where they ship from, what they handle, what they charge, and how they perform. Know who to call before we need them.



Negotiate all the time, not once a year. Stay in constant conversation with new and existing 3PLs, open negotiations, compare offers, and use each one to push rates, terms, and service levels in our favor. Every point you win drops straight into our margin.



Keep the whole business running. Own the day-to-day operations across fulfillment, customer support, vendors, and internal processes, and make sure nothing important falls between teams.



Build the systems that scale. Turn the way we work into clear processes, checklists, and tools that a growing team can follow without being told twice.



Make teams work as one. Connect marketing, creative, support, and logistics so that work moves smoothly from one hand to the next and blockers get cleared fast.



Own our other partners. Manage the relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, and service providers: performance, costs, contracts, and what happens when something goes wrong.



Run on real numbers. Track the operational numbers that matter, such as delivery times, cost per order, error rates, and margins, and turn them into decisions and savings.



Solve problems before they spread. Catch the small issue early, find the real cause, and fix it permanently, so the same thing doesn’t happen twice.



Keep the team in rhythm. Run a steady working rhythm for a remote, international team, including planning, follow-ups, onboarding, and clear ownership of every task.



Prepare for what’s next. Plan the operations behind new launches, new markets, and new brands before they arrive, so growth doesn’t become chaos.



Keep us in good standing. Make sure we follow the rules that apply to what we make and sell in every market, and that records and contracts are in order.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up research, reporting, and routine work, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



A negotiator’s mindset. You’re comfortable asking for more, you do your homework before you sit down, and you can tell a good offer from one that only looks good. You build relationships that survive hard bargaining.



Systems thinking. You see how the pieces of a business connect, you can tell a one-off problem from a broken process, and you fix the process.



Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when things go wrong, make sound calls with incomplete information, and explain them clearly.



Fluency with numbers. You’re comfortable with costs, margins, and operational metrics, and you use them to d
, not just to report. You can compare fulfillment quotes line by line and spot what’s hiding in the fine print.

description:

- Purchase Order & Manufacturing Order Management — create and track POs and MOs in MRPeasy.



- QC Process Management — prepare QC quote requests with QC checklists attached, coordinate QC inspections and review defect documentation

Skills:

- Experience managing active supplier relationships

- Responsive and comfortable across multiple communication platforms simultaneously (WhatsApp,
, Wechat)

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable with Tech tools and AI

- High urgency and ownership - today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done no matter what

- Proactive Communicator - if I foresee something may be wrong, I will highlight as soon as possible

- Adaptable - I embrace new tools, new processes and AI; and I want to keep improving

- Has Opinions - I want to suggest a better way



Details



This is a full-time remote role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 80,000 – 130,000 per month (based on experience)



Commitment: Full-time, Philippine business hours (Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm PHT) with flexibility for supplier updates outside standard hours)

title: SEO Specialist On-Page SEO & AI Tools
description:
We are hiring for an SEO Specialist to improve website content and on-page SEO across multiple client websites.



Our team uses ChatGPT and other AI tools for first-pass page reviews. Your job is to take that work further: judge the AI's recommendations, catch what it missed or got wrong, research competitors, and write page-specific improvements.



We care more about your judgment, curiosity, and attention to detail than years of traditional SEO experience. You need more than 1 year of relevant experience, and we will train you on our SEO processes.



This is not a keyword research, link building, or technical audit role.



Full-time, 40 hours a week, remote

Long-term role. You will start on an on-page SEO project that runs for the first 4 months.

First month (training) overlap hours: from 9:30 AM to 12:00 PM Mountain Time. The rest of your hours are up to you. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Review existing pages and find SEO improvements: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, content structure, and keyword targeting

- Check AI-generated recommendations for accuracy, relevance, and completeness, and catch what the AI missed or got wrong

- Write specific, actionable recommendations based on search intent, the audience, and business goals, and explain your reasoning

- Flag thin, repetitive, outdated, or generic content

- Research competing pages, compare their quality, structure, and depth, and find content gaps

- Work out what searchers are actually trying to accomplish for each topic

- Use ChatGPT and other AI tools for research and analysis, write and refine prompts, and verify claims independently

- Find ways to improve visibility in both traditional search and AI-powered search

- Prioritize recommendations by likely value, and add genuinely useful content, not just more content

- Follow our SEO processes, ask questions when something is unclear, and work across multiple client projects



MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- Sound judgment and critical thinking: you question recommendations instead of accepting them, spot gaps and inconsistencies, and explain your reasoning

- More than 1 year of experience in SEO, content editing, QA, or research

- Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI/LLM tools, and careful to check and qualify their responses before using them

- Exceptional attention to detail

- Strong online research skills, and you can tell credible information from unsupported claims

- Strong written English and clear, concise explanations

- Proactive, organized, and open to feedback



NICE-TO-HAVES

- Basic on-page SEO knowledge (keywords, headings, metadata, internal linking, search intent)

- Experience with Semrush, Ahrefs, or Google Search Console

- Familiarity with AEO/GEO (optimizing for AI-powered search)

- Experience editing or reviewing website content

- Experience with AI-assisted research or content workflows

- WordPress or another CMS



No advanced technical SEO experience needed.



Shortlisted applicants complete a short communication test and a paid practical assessment.



HOW TO APPLY

Provide a link to your updated CV, a link to your portfolio and links to sample work, if any. Answer these questions, numbered:

1. What SEO, content editing, QA, or research work have you done, for how long, and with which tools?

2. Give 2 specific example of how you used ChatGPT or another AI tool to improve your work. What did you ask it, and what did you change in its answer?

3. Describe a time you spotted an issue or opportunity that was not in your instructions. What did you do?

4. An AI tool recommends adding more keywords and a longer FAQ to a service page. How would you d
 whether that advice is accurate and useful?

5. Can you be online from 9:30 AM to 12:00 PM Mountain Time for the first month of training?

6. How many hours a week would you prefer to work (40+ full time, or if less, "part-time," please specify)?

7. If hired, will this be your only job, or do you have other jobs or freelance commitments?

8. Where do you want to be in 1 to 3 years?

title: Remote Phone Sales Rep – Warm Leads, Short 10–15 Min Calls, $10 per Sale
description:
About us

We help people trade the financial markets with AI-powered tools and funded trading capital, without risking their own savings. We are expanding into the US market and are building our phone sales team.



Why this role is different

You don’t chase anyone. Every US lead you call has:



applied through our form

watched our 20-minute info webinar

been fully briefed by our support team



They already know what we offer and what it costs. They’re warm and expecting our call. Your job is to answer their last questions and help them get started.



The role

You make short, focused calls of 10–15 minutes to US leads: confirm their goals, clear up any hesitation and close them on our entry program ($179) right on the call. No cold calling, no prospecting.



What you’ll do



Call warm US leads from your call lists in our CRM (Close, with a built-in power dialer)

Build rapport quickly and confirm the lead’s interest and goals

Answer remaining questions clearly and honestly

Handle common objections such as timing, trust or “I need to think about it”

Close on the call, send the checkout link and follow up until payment is complete

Follow up with leads you couldn’t reach

Log every call: short notes, status and next step



What we’re looking for



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent

1+ year of phone sales or BPO sales experience; experience calling US customers is a big plus

Confident, friendly and to the point: you can close on the first call without being pushy

Organized, reliable and clean with CRM notes

Night shift: your shift falls within 10 am – 10 pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday

Quiet home workspace, stable internet with a backup (e.g. mobile data) and a noise-cancelling headset

You never make income or profit promises, and you follow US calling rules (calls only between 9 am and 9 pm in the lead’s local time)



Compensation (paid monthly in USD)



$750 base in month 1, then $1,000/month once you reach 60 sales in a month

+ $15 commission per sale, no cap

Full-time reps closing 3–5 sales per day earn $1,900–$2,500/month from month 2

Commission is paid on completed, non-refunded sales

Independent contractor, fully home-based



What you get



Warm, pre-educated US leads only: no cold calling

Short calls with a simple offer, so you close on the first call

A proven process that already works in our European market

A growth path into a high-ticket closer role



To apply

Send a 60–90 second voice note or video introducing yourself in English, and answer these 3 questions:



What have you sold by phone before, and what was your close rate?

A lead says “It sounds good, but I need to think about it.” What do you say?

Can you work US hours (night shift in PH time), Monday to Friday?

title: Creative VA: Video Editing (Riverside), Kajabi & Social Media Strategy
description:
ABOUT ME AND MY BUSINESS



Hi! I'm Naomi Appelhof, a biblicalcounselor and identity coach. I help women move from insecurity to a strong, God-given identity. I've worked in counseling and care since 2004, and I'm a wife and a mother of three.



My Dutch business is established, with programs, online courses and an engaged community. Now I'm starting something new: building the English-speaking, global side of my ministry and business. That side is still very new, and I'm looking for someone who wants to help build it from the start.



WHAT I NEED HELP WITH



Video editing in Riverside

- Edit podcast episodes, interviews and videos in Riverside

- Make short clips (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) from longer recordings

- Add captions, clean up audio and video, and keep everything on brand



Kajabi (advanced, highly experienced)

You know the platform inside out and follow its latest features and updates.

- Set up and maintain courses, communities, landing pages,
 sequences and offers in Kajabi

- Help me decide how to set up the English side of my business in Kajabi, for example how to keep my English community separate from my Dutch community

- Stay on top of new Kajabi features and suggest how we can use them

- Advise on the best structure for the customer journey and the technical setup



Social media content strategy

- Help shape a clear content strategy for the English market (Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube)

- Plan content, suggest themes and formats, and keep track of what works

- Think strategically about growing an international audience



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



Skills matter, but the most important thing for me is how you work. I'm looking for someone who:

- Thinks ahead and takes initiative. You don't wait to be told; you see what's coming and act on it.

- Brings ideas. You suggest improvements, new content and smarter ways of working.

- Is open to feedback. You welcome input and use it to keep growing.

- Is organized and structured. You keep track of tasks, files and deadlines, and you communicate clearly.

- Writes and communicates well in English



DON'T HAVE ALL THE SKILLS? PLEASE STILL APPLY!



I know it's rare to find one person who is great at all three: video editing, Kajabi and social media strategy. If you're strong in one or two of these areas, please still reach out to me. Just tell me clearly where your strengths are. For example, you may be excellent in Riverside but not experienced with Kajabi, or the other way around. I'd love to hear from you either way.



FAITH



My work is rooted in my Christian faith, and much of my content is Bible-based. It would be wonderful if you share that faith or feel connected to it, especially for the social media work. It isn't a requirement, but you do need to be open to it and comfortable working with faith-based content.



HOURS AND GROWTH



To be honest about where I am: right now I can't offer a full-time role. To start, this is about 2-3 hours per week, and the hours may vary. My intention is to build a long-term working relationship. As the English side grows, I'd love for this role to grow with it.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience

2. Which of the three areas (Riverside video editing, Kajabi, social media strategy) you are strongest in

3. Examples of your work (edited videos, Kajabi projects, social media strategies or accounts you've managed)

4. Your hourly rate

5. One idea you have for growing a Christian coaching brand on social media



To show me you've read this whole post, please start your message with: "Ready to build something meaningful."



I look forward to hearing from you!

title: Online Maths & Science Tutor – UK Curriculum Year 9 (Part-Time, Daytime)
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read to the end. The application instructions are at the bottom, and applications that skip

them will not be read.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a family in Singapore looking for a patient, creative Maths and Science tutor for a 17-year-old student.

He studies a UK homeschool curriculum (Wolsey Hall Oxford, Lower Secondary Year 9) on the Canvas

platform.



Wolsey Hall's tutors set and mark his work. Your job is to help him understand it, stay with it, and complete his

OWN work. A separate Learning Coach runs his day and covers his other subjects; you work alongside them.

Singapore and the Philippines are in the same time zone, so this is a normal daytime schedule.



SCHEDULE

• Monday to Friday, 1 hour a day (5 hours/week), at a fixed time: 11:20 AM–12:20 PM

• Maths on Monday, Wednesday and Friday; Science on Tuesday and Thursday

• Live video sessions on a Zoom/Google Meet link we provide.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Pick up from the day's targets set by the Learning Coach.

• Explain each concept step by step, then have him try. He shares his screen and does the working; you

guide.

• Break each assignment into 20-minute chunks, so every session ends with something saved or submitted.

• Hook his interest through the films and characters he likes, then bridge to the real topic. Right now that

includes superheroes (The Flash, Spider-Man, Batman) and James Cameron's Avatar. Example: how far

does The Flash get in 3 seconds, and what does that tell us about speed = distance ÷ time? His interests

change over time, so keep asking what he is watching.

• After each session, post a 3-line report in the family group chat: attended (Y/N), what was completed (with a

screenshot), next session's target.

• Flag early if a topic needs more time, so the Learning Coach can plan around it.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

• Write, edit or "fix" his work. Wolsey Hall marks it as his own. No AI-written text goes into anything he

submits.

• Contact him privately (personal chat, phone calls, social media). All communication goes through the family

group chat.

• Ask for his Canvas login. You will see Canvas through his screen share.



IF HE DOES NOT SHOW UP

It will happen sometimes. When it does:

1. At the start time, post in the group chat that you are in the session.

2. At 5 minutes, post again.

3. Wait until 15 minutes. If he is still not there, use the rest of the slot to prepare the next session, and note

the no-show in your report.

You are paid for the scheduled time when you follow these steps. Following up with him is the family's job, not

yours.



WHO YOU ARE

• Licensed Professional Teacher (LET) majoring in Mathematics or Science, or a STEM degree

• At least 2 years teaching Maths and/or Science to teenagers (13–18)

• Comfortable teaching BOTH Maths and Science at lower-secondary level (about Grade 8–9)

• Clear spoken English; you can explain without jargon

• Warm but steady: you can encourage him and still hold a line

• You treat a 17-year-old as a young adult. Never "this is easy".

• Reliable setup: laptop, webcam, headset, fibre internet AND a backup (mobile data / power bank / UPS)

• Nice to have: UK or Cambridge curriculum experience (Lower Secondary, IGCSE), a digital whiteboard or

drawing tablet



PAY AND TERMS

• USD 6–7 per hour depending on experience (5 hours/week)

• Paid every two weeks via Wise or PayPal

• Shortlisted applicants do a paid 45-minute live trial session, then a paid 1-week trial

• NBI clearance required before starting

• Long-term role for the right person



HOW TO APPLY



1. Begin your application with the word EQUATION.



2. Include a 2-minute video introducing yourself (unlisted YouTube, Loom or Google Drive link).



3. Answer these in your own words (no AI tools):



- a) He gets stuck on a problem and says, "I'm just bad at maths." What do you say?



- b) Using The Flash or any superhero, explain speed = distance ÷ time to a 17-year-old in 3–5 sentences.



- c) It is 10 minutes past the start time and he has not joined. What do you do?

title: Software Developer
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



You’ll write the software that sits behind the brand: the tools our teams use, the integrations that connect our systems, and the experiences our customers see. You’ll talk to the people who use what you ship, and build the thing that actually fixes their problem, not the thing they first described.



For a sharp, driven engineer who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Build what the business needs. Work with marketing, creative, operations, and support to find where software can save time, cut errors, or unlock growth, then build it.



Improve the customer experience. Build and refine the features on our store and sites that help customers find, trust, and buy, and keep them fast, reliable, and easy to use on every device. 



Connect our systems. Build and maintain the integrations between our store, fulfillment partners, ad platforms,
, support tools, and analytics, so data flows where it should and nobody retypes anything.



Automate the repetitive work. Find the tasks that eat people’s hours and turn them into scripts, workflows, and tools that run on their own.



Make the numbers trustworthy. Build the data pipelines, tracking, and dashboards that let the team see what’s working, and keep them accurate.



Build with AI. Design and ship features and workflows powered by AI, from tools that speed up our team’s work to experiences that help our customers.



Ship fast, and ship well. Move from idea to production quickly, in small steps, with code that’s tested, readable, and easy for the next person to change.



Keep it secure and running. Handle customer and company data carefully, follow the privacy rules in every market we sell in, and fix what breaks before it affects anyone.



Choose the simple solution. Question every layer of complexity. Pick the right tool for each job, not the most impressive one.



Write it down. Document what you build and how it works, so nothing lives only in your head.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI coding tools to speed up design, implementation, testing, and documentation, then apply your own judgment to make sure the result is correct, secure, and maintainable.



What we look for



Strong fundamentals. You write clean, correct code, understand how the pieces of a system fit together, and can reason your way through a problem you haven’t seen before.



Pragmatism. You ship the simplest thing that works well, and you improve it with real feedback instead of building for imaginary needs.



Product sense. You care who uses what you build. You ask good questions, notice when the request isn’t the real problem, and test your work against reality.



Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when something breaks, find the real cause quickly, and keep people informed while you fix it.



Clear communication. You can explain technical things to non-technical people in plain words, and your written updates leave no one guessing.



Ownership. You treat every system you build as yours until it works for the people using it. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [3+] years building and shipping production software, with strong skills across the front end and back end. Experience integrating with third-party APIs and working with data is essential. Experience in e-commerce or consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. What you build goes live fast and is used by real people right away. You’ll see the whole company work better because of it.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the engineer who builds our foundations is the person best placed to lead the team behind them.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 
/?job=softdev_jazz_ph

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply here: 
/?job=softdev_onl_ph

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.
